jobs.title: AI Software Engineer - Senior
jobs.description: Overview We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Senior AI Software Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will lead the development and deployment of cutting\-edge artificial intelligence solutions that drive transformative insights and automation across diverse business domains. Your expertise will empower us to harness the full potential of big data, machine learning frameworks, and cloud\-based AI services to solve complex problems and deliver scalable, impactful results. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of AI technology within a forward\-thinking organization committed to continuous innovation and excellence. Responsibilities * Design, develop, and optimize AI models using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and other machine learning tools for predictive modeling, natural language processing, and generative AI applications. * Lead model training, evaluation, and deployment processes ensuring high accuracy, scalability, and robustness across diverse datasets. * Implement big data systems utilizing Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Talend, and other ETL tools to process large\-scale datasets efficiently. * Develop database schemas and design SQL databases to support data analytics and AI model integration. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions leveraging AWS cloud services for machine learning deployment and management. * Conduct statistical analysis for research purposes using R, SAS, or similar statistical tools to inform model development and validation strategies. * Optimize AI models for scalability and performance in cloud environments while ensuring compliance with data privacy standards. * Utilize data mining techniques and linked data principles to enhance model accuracy through enriched datasets. * Contribute to the development of AI implementation strategies that incorporate natural language processing, predictive analytics, and generative AI techniques. * Maintain thorough documentation of algorithms, processes, and system architecture to facilitate ongoing improvements and knowledge sharing. Experience * All levels are welcome to contact us. * Proven experience as an AI Software Engineer or Data Scientist, strong experience in model training, front deployment, and software engineering in frontend, backend. * Hands\-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar platforms. * Strong programming skills in Python, Java, C, Bash (Unix shell), VBA is a plus for automation tasks. * Proficiency in SQL databases along with experience in database design for analytics applications. * Familiarity with cloud\-based machine learning services on AWS or comparable platforms for model deployment and management. * Knowledge of statistical modeling techniques combined with experience in statistical analysis tools like R or SAS for research\-driven insights. * Experience working with natural language processing (NLP), generative AI models, and predictive modeling analysis to solve real\-world problems. * Ability to work effectively within cross\-disciplinary teams on complex projects involving data analytics, AI implementation, and system scalability. Join us if you're passionate about pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence through innovative engineering practices! Pay: $134,000\.00 \- $250,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cupertino, CA 95014

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, High-Volume Data Processing
jobs.description: **Location:** Dumbo, Brooklyn, NY (onsite, 5 days/week) **Type:** Full\-time **Compensation:** $220K\-$300K base salary **Relocation:** Up to $10K **Visa:** Open to visa transfers (including OPT and H\-1B). Additional sponsorship may be considered for the right candidate. **Openings:** 2 **About Client** ---------------- Client is the primary source of real, proprietary enterprise data for the world's leading frontier AI labs. They acquire enterprise data generated through collaboration, communication, and building. They transform it into de\-identified datasets that remain useful, and license those datasets directly to frontier AI labs. They've scaled from $0 to a multi\-eight\-figure run rate in a matter of months. They have about 14 people, with a lean engineering team of around five, backed by Floodgate, Afore Capital, Ludlow Ventures, and Hustle Fund. The client was built by the team behind Sunset, which scaled to an eight\-figure run rate and helped hundreds of venture\-backed startups wind down. **The Role** ------------ You'll own the backend systems that turn raw enterprise data into clean, de\-identified, high\-value datasets. This is not a role about moving data between systems. The work is code applied to the data itself: multi\-stage pipelines that process large volumes of messy, real\-world data where correctness matters as much as throughput. You'll join a small team where each engineer has real ownership, the problems are ambiguous, and your work directly affects revenue. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, and own production multi\-stage data\-processing pipelines end to end * Build systems that stay correct under failure, with sound handling of retries, partial failures, and recovery * Apply NLP and Named Entity Recognition (NER) techniques to de\-identify and transform enterprise data * Build internal tooling and dashboards that show how the pipeline is performing and where it's breaking * Work across the stack, in AWS and mostly Python, to ship quickly and improve reliability and quality * Make pragmatic technical decisions with minimal process and a lot of autonomy **Required** * A relevant undergraduate STEM degree from a top\-30 U.S. institution * 5 \-10 years of software engineering experience, with personal ownership of production backend systems * Hands\-on experience building and running multi\-stage, high\-volume data\-processing pipelines * Strong fundamentals in distributed and asynchronous systems: queues, workers, concurrency, idempotency, retries, partial failure, and recovery. We care about correctness and recovery under failure, not just scale. * Meaningful full\-time experience at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup, with real ambiguity and ownership (internships and brief stints don't count) * Strong skills in a general\-purpose backend language. Our stack is Python on AWS, but strong Go, Rust, or Java engineers are welcome. * Experience with AWS * Familiarity with NLP and NER * Willingness to work onsite in Dumbo, Brooklyn, 5 days a week. We support relocation for candidates outside NYC. **Nice to have** * Brand\-name company experience paired with a meaningful startup stint * A clear record of career progression * Batch or workflow orchestration experience * A backend\-leaning full\-stack background, especially internal tools and dashboards **Compensation \& Logistics** ----------------------------- * Base salary: $220K\-$300K * Relocation support: up to $10K * Visa transfers supported, including OPT and H\-1B * Onsite 5 days/week in Dumbo, Brooklyn \#hc267456

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Philadelphia, PA \| Full\-time We are hiring a Cloud Engineer to build, maintain, and improve the cloud services behind a growing technology environment. This is a role for an engineer who likes getting into the detail, whether that means improving a deployment process, resolving a tricky access issue, tightening a security control, or making an unreliable service easier to monitor. You will work closely with software, infrastructure, and support colleagues to ensure cloud platforms are secure, well documented, and ready to support the business as it grows. The position At Zenithbase Technologies, cloud engineering is not limited to provisioning resources. You will help shape how systems are designed, deployed, supported, and recovered. Your work will have a direct impact on service reliability, information security, and the experience of the people using our technology. Key accountabilitiesCloud infrastructure and automation * Build and maintain cloud infrastructure using repeatable, well\-documented methods. * Support the design and operation of cloud\-hosted applications, databases, networking, storage, and identity services. * Develop automation for routine engineering and operational tasks using PowerShell, Python, Terraform, or similar tools. * Improve CI/CD pipelines and work with development teams to make releases dependable and easier to manage. Security and resilience * Maintain cloud security controls, access management, encryption, logging, patching, and vulnerability remediation. * Support backup, disaster recovery, and business\-continuity arrangements, including regular testing. * Review cloud configuration and usage to identify risk, inefficiency, or opportunities to improve resilience. * Help investigate technical incidents and contribute to root\-cause analysis and corrective actions. Operational improvement * Monitor performance, availability, alerts, and capacity across cloud platforms. * Keep architecture diagrams, configuration records, operating procedures, and technical documentation current. * Work with vendors and internal teams to resolve escalated technical issues. * Contribute to technology roadmaps, infrastructure upgrades, and cloud\-cost optimisation. Candidate profile You should have: * At least three years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, systems administration, or infrastructure engineering. * Hands\-on experience with Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, or a comparable cloud platform. * Experience with identity and access management, networking, virtual machines, storage, and cloud security controls. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, or Ansible. * Experience supporting CI/CD pipelines and source\-control workflows. * A good understanding of monitoring, incident management, backup, and disaster recovery. * Strong troubleshooting skills and a disciplined approach to documentation and change control. * The ability to explain technical issues clearly to colleagues with different levels of technical knowledge. Relevant cloud certifications are welcomed, particularly Azure, AWS, Kubernetes, or security qualifications. Working arrangements and benefits Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Work location: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) plan with employer contribution * Paid time off, paid sick leave, and paid company holidays * Life and disability insurance * Flexible spending account options * Paid technical training and certification support * Employee assistance program * Company\-issued equipment Zenithbase Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics. Pay: $115,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Design Specialist II
jobs.description: **About Stratus** Stratus is a fully integrated engineering, architecture, interior design, and consulting firm delivering comprehensive solutions across diverse markets. Built on the union of deeply rooted firms and recognized industry leaders, we bring together broad expertise and a robust talent pool to deliver comprehensive end\-to\-end solutions. Serving public and private clients across the Civic, Commercial, Industrial, Transportation, Education, Water Resources, and Government sectors, we approach every project\-whether a targeted renovation or large\-scale infrastructure\-with precision, insight, and purpose. Stratus designs spaces that work, last, and make an impact. **The Role**The CAD/BIM Designer is a highly experienced design professional responsible for overseeing complex digital modeling, drafting, and coordination efforts across large\-scale architectural and engineering projects. This role involves leading multi\-disciplinary design coordination, implementing advanced modeling techniques, and setting standards to ensure consistency, quality, and efficiency across projects. The CAD/BIM Designer IV plays a key leadership role within the design team, providing expertise, guidance, and support to junior designers while managing challenging and high\-stakes design tasks. **Responsibilities** * Lead the development of detailed and highly complex 2D and 3D CAD/BIM models, preparing construction documents, technical drawings, and digital representations that meet all project requirements. * Oversee multi\-disciplinary coordination within CAD/BIM environments, integrating architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, and other models into a unified and cohesive project design. * Set, enforce, and monitor CAD/BIM standards and best practices across all design stages, ensuring quality control and adherence to project specifications. * Provide expert\-level guidance and mentorship to junior and intermediate designers, assisting with technical challenges, training on best practices, and ensuring consistent quality. * Collaborate closely with project managers, architects, engineers, and clients to understand project requirements, resolve design issues, and make necessary adjustments to models and documentation. * Conduct advanced quality control reviews on CAD/BIM deliverables, verifying accuracy, consistency, and compliance with industry standards, regulatory codes, and project specifications. * Develop and implement workflows that enhance efficiency and ensure seamless integration of CAD/BIM processes across large\-scale projects. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex design and software issues, assisting with problem\-solving across the design team. * Prepare high\-quality presentations, visualizations, and 3D renderings for client and stakeholder meetings, ensuring that design intent and technical details are effectively communicated. * Stay updated on advancements in CAD/BIM technologies, processes, and industry standards, implementing new tools and techniques to improve design quality and operational efficiency. **Qualifications** *Required** Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree or certification in CAD, BIM, Architecture, Engineering, or related field. * 6\-8 years of experience in CAD/BIM design, with significant experience on complex, multi\-disciplinary projects. *Preferred** Advanced certification in AutoCAD, Revit, or other BIM software. * Experience in a leadership or supervisory role within CAD/BIM design teams. **Why you'll love Stratus*** A team\-oriented environment that values transparency, creativity, and shared success * Meaningful career paths, leadership opportunities, and space to specialize * Learning \& Development – Education and Professional Licensing * We support hybrid work and balance because your well\-being matters * Excellent Health Care Programs – Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Company\-paid Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability, and Long\-Term Disability * Voluntary Life Insurance options for employees, spouses, and dependents * 401k Retirement Plan with employer match * Paid Holidays \& Competitive PTO plans Interested in learning more about Stratus, please visit https://www.stratusteam.com/ . **Equal Opportunity Statement** *Stratus is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy\-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. Stratus Team’s management Team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, access to facilities and programs, and general treatment during employment.*

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description: Efficient Computer is rethinking computing from the ground up to solve one of AI's biggest challenges: energy. Our Fabric architecture delivers a 10–100x improvement in energy efficiency for general\-purpose computation, including AI, while supporting familiar programming languages and software frameworks—unlocking new possibilities for autonomous machines, intelligent infrastructure, wearables, and space systems. With our first processor, Electron E1, now shipping in volume and more than $97 million in Series B financing recently announced, we're accelerating customer deployments and scaling our architecture to data center performance. Join us to build the hardware and software that bring intelligence wherever it's needed and help shape the next generation of computing. Computing's growth is limited by energy. Efficient Computer, a fabless semiconductor company spun out of Carnegie Mellon University, exists to change that. We build general\-purpose processors that run the same workloads as a CPU or GPU on a small fraction of the energy, which makes real computing possible in places where power and battery life have always been the limiting factor. We have taped out multiple test chips, our first production chip is back from the foundry, and we will be shipping to customers soon. Those customers are building everything from industrial and automation systems to wearables to spacecraft. We are well capitalized, backed by leading venture and strategic investors, and growing quickly across sites in Pittsburgh, Austin, and San Jose. **The opportunity** ------------------- This is our first dedicated finance hire. You will own finance and accounting end to end, working with the right third parties where that makes sense, and shape the function into one that is ready for the scale ahead of us. How that gets built is largely yours to define, and as the company grows, so does this function and the team behind it. Day to day you will work with the VP of Operations, closely with the CEO, and directly with department heads across engineering, supply chain, and people ops, along with our outside accountants, auditors, and counsel. In your first few months, we would expect you to get the close running on a predictable cadence, form a clear view of our cash position and committed spend, and sit down with every department head to understand the spending behind the budgets they have been given. By the end of your first year, leadership should be running the business off a forecast you own and trust, department heads should own their budgets rather than receive them, our controls and documentation should be in a place where an audit would not be a fire drill, and we should have a real plan for what finance looks like at several times our current size. **What you will own** --------------------- **Accounting, tax, and compliance.** Run the month\-end close with our outsourced bookkeepers and make it fast, clean, and repeatable. Ready the books for taxes, work with our external CPAs through filings and year end, and manage those partner relationships to a standard you set. Own the GL, revenue recognition, and inventory and cost accounting as we move into production volume, including the contract manufacturer and international vendor questions that come with it. Own payroll, AP, AR, billing, and collections as commercial revenue ramps, along with R\&D tax credits and Section 174 treatment, sales tax, and the multi\-state obligations of a distributed team. **Planning, forecasting, and budgeting.** Own the operating model, the annual budget, and the rolling forecast, and improve all three: better drivers, tighter assumptions, and a model people trust enough to decide against. Build a real departmental budgeting process hand in hand with department heads, so each function owns its numbers instead of inheriting them. Deliver variance analysis that explains what the numbers mean, not just what they are. **Cash and capital.** Forecast cash and manage treasury in a business that commits large amounts of capital well ahead of revenue, including the impact of tape\-outs, wafer and substrate commitments, test hardware, and other long\-lead spend. Own our banking and insurance relationships, and support future financings, debt facilities, and the diligence that comes with them. **Systems, controls, and reporting.** Own the finance systems roadmap and make sure our stack is ready for scale: integrated, well understood, and able to support a much bigger company without a rip and replace. Build the controls, approval flows, and documentation a company our size should have, without adding process for its own sake, and get us audit ready. Prepare board and investor reporting alongside the VP of Operations and CEO, and support equity administration, 409A refreshes, and cap table work with our counsel and outside partners. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- * 10\+ years in finance and accounting, including ownership of both a close and a forecast * Experience doing this in a capital\-intensive business, whether semiconductor or another industry where large commitments are made long before revenue and cash planning has to run years out * Time in a fast\-moving startup, ideally as an early or first finance hire, and comfort operating without a finance team behind you * A track record of maturing a finance function: taking something scrappy and making it rigorous without slowing the company down * Clear communication with people who do not think in accounting terms, including engineers, executives, and the board * Comfort being hands on. For a while you will be doing the work, not directing it Bonus points for a CPA, semiconductor or hardware experience, having run a company's first audit, having implemented finance systems that outlasted your tenure, or having prepared a company for the reporting rigor that comes with an IPO track or an acquisition. Semiconductor experience is a plus rather than a requirement: what matters is that you have built and run this function somewhere capital intensive before. We offer a competitive base salary for this role, generally ranging from $160,000 to $240,000, plus a 10% annual bonus, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits. Final compensation will depend on experience, level, and location, with flexibility for the right candidate. **Why Join Efficient?** Build what's next. At Efficient, you'll tackle big challenges with room to take ownership and make an impact. We back you with competitive pay, equity, a 401(k) match, company\-paid benefits, paid parental leave, and flexibility—plus opportunities to grow your skills and career as we scale.

jobs.title: Founding Applied AI Engineer — Proactive AI Agents
jobs.description: **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Base Salary:** $300K–$500K **Equity:** Substantial founding\-level / competitive equity **Visa:** Open to visa transfers and new sponsorship **Relocation:** Relocation support available **Team Size:** 3 employees (Founded 2026\) **Hiring Goal:** 1–2 candidates ### **About Client** A research\-first, product\-led AI company building the next generation of personal, proactive AI agents. Rather than building chatbots or copilots that wait for instructions, Centaur is developing agents that understand how people work, anticipate their needs, and autonomously pursue objectives on their behalf over days, weeks, and months. The platform observes how individual users work — including screen activity, conversations, and actions across tools — to understand intent and human judgment. It learns repetitive workflows, proactively automates tasks that do not require human judgment, and continuously improves from feedback when its predictions differ from users' actual decisions. ### **About the Opportunity** As a **Founding Applied AI Engineer**, you'll join a tiny, high\-agency founding team at the earliest stage of building truly autonomous, proactive AI agents. This is not an implementation role — you'll help define product direction, ideate solutions, and independently own the end\-to\-end build of agentic systems from 0?1\. ### **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and ship agentic AI systems and agent harnesses that power Centaur's proactive, autonomous agent platform * Take personal ownership of 0?1 ML/AI model\-based products — from technical architecture through production deployment * Operate across product, engineering, models, and infrastructure — this is a broad, cross\-functional role, not a narrowly scoped one * Help define product direction, ideate solutions, brainstorm features, and make independent technical and product decisions * Build systems that learn user intent and workflows from screen activity, conversations, and cross\-tool actions * Continuously improve agent performance based on feedback loops between predicted and actual user decisions * Work in close, daily collaboration with a tiny founding team where every engineer has outsized influence on product and technical direction ### **Required Qualifications** * **2–6 years** of professional experience as an Applied AI Engineer or in a substantially equivalent hands\-on Applied AI engineering role * Experience at a relevant technical environment: an AI lab, an applied AI startup, an AI\-focused startup with directly relevant work, or an infrastructure company * Demonstrated **0?1 ownership** of a production ML/AI model\-based product or agentic system — you personally built and shipped it, not just contributed to an existing system * **Hands\-on experience building agentic systems, agent harnesses, or model\-based AI/ML products** (candidates whose AI experience is entirely in adjacent areas such as computer vision, speech, or robotics, without agentic systems experience, are not a fit) * **Deep, professional\-level Python expertise** — basic familiarity, academic use, or occasional scripting is not sufficient * Demonstrated ability to operate across product, engineering, models, and infrastructure * Demonstrated product ownership and ideation — defining direction, brainstorming features, and making independent technical/product decisions, rather than primarily implementing predefined specs * Willing and able to work onsite in San Francisco 5 days/week *(firm requirement — remote work is not being considered)* ### **Strongly Preferred** * Early\-stage startup engineering experience * Early hire at a high\-growth AI startup * Company founder experience * Major product ownership * Strong university background from a top\-tier global institution * Frontier AI lab experience * Strong research background combined with demonstrated product shipping \#hc267432

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: Full Tilt Data, LLC is a trusted data, analytics, and IT consulting firm specializing is health related services for the federal government. Established in 2023 by a group of founders that bring 15\+ years of industry experience. We are passionate about harnessing the power of data through our comprehensive data management solutions. The applications allow external organizations to submit, validate, and certify data that support critical agency programs. **Key Responsibilities** * Build and enhance front\-end and back\-end services that will support future interoperability interfaces such as FHIR. * Build accessible, user\-friendly interfaces in React (or Angular), including supporting a planned front\-end migration from Kendo UI to React. * Build spreadsheet import and export features (Apache POI) and data validation logic for user submissions. * Design and maintain database schemas and migrations on Amazon RDS/Aurora (MySQL). * Write unit and integration tests (JUnit, Mockito, Jest, Vitest) and meet code quality and security checks in SonarQube and Snyk. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code in GitHub Enterprise and deploy to containerized AWS environments (ECS/Fargate, Kubernetes). * Ensure features meet Section 508 and WCAG 2\.1 accessibility standards, federal design system guidelines, and security requirements, including role\-based access control. * Participate in PI Planning, sprint ceremonies, and demos, and provide production support during peak data submission periods. **Required Qualifications** * 4\+ years of professional full stack development experience. * Strong Java skills, including Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate, and Maven. * Experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript and React (React 18, plus a state management tool such as Redux, Zustand, or TanStack Query) or Angular. * Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs. * Solid relational database and SQL skills (MySQL, Aurora, or similar). * Hands\-on experience with AWS services (e.g., ECS, S3, RDS, API Gateway) and containers. * Experience with Git\-based workflows, CI/CD, and automated testing. * Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. * Candidates must be able to pass a background check equivalent to a Federal Public Trust clearance. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting federal government contracts. * Experience with FHIR APIs or other data interoperability standards. * Experience in SAFe environments; SAFe certification is a plus. * Experience building Section 508\-compliant applications using the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS) or a similar federal design system. * Familiarity with Kendo UI, WildFly, Storybook, or Node.js. * Experience with federal identity management solutions, New Relic, or Splunk. * Exposure to Spark, jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: **MUST\-HAVE SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE** **Programming \& Data Engineering** Expert \- level proficiency in Python, Scala, and PySpark, with a strong track record of designing and delivering production\-ready, modular, and well\-tested solutions; developing and troubleshooting Spark workloads; and optimizing large\-scale batch and streaming data pipelines using Delta Lake and Spark technologies. Strong SQL and data modelling — dimensional and normalised; schema design and data contract definition. Databricks expertise — Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Jobs \& Workflows, cluster and pool management, performance tuning, Model Serving. Azure data stack — ADLS Gen2 (zone design, ACLs, lifecycle), Azure Data Factory (parameterized / metadata\-driven frameworks, error handling), Azure Event Hubs. **AI \& Machine Learning** 3\+ years designing and shipping LLM\-based systems in production: RAG pipelines, agentic / tool\-calling workflows, structured output, chunking and embedding strategy, vector and hybrid retrieval, and prompt engineering. Evaluation discipline — golden datasets, regression suites, accuracy and hallucination tracking, human\-in\-the\-loop feedback loops; you measure AI quality, not assert it. Hands\-on experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph, plus at least one provider stack (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or Databricks Model Serving). Metadata\-driven thinking — schema inference, data profiling, lineage, catalogs, and configuration\-driven frameworks that onboard the next source without new code. **Architecture \& Governance** 12–18 years of total experience in data engineering, data platform delivery, or related disciplines. Proven delivery of a medallion / lakehouse architecture at enterprise scale — not just familiarity with the concept. Azure security and governance — Entra ID, managed identities, RBAC, POSIX ACLs on ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, private endpoints, and PII handling. CI/CD and infrastructure as code — Azure DevOps, Terraform, Databricks Asset Bundles, and automated testing of data pipelines. Clear technical writing and the ability to present and defend a design to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. **STRONGLY PREFERRED** Knowledge graphs and ontologies: RDF/SPARQL, property graphs (Neo4j), or graph modelling over a lakehouse. Text\-to\-SQL or semantic\-layer\-backed natural\-language query systems at enterprise scale, including access control and ambiguity handling. ML\-based anomaly detection on time\-series or transactional financial data. Financial services or insurance domain knowledge: finance close, general ledger, subledger, reconciliation, or actuarial data. LLMOps and MLOps: model versioning, prompt versioning, cost governance, and observability tooling. Databricks Data Engineer Professional, Azure DP\-203 / DP\-700, or AZ\-305 certification. dbt, Great Expectations, or similar data\-quality and transformation tooling. Workday, Prism, or Accounting Center exposure. **WHAT MAKES SOMEONE SUCCESSFUL HERE** You prototype in days, not sprints — and the prototype is production\-close enough to survive an architecture review. You know where AI genuinely helps and where a deterministic rule is the better engineering answer. On finance data, that judgement matters more than enthusiasm. You design for human review by default. Every AI\-generated mapping, rule, and artefact lands in front of a reviewer with the reasoning attached. You are comfortable working with US\-based client stakeholders and can explain a technical trade\-off to a finance business owner without jargon. You leave behind documentation and patterns the client's own team can operate without you. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $145,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cary, NC 27512

jobs.title: Plant Utilities Engineer 1 (NY HELPS) (Power Plant)
jobs.description: Duties Description Plant Utilities Engineers 1 operate, maintain and repair mechanical, electrical, and auxiliary or emergency equipment in a heating or air\-conditioning plant or a single or multi\-building facility or facilities with multiple utility equipment installations. Minimum Qualifications This title is part of the New York Hiring for Emergency Limited Placement Statewide Program (NY HELPS). For the duration of the NY HELPS Program, this title maybe filled via a non\-competitive appointment, which means no examination is required but all candidates must meet the minimum qualifications of the title for which they apply. At a future date (within one year of permanent appointment), it is expected employees hired under NY HELPS will have their non\-competitive employment status converted to competitive status, without having to compete in an examination. While serving permanently in a NY HELPS title, employees may take part in any promotion examination for which they are qualified. NON\-COMPETITIVE MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS (NY HELPS): Either 1\. Graduate of heating, HVAC, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration apprenticeship program from the U.S. Air Force; Or 2\. Must have been an enlisted machinery technician (MK) with the U.S. Coast Guard OR possession of a certificate as a Marine Engineer issued by the U.S. Coast Guard; Or 3\. Must have been an enlisted power generation equipment repairer with the U.S. Army; Or 4\. Must have been an enlisted gas turbine systems technician, submarine nuclear propulsion plant operator reactor control, utilities man, machinist mate, or engineman with the U.S. Navy; Or 5\. Must have a Merchant Mariner's Document (MMD) and have been a qualified member of the engine department (QMED) as an oiler, fireman/water tender, refrigerating engineer or engineman with the U.S. Merchant Marine; Or 6\. Completion of a New York State Department of Labor registered apprenticeship program for stationary engineers, plant maintenance (plumber/steamfitter), HVAC Mechanic or plant maintenance (refrigeration/AC) (See Note \#1\); Or 7\. Possession of a High\-Pressure Boiler Operating Engineer License or Stationary Engineer License; Or 8\. A bachelor's degree in Facilities Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Marine Engineering; Or 9\. Four years of full\-time hands on experience in the maintenance and operation of commercial, industrial, institutional facility, computer applications of digital energy platforms and building analytics and/or performing diagnosis, repair of HVAC systems or boilers or auxiliary equipment; Or 10\. Four years of full\-time hands on experience in a residential setting performing diagnosis, operation, maintenance repair of HVAC systems or boilers or auxiliary equipment; Or 11\. An associate's degree in HVAC AND two years of qualifying experience as described in EITHER qualification \#9 or \#10 above; Or 12\. Completion of an HVAC certificate or diploma from a BOCES program (900 hours) OR completion of an approved certificate in HVAC, electrical, refrigeration, boiler operations and maintenance, or plumbing from an accredited technical school or technology college (See Note \#2\) AND two years of qualifying experience as described in EITHER qualification \#9 or \#10 above. Information on ACCSC accredited programs can be found here: http://www.accsc.org/ \[(External Link)] . Information on BPSS recognized proprietary schools can be found here: http://www.acces.nysed.gov/bpss/welcome\-career\-training\-proprietary\-schools \[(External Link)] . COMPETITIVE MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS (NON\-NY HELPS): Candidates must have a reachable score on the University at Albany Plant Utilities Engineer 1 Exam List OR Be a current NYS employee and have a current permanent appointment with 1 year of service as a Plant Utilities Engineer 1, or in a title eligible to transfer to Plant Utilities Engineer 1 OR Be a former NYS employee eligible for reinstatement to the title of Plant Utilities Engineer 1 May be filled from a mandatory reemployment list if one is in effect at the time of appointment. Any applications received that do not meet the above requirements as described will be deemed unqualified. Additional Comments YOU MUST APPLY ONLINE using this link: http://albany.interviewexchange.com/jobofferdetails.jsp?JOBID\=205502 Some positions may require additional credentials or a background check to verify your identity.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera. **The Job** ----------- You will own features end to end, from conception to production, across our gateway infrastructure, enterprise deployments, and agentic systems. The work leans backend and infra, but nothing is off limits: when the product needs a better UI you build it, and when a connector breaks during a security review you fix it. Claude and Codex are your primary working environment, and you use a fleet of agents to move faster than a team this size has any right to. Agents write much of the code and review PRs, so your real job is the judgment they cannot make: shaping the problem, making architecture, product, and UX calls, hardening enterprise paths, designing connectors, protecting security\-sensitive surfaces, and catching generated code that is quietly wrong. Roles are blurred and we ship within hours, and you will learn directly from the founders and from customers. We hire across levels, from strong early\-career builders to seasoned engineers, and we set level and pay to match. What matters most is judgment, range, and how fast you ship. **About You** ------------- * You are a builder with a track record of shipping to real users, whether that is a product, an internal tool, an open\-source project, or a serious side project. You ship, then iterate, without waiting for specs or approvals. * You have strong fundamentals and learn fast. How quickly you pick things up matters as much as years of experience. * You care about product value and customer needs over technical purity. * You take infra seriously. You think about blast radius, trust boundaries, and what happens when your code is in the path of every customer's agents. * You can read unfamiliar code, reason from first principles, and explain your tradeoffs. * You are comfortable across the stack (TypeScript, Python, CockroachDB), or you pick up new languages, protocols, and domains fast. * You are excited to build with agents, and to learn when they help and when they hide a problem. * You already build with AI every day and want room to move without heavy process. **Nice to have:** ----------------- * Developer\-facing products, protocol or gateway work, or infrastructure at scale. * Background in security, identity, or permission systems. * Contributions to open source, MCP servers, or agentic frameworks. * Design sensibility: engineers who care about design, designers who think about infrastructure. **What we offer:** ------------------ * Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. * Unusual scope and ownership of features that ship to enterprise customers. * Building and deploying agents on the same platform we sell. * Direct access to the founders, customer context, and product direction, with mentorship as you grow. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.title: Staff/Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **About SirenOpt** SirenOpt helps manufacturers make better, safer, and more reliable micro\- and nano\-materials. These materials are the building blocks of critical sectors of the global economy such as batteries, computer chips, aircraft components, and power systems. But, surging material demand and growing complexity are pushing production to unprecedented scales and speeds, leaving manufacturers effectively flying blind. Small, undetected variations during production lead to wastage, lower performance, higher costs, and safety risks. SirenOpt is changing this by developing a manufacturing intelligence platform that non\-destructively probes materials during production, revealing critical internal information without damaging them. Using a novel combination of cold atmospheric plasma, physics\-informed machine learning, and predictive analytics, SirenOpt generates unique, real\-time material fingerprints that capture material signals not accessible through conventional measurement techniques. These insights give manufacturers unprecedented visibility into how materials behave as they are made. We turn hidden data into actionable intelligence to help manufacturers reduce variability and thus increase yield and performance. The technology can be deployed as a standalone tool or integrated directly into factory production lines. SirenOpt is currently deploying early versions of its platform with some of the largest industrial manufacturers in the world across North America, Europe, and Asia. **About the job** **Job Title:** Staff/Senior Mechanical Engineer **Location:** On\-Site (San Leandro, CA) **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Role Overview** SirenOpt is seeking a **Staff or Senior Mechanical Engineer** to help us deliver a sensing and software platform that can be integrated inside high\-volume thin film manufacturing lines. As an early\-stage member of the SirenOpt team, you will be able to make a real impact on next\-generation thin film technologies and help build a solid technical foundation upon which a small company can grow. The ideal candidate will learn new concepts quickly and take pride in the quality of their work. We expect that you will be able to apply sound engineering judgment to solve a wide range of technical challenges efficiently and creatively. Some ofthese problems may lie outside your core areas of expertise, so technical curiosity and a self\-starting attitude are critical for success. This role offers an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of technological innovation, working with cutting\-edge systems in a collaborative and dynamic environment. If you are a driven and skilled engineer looking to make a significant impact in advanced manufacturing and the green energy transition, we encourage you to apply. **What You'll Do** * Lead the mechanical design and validation of a low\-temperature plasma\-based metrology sensor platform. * Interface with a small, cross\-functional project team to research, develop, and validate new concepts for low\-temperature plasma\-based metrology. * Perform fundamental studies to characterize and understand the sensitivity of the sensor and platform performance. * Closely interact with clients to iterate on the design based on their feedback, paying close attention to integration speed. * Create and maintain technical design documentation (e.g. requirements, 3D and 2D data, assembly documentation, test processes and test reports). **What We're Looking For** * B.S./M.S. in Mechanical Engineering with minimum of 4 years of relevant industry experience. * Experience autonomously leading independent mechanical design projects, in particular those that involve designing a product that can be integrated into a larger system. * Experience with design of motion control mechanisms. Ability to properly constrain parts, define datums run through tolerance analysis. Use of GD\&T to control those tolerances in drawings. Setting requirements and selection of motors, couplers, stages, gearboxes. * Programing of motion controllers is a plus. * Static and dynamic stress and strain analysis including vibration testing and analysis. * Some familiarity with part quality and measurement setup for CMM or OMM inspection. * Experience with hands\-on development of prototypes. * Experience with initiating and maintaining supplier support. * Experience with maintaining awareness of customer needs and iterating on designs accordingly. * Experience with mechanical design for manufacturing lines. * Familiarity with standards requirements for high\-voltage/low\-voltage or gas distribution devices is a plus. * Experience with performing sensitivity and risk analysis and using the results of those analyses to inform future mechanical designs e.g., quantifying a prototype's sensitivity to certain environmental disturbances and creating a mechanical design that mitigates the effects of those disturbances. * Prior exposure to high\-precision, high\-throughput industrial designs for material handling, metrology, and/or process automation applications are a plus. * Experience taking designs from initial concept development to product launch. Design for reliability, manufacturing, and service (DfX) are a plus. * Proficiency with use of CAD and PDM tools (e.g., SolidWorks or OnShape) to design parts and assemblies and prepare technical documentation. * Ability to independently identify and procure parts, manage supplier relationships, and rapidly fabricate medium\-fidelity prototypes using 3D printers, metal stock, optical breadboards, etc. is preferred. * Demonstrated the ability to adapt to new technical challenges and excited to work in a dynamic multi\-disciplinary environment. * Excellent written, verbal and visual communication skills. * Ability to rapidly create and iterate upon prototypes based on client and team feedback. **Nice to have:** * Experience with metrology equipment and sensors, particularly those used for metrology of advanced materials. * Some familiarity with thin films, in particular any those related to Lithium\- and Zinc\-based battery electrodes, Thermal Barrier Coatings for turbine blades, photovoltaics, optical coatings, displays, packaging materials, semiconducting wafers, and/or adhesives. **Benefits** * Equity and Salary compensation depends on experience * Health, Dental, Vision plans provided * 401k matching provided * Time off: 20 days of PTO per year, plus approximately 15 paid US holidays per year

On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work. From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved. You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer. You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers. **About you** ------------- * You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job. * You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role. * You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum. * You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations. * You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew. * You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one. * You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy. * You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them. * You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team. **Bonus** --------- * AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background. * You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers. * Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship. * Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive base, variable, and significant equity. * Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership. * Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions. * Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.description: **Posting Title** ================= Undergraduate / Graduate (Spring / Summer) Intern \- Cyber Security Research – 5G . **Location** ============ CO \- Golden . **Position Type** ================= Intern (Fixed Term) . **Hours Per Week** ================== 40 . **Working at NLR** ================== NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development. Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world\-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost\-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth. At NLR, you'll find a mission\-driven environment supported by state\-of\-the\-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well\-being. **Job Description** =================== The National Laboratory of the Rockies’ (NLR) cybersecurity research is strengthening our grid against tomorrow's threats. The selected intern would join the Cyber Mission Assurance team to support research efforts within the Cybersecurity Research Center’s portfolio including: * Characterization of the potential for U.S. electric grid disruption from natural hazards and human threats * Assessment of the cybersecurity of distributed energy systems Strengthening the resilience of the U.S. electric grid * The Cyber Mission Assurance team is looking for talented Software or AI Engineering interns to help build intelligent, data\-driven applications for 5G and emerging 6G networks. This internship focuses on developing RIC rApps, xApps, and dApps, along with NWDAF\-based analytics, enabling closed\-loop automation and AI\-powered optimization across the RAN and core network. Interns will work on cloud\-native, microservice\-based systems that apply machine learning and advanced analytics to real network data, contributing to next\-generation autonomous networks. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and implement **RIC applications** : + **rApps** (non\-real\-time optimization and policy\-driven automation) + **xApps** (near\-real\-time RAN control and optimization) + **dApps** (distributed and domain\-specific intelligent network functions) * Develop and enhance **NWDAF analytics functions** for performance monitoring, prediction, anomaly detection, and optimization * Build **AI/ML models** for network intelligence (forecasting, classification, reinforcement learning, root\-cause analysis) * Implement **closed\-loop automation workflows** using AI insights and RIC control interfaces * Develop **cloud\-native microservices** using containers and Kubernetes * Integrate with **O\-RAN and 3GPP interfaces** (A1, E2, O1, service\-based APIs) * Process and analyze **large\-scale, time\-series and streaming network data** * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on design, testing, and validation Document software designs, experiments, and technical results * **What you will learn:** * End\-to\-end development of **RIC rApps, xApps, and dApps** in 5G/6G systems * Practical implementation of **NWDAF\-based analytics and AI pipelines** * Applying **AI/ML to closed\-loop network automation** * Building **telecom\-grade, scalable cloud\-native software** * Insights into **6G intelligence, autonomous networks, and standardization trends** . **Basic Qualifications** ======================== "Minimum of a 3\.0 cumulative grade point average. Undergraduate: Must be enrolled as a full\-time student in a bachelor’s degree program from an accredited institution. Post Undergraduate: Earned a bachelor’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year. Graduate: Must be enrolled as a full\-time student in a master’s degree program from an accredited institution. Post Graduate: Earned a master’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year. Graduate \+ PhD: Completed master’s degree and enrolled as PhD student from an accredited institution. Please Note: * Applicants are responsible for uploading official or unofficial school transcripts, as part of the application process. * If selected for position, a letter of recommendation will be required as part of the hiring process. * Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date." **\* Must meet educational requirements prior to employm afana, time\-series databases) **Preferred Qualifications** ============================ * Knowledge of 5G architecture, O\-RAN, RIC, or 3GPP NWDAF concepts * Experience with machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit\-learn) * Experience with cloud\-native technologies i.e. docker * Exposure to reinforcement learning, graph analytics, or network optimization * Prior experience with telecom data, simulations, or digital twin . **Job Application Submission Window** ===================================== The anticipated closing window for application submission is up to 30 days and may be extended as needed. **Annual Salary Range (based on full\-time 40 hours per week)** =============================================================== Job Profile: Post Graduate / Annual Salary Range: $57,900 \- $95,500 NLR takes into consideration a candidate’s education, training, and experience, expected quality and quantity of work, required travel (if any), external market and internal value, including seniority and merit systems, and internal pay alignment when determining the salary level for potential new employees. In compliance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act, a potential new employee’s salary history will not be used in compensation decisions. **Benefits Summary** ==================== Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; 403(b) Employee Savings Plan with employer match\*; and sick leave (where required by law). NLR employees may be eligible for, but are not guaranteed, performance\-, merit\-, and achievement\- based awards that include a monetary component. Some positions may be eligible for relocation expense reimbursement. Internships projected to be less than 20 hours per week are not eligible for medical, dental, or vision benefits. **\*** Based on eligibility rules **Badging Requirement** ======================= NLR is subject to Department of Energy (DOE) access restrictions. All employees must also be able to obtain and maintain a federal Personal Identity Verification (PIV) card as required by Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD\-12\), which includes a favorable background investigation. Intern assignments extending beyond six months will be subject to this requirement. **Drug Free Workplace** ======================= NLR is committed to maintaining a drug\-free workplace in accordance with the federal Drug\-Free Workplace Act and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug. If you are offered employment at NLR, you must pass a pre\-employment drug test prior to commencing employment. Unless prohibited by state or local law, the pre\-employment drug test will include marijuana. If you test positive on the pre\-employment drug test, your offer of employment may be withdrawn. **Submission Guidelines** ========================= Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at NLR you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified. Applications are not kept on file for future positions. Please include a cover letter and resume with each position application. . **Equal Opportunity Employer** ============================== All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, domestic partner status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws. **Reasonable Accommodations** **E** **\-Verify** **www.dhs.gov/E\-Verify** For information about right to work E\-Verify is a registered trademark of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security. jobs.title: Vibe Coder & Automation Wizard - Founding Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Your first thought when you see a repetitive task is, “I could automate that.” You build things just to see if they’ll work. And when an AI agent finally does exactly what you wanted? That’s a good day. We should talk. **A Day Back (adayback.ai)** helps service businesses get their time back through AI agents and automation. We’re hiring a **Founding Engineer / Junior AI Developer** to connect software, build useful agents, and turn everyday business headaches into tasks that practically handle themselves. We’re looking for an **obsessed vibe coder**. Someone who is constantly experimenting, learning new tools, and turning ideas into working solutions. You might be early in your career, but you’re already building things and have the coding foundation to understand, debug, and improve what AI produces. As our first technical hire, you’ll work directly with founder Matthew Poll. You’ll help build our company, work with clients, and see your projects make a difference in real businesses. **Location:** South Jordan / Salt Lake City, Utah. Local, on\-site work and in\-person client visits required. **Job type:** Full\-time. Available to start ASAP. **Salary:** $60,000–$100,000 per year, based on skills and experience. **Equity:** Potential opportunity after demonstrating strong performance and contribution. **Duties** * Build, configure, and improve AI agents that take repetitive work off people’s plates. * Connect client software, CRMs, and business tools through APIs and automation. * Attend in\-person client setups, typically around two hours for the initial appointment. * Talk with business owners and their teams to figure out where time gets wasted and what we can automate. * Get deep into our CRM and internal tools, then make them work better. * Troubleshoot problems, test your solutions, and make sure they keep working after the demo. * Explain what you’ve built in plain English and help clients feel comfortable using it. * Shadow client training sessions and webinars, then grow into leading them. * Help shape and build our long\-term product. * Document your work and handle client data, credentials, and access responsibly. **Skills** * Hands\-on experience building with AI coding tools and experimenting with AI agents. Experience with Grok Bot, Claw, OpenClaw, or similar tools is a plus. * A coding foundation that helps you read, troubleshoot, and improve AI\-generated code. * Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and workflow automation, plus the curiosity to learn unfamiliar systems. * Strong problem\-solving skills. When something breaks, you investigate, ask good questions, and work toward a fix. * Clear communication and confidence talking with clients on the phone, on video, and in person. * Creativity, initiative, and follow\-through. You can take an idea, build it, test it, and finish it. * Comfort with startup life: priorities evolve, you’ll wear several hats, and your ideas will matter. * Availability for full\-time, on\-site work in the South Jordan / Salt Lake City area. Personal projects count. Useful experiments count. That automation you built because doing something manually annoyed you? We want to hear about it. **Apply with your resume and a quick note about what you’ve built, which AI tools you use, and why this role sounds like your kind of work.** Include a project link or demo if you have one. Let’s give people their day back. Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Experience: * Vibe Coding: 1 year (Preferred) * Coding: 1 year (Required) Language: * English (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.description: At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. **This position reports to:** Electrical Engineering Manager \_\_ **Your role and responsibilities** ABB is seeking a **Senior Lead Project Engineer** to join our team. In this role, you will provide technical leadership and oversee the successful execution of multidisciplinary electrical engineering projects from concept through commissioning. As the Lead Electrical Engineer on assigned projects, you will coordinate engineering activities across multiple disciplines, ensure technical excellence, manage engineering scope and deliverables, and serve as the primary technical interface for customers, project managers, and internal stakeholders. The work model for the role is: Hybrid \#LI\-Hybrid This role is contributing to the Automation Energy Industries division in either Houston, TX or Calgary, Alberta, Canada. **You will be mainly accountable for:** * Lead and support engineering projects, ensuring successful delivery through effective technical leadership, coordination, and adherence to project scope, schedule, and quality expectations. * Develop, review, and approve electrical engineering deliverables, ensuring compliance with project requirements, applicable codes, industry standards, and ABB engineering practices. * Lead customer technical meetings, design reviews, and interdisciplinary engineering coordination meetings. * Manage engineering scope, technical risks, engineering schedules, and change management activities in collaboration with Project Management. * Support factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities as required. * Coordinate and provide technical oversight of multi\-discipline vendors and subcontractors, ensuring alignment with project requirements, engineering standards, schedules, and overall project objectives. * Support proposal development, engineering estimates, technical risk assessments, and engineering execution planning. Additional tasks with varying scope depending on experience level: * Perform and review power system studies (e.g., short circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, load flow) to support protection design and validate system performance. * Create and review substation and electrical building integration design packages and follow those projects from the conceptual stage to construction completion. * Develop and review protection and control system designs, including relay selection, protection philosophies, settings development, configuration, and coordination. * Design/review/implementation of power management systems (PMS). *Our team dynamics* Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there. **Qualifications for the role:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university. * 5 or more years of experience in electrical engineering, with demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary engineering projects. * Extensive experience in at least two of the following technical areas: + Power system studies and associated software (ETAP, SKM, PSCAD, EasyPower) + Substation and electrical building design. + Protection and control system design, including relay applications, settings, and integration. + Industrial automation systems, including power management systems (PMS), SCADA, or distributed control systems (DCS). * Strong understanding of relevant industry standards and codes (IEEE, NFPA, NEC, ANSI, IEC, or equivalent as applicable). * Demonstrated experience serving as the Lead Electrical Engineer or Engineering Lead on complex engineering projects. * Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams and coordinate technical execution across multiple concurrent projects. * Excellent technical problem\-solving, communication, and documentation skills. * Ability to mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance within the team. * Professional Engineering designation (PE) preferred. What's in it for you? Working at ABB offers a unique opportunity to gain hands\-on experience across the full spectrum of power system engineering. Our group actively engages in substation design, protection and controls engineering, power system studies, and the design and implementation of power management systems. Being part of this team allows engineers to collaborate across multiple disciplines, contribute to complex and impactful projects, and develop a well\-rounded understanding of modern power infrastructure up to 69kV. jobs.title: Architecture and Systems Design Analyst
jobs.description: Custom Solutions is the ABM IT team responsible for building and maintaining bespoke .NET business applications, both on\-prem and in Azure. Core team focus is Team Connect — ABM’s mobile\-first workforce platform (time \& attendance, scheduling, and an admin portal) — plus internal workflow/process\-automation tools and custom REST APIs. Users span internal business units (Finance, HR, Facilities, Operations), a large distributed hourly mobile workforce, and downstream automated systems. Business criticality ranges from business\-critical financial/HR\-adjacent integrations to lower\-criticality internal productivity tools. We’re looking for a Full Stack .NET Developer to design/build new applications in Azure or on\-prem and maintain applications across our portfolio — from ASP.NET Core Web APIs and Azure Functions to .NET MAUI mobile, Blazor, Angular, or React front ends. You’ll work within an audited, AI\-augmented SDLC: approved AI coding assistants integrated into daily development, an automated AI code\-review engine gating every pull request, and AI\-specific quality gates built into the team’s Definition of Done. You will collaborate closely with other CS team members, business and product owners, and the QA team to help ship secure, well\-tested software through a structured, security\-conscious SDLC. **Key Responsibilities** **Development** * Design and implement features following Domain\-Driven Layered Architecture principles, with strict separation of Presentation, Application, Domain, and Infrastructure layers * Build ASP.NET Core Web APIs, Azure Functions (isolated worker model), Blazor web applications, .NET MAUI mobile apps, and/or React or Angular front ends (TypeScript strict mode required — no JavaScript\-only work) * Design and maintain offline\-first mobile functionality in .NET MAUI — local SQLite snapshot storage, background sync queue processing, and conflict resolution for data captured while disconnected * Apply the Repository pattern for all data access, Dependency Injection (Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection), MediatR CQRS handlers, and FluentValidation on API request DTOs * Work with Entity Framework Core against SQL Server and Azure Cosmos DB, including partition\-key design, change\-feed processors, and RU/s budget management, using parameterized queries * Integrate with Azure Key Vault for secrets management and Azure App Configuration for environment\-labeled settings and feature flags (DEV/SIT/UAT/PROD) * Author and troubleshoot Azure API Management policies for API gateway and backend system integrations * Contribute to observability: Application Insights custom telemetry/KQL queries, Azure Monitor alerting, and the Bicep templates that provision them **Code Quality \& Review** * + Submit pull requests with mandatory peer/Lead Developer review before merge * + Maintain minimum 70% unit test coverage on new code (xUnit or MSTest, Coverlet) * + Write and maintain integration tests against Dev/Staging environments * + Resolve findings from automated security scans (Snyk SAST on every PR) and DAST scans (OWASP ZAP/StackHawk) before release * + Follow Microsoft C\# coding conventions and team style guide, enforced via .editorconfig and Roslyn analyzers * + Enforce SOLID principles and Domain\-Driven Layered Architecture boundaries during code review **Process \& Collaboration** * + Work from Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) authored by Business Analysts and contribute to Functional Technology Approach (FTA) documents for significant features, new API endpoints, or infrastructure changes * + Participate in STRIDE threat modeling and PII impact assessments for features that expose new endpoints, integrate external systems, or handle personal data * + Decompose accepted requirements into Azure DevOps user stories and work within the team’s Git branching strategy (feature/, hotfix/, protected main and develop branches) * + Support release readiness: CI pipeline checks (build, test, SAST), QA/UAT sign\-off, and documentation needed for CAB/RFC change approval * + Collaborate with QA Engineers, Business Analysts, and Cloud Operations/InfoSec throughout the development lifecycle **Security \& Compliance** * + Follow segregation\-of\-duties requirements — developers implement and submit for review but do not promote their own code to production * + Ensure no production data is used in non\-production environments (synthetic or masked data only) * + Handle PII and confidential data in accordance with the team’s data classification standards (encryption at rest/in transit, masking in non\-prod) * + Use only Security\-team\-approved AI tools, and never submit secrets, PII, or proprietary business logic to any AI tool prompt **Required Qualifications** * + Professional experience building applications in C\# / .NET (.NET 8\+ preferred) * + Hands\-on experience with ASP.NET Core Web API and Entity Framework Core * + Experience with at least one modern front\-end approach: .  frameworks (xUnit or MSTest) and writing testable code * + Understanding of secure coding practices — input validation, parameterized queries, secrets management **Preferred / Nice to Have** * + Experience with Azure services: App Services, Functions, Cosmos DB, Key Vault, Service Bus, App Configuration * + Experience with Azure API Management (policy authoring, backend integration troubleshooting) * + Experience with Azure Monitor / Application Insights (KQL, alerting) and Bicep/ARM infrastructure as code * + Familiarity with Power Automate, Logic Apps, or Microsoft Graph API for workflow automation * + Experience with .NET MAUI or other cross\-platform mobile frameworks, including offline\-first/sync architectures * + Experience with Azure DevOps (Git, CI/CD pipelines, Test Plans) or TFS * + Experience with MediatR/CQRS and FluentValidation * + Familiarity with SAST/DAST tooling (Snyk, OWASP ZAP) and remediating findings * + Comfortable working alongside AI\-assisted development tooling (AI code review gates, AI pair\-programming) within an audited SDLC * + Exposure to regulated or compliance\-driven SDLC environments (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PII handling) **What Success Looks Like** * + Code passes peer review, SAST scanning, and required test coverage on the first or second pass * + Features are delivered against FRD/FTA specifications with minimal rework * + Security and data\-handling requirements (PII classification, masking, secrets management) are built in from the start, not bolted on * + Strong working relationships with QA, BA, and Cloud Operations/InfoSec throughout the delivery cycle **Benefit Information:** ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM 2026 Employee Benefits \| Staff \& Management ABM (NYSE: ABM) is one of the world’s largest providers of integrated facility, engineering, and infrastructure solutions. Every day, our over 100,000 team members deliver essential services that make spaces cleaner, safer, and efficient, enhancing the overall occupant experience. ABM serves a wide range of market sectors including commercial real estate, aviation, education, mission critical, and manufacturing and distribution. With over $8 billion in annual revenue and a blue\-chip client base, ABM delivers innovative technologies and sustainable solutions that enhance facilities and empower clients to achieve their goals. Committed to creating smarter, more connected spaces, ABM is investing in the future to meet evolving challenges and build a healthier, thriving world. ABM: Driving possibility, together. ABM is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any trait or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, including disability and protected veteran status. ABM is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need assistance in completing the employment application, please call 888\-328\-8606\. We will provide you with assistance and make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case\-by\-case basis. ABM participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E\-Verify program. E\-Verify is an internet\-based system used to electronically confirm employment eligibility. ABM is a military\-friendly company proudly employing thousands of men and women who have served in the U.S. military.
