turning ambiguous requirements from prospects, partners, and AEs into concrete, working implementation plans. * Build working integrations against third\-party APIs, CRMs, field service management (FSM) platforms, telephony systems, and partner ecosystems, writing real code, handling REST APIs, JSON, authentication, and webhooks, and getting a credible proof of concept working quickly. * Build and maintain the demo and sandbox tooling the GTM org relies on: reusable demo environments, representative fixture data, and internal tools, treating one\-off deal builds as reusable assets (integration patterns, reference implementations, scripts) rather than throwaway work. * Configure and tune Avoca's conversational AI for demo and POC scenarios, including prompt engineering to reflect real customer workflows. * Serve as the technical counterpart to Account Executives and Partnerships in the room with a prospect's or partner's engineering team, establishing credibility from the C\-suite to individual developers, and translating those conversations into plans a non\-technical AE can run with. * Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues that surface during evaluations, pilots, and POCs, protecting at\-risk deals and partner launches. * Partner with Product and Engineering to feed recurring integration gaps and field learnings back into the roadmap, and to keep demo environments current as the product evolves. * Partner with (not replace) Forward Deployed Engineering and Implementation when a build needs to graduate from a working POC to a hardened production deployment: you own the pre\-sales build and the demo layer; production delivery is a handoff. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 4\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing role: Solutions/Sales Engineering, Forward Deployed / Deployment Engineering, Implementation or Integration Engineering, Solutions Consulting, or software engineering with meaningful customer exposure. * **Hands\-on ability to build.** Proficient in TypeScript/JavaScript (Next.js, React, Node/Fastify); ships production\-grade code and independently stand up an integration or demo tool, not just spec one for someone else to build. You don't need to be a production backend engineer, but "can build it yourself" is the bar. * Practical experience integrating against third\-party APIs and enterprise systems: REST, JSON, authentication/OAuth, webhooks, and comfort working from unfamiliar or incomplete API documentation. * Working SQL and a solid grasp of relational data: enough to model, transform, and wire up realistic data for integrations and demo environments. * Experience owning something technical end\-to\-end, from requirements through build, testing, and a working rollout, even if handed off afterward. * Strong technical judgment and troubleshooting instincts, and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * A product mindset toward internal tooling: you treat demo and sandbox infrastructure as a product with users (the GTM team). * Familiarity with AI\-powered products, conversational AI platforms, or data\-driven systems. Bonus: prompt engineering, call center / communications platforms, CRM or FSM integrations, or prior Partnerships/channel support experience. **Who You Are** --------------- * Self\-motivated, entrepreneurial, and comfortable operating in fast\-moving, high\-growth environments. * A builder who thrives on owning things end\-to\-end and turning one\-off work into something reusable. * Autonomous, self\-directed, and comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete requirements. * A proactive, effective communicator who's equally credible with a customer's engineers and your own AEs. * In\-office, engaged, and eager to collaborate at our NYC location full\-time. **Benefits** ------------ * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance * Company\-sponsored 401(k) through Vestwell * Flexible PTO plus U.S. federal holidays * Company\-wide off\-sites * Daily in\-office lunch through Parkday * Monthly wellness stipend * Dinner covered when working late * Commuter benefits and late\-night rideshare * Standing desks and workspace accommodations available on request * All core tools and software provided **Compensation:** The expected base salary for this role is $160,000\-$200,000 with final compensation based on experience, skills, and qualifications determined during the interview process. Avoca’s total compensation package includes base salary, bonus, equity, and a comprehensive suite of benefits and perks. Our Recruiting team will share the full details as you progress through our hiring process. **Why Avoca** ============= At Avoca, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category\-defining company at the center of a massive market opportunity. We’re a fast\-moving, collaborative team with a culture designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and impact. *Avoca provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability.* Compensation Range: $160K \- $200K

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: Position Overview The Solutions Engineer is a rare, high\-impact role for technologists who are equally energized by solving hard business problems and building the systems that fix them. Sitting within Bridgeway’s Advanced Technologies team, this individual goes deep with our operational business units to understand real, complex challenges, then comes back and builds the solutions from the ground up. This isn’t a ticket\-taking developer role or a requirements\-gathering analyst role; it’s a full\-ownership position that spans the entire solution lifecycle. You’ll design architectures, write production code, and ship working software directly into operations. AI\-assisted development (including Claude Code) is a first\-class tool here, not an afterthought, and this role sits at the center of Bridgeway’s broader AI transformation strategy. Key Responsibilities Business Engagement \& Requirements * Embed directly with operations, finance, billing, collections, and other business units to uncover inefficiencies, automation opportunities, and high\-value technology gaps * Run structured discovery to extract, document, and sharpen requirements, separating signal from noise and turning ambiguous asks into buildable specs * Convert messy, real\-world business problems into precise solution briefs: tightly scoped, measurable, and ready to build against * Challenge assumptions and probe for root causes rather than accepting surface\-level problem statements Solution Design * Architect end\-to\-end solutions spanning process, data pipelines, system integrations, and application layers, always choosing the right tool for the job rather than the familiar one * Produce clean solution architecture documentation: data flows, API contracts, system interaction diagrams, and technical specs that others can build on * Define and document KPIs and success metrics for every solution; establish baseline measurements and post\-deployment tracking plans * Support process and organizational design work when solutions require workflow redesign or role realignment Development \& Delivery * Write production\-ready code for internal tools, intelligent automations, system integrations, and AI\-powered workflows, with a high bar for quality and maintainability * Use Claude Code and AI\-assisted development as a force multiplier: shipping faster, thinking bigger, and continuously raising what’s possible for a team your size * Design and build integrations between core operational and enterprise platforms, billing systems, and external APIs, creating connected systems that eliminate manual handoffs * Conduct unit testing, user acceptance testing coordination, and quality validation prior to deployment * Manage deployment activities, post\-launch monitoring, and iterative improvements Stakeholder Communication \& Collaboration * Maintain clear, proactive communication with business sponsors throughout the project lifecycle * Prepare solution documentation, user guides, and training materials as needed * Present solution designs and status updates to leadership in plain business language, not technical jargon * Work collaboratively within an agile/product\-owner model, prioritizing, iterating, and shipping incrementally AI \& Continuous Improvement * Identify and build AI\-powered capabilities into solutions, spanning classification and prediction models, generative AI workflows, and autonomous agentic processes * Stay on the cutting edge of AI tooling, LLM capabilities, agentic frameworks, and developer toolchains, and actively bring what you learn back into Bridgeway’s stack * Contribute to the company\-wide AI adoption program through knowledge sharing, documentation, and peer enablement Qualifications Required * 3–7 years of experience in a solutions engineering, business systems, or software development role * Demonstrated ability to independently gather requirements, design solutions, and deliver working software without heavy supervision * Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python strongly preferred; JavaScript, SQL also valued) * Strong analytical skills with experience defining KPIs, building data models, and interpreting operational data * Excellent communication skills, equally comfortable presenting to a VP or pairing with a frontline operator * Familiarity with API integration patterns (REST), relational databases, and data pipeline concepts * Experience working in or with agile / product\-oriented delivery teams Preferred * Active hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools: Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar; comfort with LLM APIs and prompt engineering is a strong plus * Familiarity with RPA tooling (Power Automate, UiPath) and/or workflow automation platforms * Experience with process mapping methodologies (L1–L3 process documentation) * Background in or exposure to organizational design and change management What Success Looks Like In the first 90 days, the Solutions Engineer will have completed at least one full solution cycle, from stakeholder discovery through deployment, and will have established productive working relationships across the business units they support. At 6 months, they will be operating as a trusted partner to multiple departments, managing a pipeline of active solutions, and demonstrating measurable operational impact through the work they’ve shipped. At 12 months, they will be recognized internally as a subject\-matter expert on how Bridgeway builds technology solutions, and will be actively advancing the company’s AI adoption roadmap through their delivery work. Core Competencies Business Acumen Understands freight brokerage operations and connects technology to business outcomes Technical Depth Can design and build solutions end\-to\-end, not just document requirements or review others’ code Communication Translates complexity clearly, speaking both business and technical fluently Ownership Mindset Drives solutions from idea to impact without waiting to be directed; holds themselves accountable for outcomes Structured Problem\-Solving Breaks complex problems into solvable components; designs before building AI Curiosity Proactively incorporates AI tools into workflow; comfortable experimenting with emerging capabilities About Bridgeway Bridgeway is a freight brokerage company in the middle of a genuine technology transformation, and not one that’s been announced and forgotten. It is actively reshaping how we operate. Our Advanced Technologies team is building the AI tools, intelligent automations, and connected systems that will define how Bridgeway competes over the next decade. If you want to do consequential technical work with real operational impact, in an environment that takes AI seriously and gives you the autonomy to build things that matter, this is that role.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Software Engineering
jobs.description: About BetaNXT: BetaNXT is a leading provider of frictionless wealth management infrastructure, real\-time data solutions, and an enhanced advisor experience. We invest in platforms, products, and partnerships to accelerate growth for the ecosystem we serve. Our connective approach empowers our clients to deliver a comprehensive, end\-to\-end advisor and investor experience. BetaNXT is a premier provider of technology, data, and operations as services to a rich client base of wealth managers, institutional wealth firms, and digital brokers. It is comprised of three industry\-leading businesses which, combined, provide end\-to\-end solutions across the investment lifecycle. Career Framework Job Description: Provides technical guidance, making architectural decisions, and contributing to the overall strategy of software development projects. Provides technical leadership within the development team through writing, testing and debugging complex and critical code for software solutions. Leads the development of major features or components. Leads the design and architecture of software systems, making strategic decisions to ensure scalability, flexibility, and maintainability. Takes ownership of critical features or modules within projects, driving their development from conception to implementation. Collaborates with product managers to define and refine requirements. Conducts and leads code reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards and best practices. Sets and enforces high code quality standards within the team. Contributes to project planning, estimation, and execution, collaborating with project managers and other leads. Acts as a technical lead on projects, ensuring successful delivery. Analyzes and solves complex and critical programming problems. Provides expertise in troubleshooting and resolving issues in the software. Oversees and contribute to detailed technical documentation for code, architecture, and system design. Actively contributes to process improvements, optimizing development workflows, and suggesting tools or methodologies that enhance efficiency. Implements best practices in the development process. Communicates effectively within the development team and with stakeholders. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment. Stays abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends to lead innovation within the development team. May function as a Team Lead with no direct reports, providing guidance to less experienced colleagues, with some people supervision. Allocates work and monitors the quality of work for others. Takes the lead to implement process improvements based on analysis. Accountable for multiple processes or programs. Generally covers mid\- to large\-sized or moderately complex clients and/or projects. Influences timelines, expectations, and proactively negotiates across departments and sometimes functional management. Bachelor's degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required. Often a minimum of 8 to 12 years of relevant experience with the necessary competencies. **Overview of the Senior Specialist, Software Engineering:** The Senior Specialist, Software Engineering leads technical delivery of cost basis management solutions within a fast\-paced Fintech environment. Operating as both a hands\-on individual contributor and informal team lead, drives architecture decisions, mentors peers and partners with cross\-functional teams to build reliable, scalable platform capabilities. They bring deep domain expertise, a cloud\-native mindset and a passion for AI\-augmented engineering. **Duties and Responsibilities of the Senior Specialist, Software Engineering:** * Identify and resolve complex operational, regulatory, and organizational challenges by leveraging deep cost basis domain expertise and hands\-on engineering skills. * Design, develop, and implement methodologies, protocols, and processes that enhance platform reliability and improve client experience. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps tooling (Git CI/CD pipeline, Jenkins) to ensure fast, reliable automated builds, testing, and deployments. * Operationalize cost basis strategies through clean, maintainable code and well\-documented engineering standards shared across the team. * Coordinate with engineering peers, product managers, and operations to ensure timely and accurate delivery of cost basis calculation and tax reporting features. * Ensure all activities comply with applicable regulatory standards; proactively contribute to technical frameworks that support ongoing compliance. * Provide technical mentorship and code review guidance to junior and mid\-level engineers; deliver actionable, growth\-oriented feedback. * Resolve complex cost basis calculation challenges, including corporate action adjustments, transfer‑in basis reconciliation, and multi‑lot accounting edge cases. * Contribute to long\-term technical roadmap planning, capability development, and engineering best practices. * Collaborate cross‑functionally with product, operations, and engineering teams to ensure alignment and effective delivery. * Integrate AI/ML capabilities (e.g., anomaly detection, intelligent reconciliation, LLM\-assisted workflows) to improve platform automation and reduce manual intervention in tax operations. **Skills and Experience of the Senior Specialist, Software Engineering:** * 10\+ years of relevant experience, including at least 3\-5 years in cost basis, tax operations within a financial services or Fintech organization. * Strong domain knowledge of cost basis methodologies and tax lot accounting. * Exposure to tax reporting domains, including familiarity with IRS systems and knowledge of various tax reporting formats and regulatory reporting requirements, is highly desirable. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required. * Proven analytical and problem‑solving abilities with a track record of resolving complex operational and system‑level issues. * Hands\-on experience leading and coordinating cross\-functional technical initiatives involving engineering, operations, and compliance. * Cloud expertise: proficiency in at least one major cloud platform (AWS, OCI, Azure, or GCP), including infrastructure\-as\-code, cloud\-native services, and cost\-efficient architecture patterns. * AI/ML integration: experience leveraging AI tools, LLM APIs, or ML pipelines to augment engineering workflows, automate operations, or enhance platform intelligence. * CI/CD proficiency: experience designing and maintaining automated pipelines (build, test, deploy) with modern DevOps tooling and GitOps practices. * Expert\-level proficiency in Oracle databases, including advanced PL/SQL development for complex queries, stored procedures, and performance optimization. * Hands\-on experience with Unix/Linux shell scripting to automate operational tasks, data processing workflows, and system maintenance. * Strong Java development skills, with the ability to design, develop, and troubleshoot distributed backend services and integrations. * Strong experience with Spring Boot and a deep background in Spring Batch for building scalable microservices, automated batch workflows, and high\-volume financial data processing solutions. * Proficient in Git for version control, including branching strategies, pull request workflows, and code review best practices. * Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex technical or regulatory concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders. * Background in driving operational execution, meeting daily and short‑term objectives while supporting long‑term departmental goals.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio. Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself. The Role BeyondTrust is building a new cross\-product Site Reliability Engineering team that stands up and runs the AWS GovCloud environments bringing additional BeyondTrust products into our FedRAMP authorization. The team owns the reliability, change control, and continuous\-compliance machinery for those environments so that product feature teams can stay focused on product delivery. This is an engineering team that owns operations, not an operations team. Its product is automation; operations is the input. Every manual procedure performed twice is a candidate for elimination, and the team's success is measured by the operational work it has made unnecessary, not the tickets it has closed. Hands\-on operational work is capped at roughly half of team capacity; the rest goes to engineering the work away. Our workloads are not purely cloud\-native. The estates include appliance\-model and single\-tenant VM fleets at scale alongside shared services, so fleet upgrade orchestration, golden images, and staged rollouts are core work, not edge cases. What You'll Do * Build and operate AWS GovCloud environments: multi\-account structure, guardrails, logging and security tooling, IaC\-native provisioning (Terraform) * Build and run release and update machinery for cloud fleets: mandatory security updates, staged and jittered rollout windows, coordinated installs, and verification that a patch actually landed everywhere it was scoped to * Build the continuous\-compliance evidence pipeline: collection, normalization, and reporting of FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators, where evidence is machine\-readable, re\-verified every few days, and reported monthly * Instrument production: telemetry, SLOs, dashboards, and alerting that the team and product engineering actually own and act on * Consolidate CI/CD: shared pipelines for build, signing, artifact management, quality gates, and security scanning instead of per\-team reinvention * Participate in on\-call for the GovCloud estate, with the explicit expectation that recurring incident causes get engineered away What You'll Bring * Build and operate AWS GovCloud environments: multi\-account structure, guardrails, logging and security tooling, IaC\-native provisioning (Terraform) * Build and run release and update machinery for cloud fleets: mandatory security updates, staged and jittered rollout windows, coordinated installs, and verification that a patch actually landed everywhere it was scoped to * Build the continuous\-compliance evidence pipeline: collection, normalization, and reporting of FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators, where evidence is machine\-readable, re\-verified every few days, and reported monthly * Instrument production: telemetry, SLOs, dashboards, and alerting that the team and product engineering actually own and act on * Consolidate CI/CD: shared pipelines for build, signing, artifact management, quality gates, and security scanning instead of per\-team reinvention * Built or operated inside a FedRAMP Moderate or High boundary (or IL4/IL5, StateRAMP equivalent): continuous monitoring, POA\&M lifecycle, patch SLAs, 3PAO engagement * AWS GovCloud specifically; multi\-account landing zones; FIPS endpoints and crypto modes * VM fleet or appliance\-model operations at scale, not only Kubernetes * Telemetry and data pipeline ownership (OTEL, Grafana\-class stacks) * Compliance\-as\-code and evidence automation (OSCAL, machine\-readable ConMon, AWS Config rules or OPA at scale) * Test and verification engineering: building the harnesses that prove a fleet is in the state the paperwork says it isParticipate in on\-call for the GovCloud estate, with the explicit expectation that recurring incident causes get engineered away Working Details * Location: US\-based, remote. This role works inside a FedRAMP boundary; standard US\-person requirements for federal environments apply. * Reports to the SRE Manager, within the VP of Application Engineering's organization. Better Together Diversity. Inclusion. They're more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected. We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together. About Us BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity\-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders. BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners. Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com. \#LI\-BS1

jobs.title: Engineer II/III, Automation
jobs.description: **About This Role** As an Engineer II/III Automation, you will join the Automation \& MES team at Biogen’s RTP Bio site, supporting both operational excellence and project\-driven goals. This role provides technical solution development and hands\-on support for DeltaV DCS and Syncade MES systems, partnering cross\-functionally to design, implement, maintain, and continuously improve automation solutions that support biopharmaceutical manufacturing operations. You will be responsible for recipe authoring, software configuration, validation activities, change controls, troubleshooting, and ensuring seamless integration with systems such as PI Historian, Oracle, CMMS, Veeva, and Labware (LIMS). This position plays a critical role in optimizing manufacturing operations, enhancing system reliability, and supporting the site's long\-term automation strategy. **What You'll Do** * Configure and maintain DeltaV DCS and Syncade MES software to support process improvements, new products, and new equipment implementations. * Partner with Process Owners, Manufacturing, and cross\-functional stakeholders to design and implement software that meet s operational and engineering requirements. * Author, review, and approve MES and DeltaV DCS documentation, including lifecycle documents, project documents, procedures, work instructions, and validation deliverables. * Create and execute software testing scripts and support software validation activities in accordance with established procedures and GAMP 5 principles. * Define and support validation strategies in collaboration with Quality representatives and ensure consistency in execution across disciplines. * Execute and manage change controls for DeltaV DCS and Syncade MES systems while maintaining compliance with site procedures and quality requirements. * Troubleshoot MES and DCS system issues during testing and manufacturing operations, including participation in an on\-call support rotation. * Identify and implement opportunities for optimization in system design, programming, testing, integrations, and operational processes. * Collaborate with automation, data systems, manufacturing, and engineering teams to ensure systems continue to meet evolving site needs. * Support and lead small to medium engineering projects, ensuring timely execution and adherence to quality standards. * Evaluate technical options and recommend optimal solutions for system enhancements and integrations. * Support continuous improvement initiatives and drive operational excellence through automation solutions. Maintain training requirements, establish development goals, and support knowledge sharing across the team. * **Who You Are** You are a technically capable automation professional who thrives in a collaborative and fast\-paced manufacturing environment. You are detail\-oriented, proactive, and passionate about solving complex technical challenges. You leverage strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to identify effective solutions while working closely with cross\-functional partners. You are committed to continuous improvement, system reliability, and delivering automation solutions that support safe, compliant, and efficient manufacturing operations. **Required Skills for an Engineer II** **Salary Range: 65K\-85K** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, or a related discipline from an accredited college or university * Minimum of 0\-2 years of experience in a GMP manufacturing environment Strong collaboration and communication skills with cross\-functional teams * **Required Skills for an Engineer III** **Salary Range: 77K\-100K** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related discipline from an accredited college or university * Minimum of 2 years of experience with MES recipe authoring (preferably Syncade) and/or supporting DeltaV in an engineering related capacity * Strong understanding of system validation, change controls, and troubleshooting within MES and DCS environments * Proven ability to develop and implement automation solutions that support manufacturing and operational objectives * Ability to evaluate technical options and drive optimal system enhancements across automation platforms Experience providing technical leadership and collaborating across functions to meet site goals * **Preferred Skills** * Experience supporting large\-scale biotech or pharmaceutical manufacturing environments * Familiarity with integrations involving PI Historian, Oracle, CMMS, Veeva, and Labware (LIMS) * Experience supporting investigations and implementing corrective and preventative actions (CAPAs) * Ability to lead cross\-functional meetings and coordinate change implementation activities * Familiarity with GAMP 5 principles and regulated system compliance requirements * Experience identifying and implementing process, design, and system optimization opportunities * Interest in expanding expertise across automation platforms and integrated manufacturing systems Experience serving as a subject matter expert for MES, DeltaV or other automation systems within a manufacturing environment * Job Level: Professional **Additional Information** The base compensation range for this role is: $77,000\.00\-$100,250\.00 Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills \& experience, job location, and internal equity. Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long\-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance. In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families *physical, financial, emotional,* and *social well\-being* ; including, but not limited to: * Medical, Dental, Vision, \& Life insurances * Fitness \& Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement * Short\- and Long\-Term Disability insurance * A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end\-of\-year shutdown time off (Dec 26\-Dec 31\) * Up to 12 company paid holidays \+ 3 paid days off for Personal Significance * 80 hours of sick time per calendar year * Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit * 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions * Employee stock purchase plan * Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year Employee Resource Groups participation * **Why Biogen?** We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid\-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well\-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life\-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives. At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about our Biogen. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, race, color, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, religion, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. Biogen is an E\-Verify Employer in the United States.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.description: Bitsight is a cyber risk management leader transforming how companies manage exposure, performance, and risk for themselves and their third parties. Companies rely on Bitsight to prioritize their cybersecurity investments, build greater trust within their ecosystem, and reduce their chances of financial loss. Built on over a decade of technological innovation, its integrated solutions deliver value across enterprise security performance, digital supply chains, cyber insurance, and data analysis. * We invented the cyber ratings industry in 2011 * Over 3500 customers trust Bitsight * Over 600 teammates are dispersed throughout Boston, Raleigh, New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and remote **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a highly experienced and collaborative Senior Full Stack Engineer and team player to join one of our multicultural Engineering teams, focusing on our Third Party Risk Management business. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you are known for thinking on your feet, learning quickly, and owning a problem to resolution. You enjoy solving complex problems while contributing with new ideas and techniques, leading to continuous improvement for the team. You enjoy close collaboration to find better ways to deliver great quality software in a high\-trust Engineering culture. Apart from domain skills, what we truly value are strong generalists: those with the critical thinking skills to use a variety of technologies \& languages and pick up new concepts when needed. We deliver well\-tested, high\-quality code in a continuous delivery environment. **Requirements:** ----------------- * Curious and with a growth mindset. Have a passion for continuous learning, seeking out opportunities to expand your knowledge, and stretching yourself and others to achieve goals. * Strong Computer Science fundamentals in system design, data structures, and algorithms. * Ability to own loosely defined features from technical design through completion, and deliver on commitments. * Five (5\) years of experience as a Software Engineer building and maintaining a SaaS application. * Experience with Python. * Experience maintaining, building, and optimizing REST APIs. * Solid understanding of modern Javascript (ES6\+) and experience with at least one modern web framework (React, Vue, Svelte, etc.). * Experience with CI/CD (e.g. Gitlab CI/CD, Jenkins) and container technologies (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes). * Experience working with a team of engineers, and product owners in delivering a product to end\-users. * Results driven. You don’t want to just write code, you want to ship code that is loved by customers. * Excellent communication skills in English \- both written and spoken. **Preferred:** -------------- * Experience with modern Python frameworks and technologies, such as Django, FastAPI, Flask, SQLAlchemy. * Experience with cloud computing environments (E.g., AWS) * Hands\-on experience leveraging AI\-assisted coding tools in daily workflows, including but not limited to Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code. **Belonging \& Inclusion****.** Bitsight is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. This means we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of your gender identity, race, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, status as a protected veteran, or status as an individual with a disability. **Culture.** We put our people first. Bitsight offers best in class benefits. We devote the same energy to nurturing our company's inclusive culture as we apply to serving our customers' needs. Working at Bitsight will give you the opportunity to fulfill your professional goals and expand your skills. **Open\-minded.** If you got to this point, we hope you’re feeling excited about the job description you just read. Even if you don’t feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We’re eager to meet people that believe in Bitsight’s mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways. Bitsight also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or based on a sincerely held religious belief in accordance with applicable laws. If you need to inquire about a reasonable accommodation, or need assistance with completing the application process, please email recruiting@bitsight.com. This contact information is for accommodation requests only, and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. This role uses AI\-assisted transcription during the interview process. All hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team. **Additional Information for United States of America Applicants**: Bitsight is committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status. Bitsight will not discharge, discipline or in any other manner discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because such employee or applicant has inquired about, discussed, or disclosed the compensation of the employee or applicant or another employee or applicant. **Massachusetts Applicants:** *It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.* Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment consistent with applicable law. This position may be considered a promotional opportunity pursuant to the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act. The anticipated hiring base salary range for this position is US$119,000 to $150,000 annually for US\-based employees. This range reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations, is based on a full\-time work schedule, and is Bitsight’s good faith estimate as of the date of this posting. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for participation in a bonus or commission plan and an equity grant. Bitsight also offers a competitive benefits package, including but not but limited to medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid parental leave; flexible time off; a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities; life and disability insurance; and tuition reimbursement.

Working at the intersection of analytics engineering, data engineering, and artificial intelligence, you will define the metrics, business logic, and context that enable large language models (LLMs) and AI agents to reliably understand and query institutional data, and you will bring software engineering rigor to modern data tools such as dbt, Dagster, Apache Iceberg, Trino, and AWS. As part of the AI, Automation, and Data Engineering team, you will report to the \[Reporting Manager Title], serve as a technical leader on high\-priority initiatives, mentor fellow engineers, and partner with data engineers, AI engineers, researchers, faculty, and staff in a hybrid work environment based in Boston, MA. This is an opportunity to help define an evolving discipline and build the data foundations that support university operations, research, and innovation. You Will: Architect and lead development of scalable analytics data models and lakehouse data layers using dbt, SQL, and Python. Define and govern the semantic layer, including enterprise metrics and business logic, as a single source of truth for reporting and AI. Lead context engineering efforts, designing the metadata, semantic models, and AI\-ready interfaces (e.g., MCP, text\-to\-SQL) that enable LLMs and AI agents to accurately use institutional data, and measure their accuracy. Design production\-grade data and ML pipelines, including feature engineering and embedding pipelines, using Dagster and AWS. Set engineering and data quality standards and conduct expert\-level code reviews. Lead technical planning and delivery for cross\-functional initiatives and contribute to IS\&T's analytics and AI data strategy. Mentor engineers and foster a culture of engineering excellence. jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer - II
jobs.description: **Job Overview** This role has these primary responsibilities: (1\) Create, counsel, design, coordinate, project engineer, and fully execute entire or selected/assigned portions of clients’ IT projects. (2\) Provide timely IT support for Brave North Technology LLC’s (“Brave North”) clients. (3\) Assist with advanced or complicated technology requests, process improvements, and other administrative, documentation, and duties as requested by clients, RSSM (Routine Security and Stability Maintenance), Helpdesk, and Onboarding Teams and/or internal team members, and execute and complete/entire or selected/assigned portions of tasks or projects. The scope of technology service is broad. Brave North supports internet, networking, client/desktop computers, printers, scanners, mobile devices, websites, email, and other IT\-related devices and technology resources. Customer service skills are critically important: emotional intelligence, patience, and compassion are critically important. This position will know they have been successful in this position when clients report their projects and/or issues were resolved efficiently, and they feel valued and listened to. **Essential Functions** * Initiate, determine scope of, strategize, plan, and execute IT project work for clients from beginning to end of project. Serve as Project Lead / Project Engineer by taking on full responsibility for the completion of the project, whether the project work will be performed solo or have components delegated to other technicians. Develop and follow scheduled rollout of the project implementation, keeping Client informed of progress along the way with regular (weekly) updates and check\-in meetings. * Carefully track project progress, including daily and weekly updates to individual project schedules and the larger project schedule in order to fully track, manage, and plan future project schedules and the impact of project changes, complications, and additions. * Remain in regular communication with each designated client project contact keeping them informed of any project changes, schedule changes, complications, or other discoveries. Provide detailed explanations of work to ensure the client fully understands the outcomes and deliverables of each project. * Track project and process work throughout a project. Note any recommended process or project step changes on internal process documents or KB documentation for future Brave North client projects. * Provide counsel and support to clients throughout a technology project. Proactively identify perceived client “pain points”, issues, conflicts, or other areas that could result in project failures, delays, or lack of change adoption and either individually or with support from Brave North colleagues, work to present, deliver, and/or pursue proactive measures to address such issues prior to conflicts, delays, or other barriers to positive project outcomes. * As needed, provide timely responses to support requests or system monitor alerts, which come in via phone, email, and SMS. This includes: * \- respond to all incoming requests with expected urgency * \- engage client with a professional, calm, patient, empathetic, and confident manner * \- assess severity/impact level and prioritize support requests accordingly * \- proactively follow up with clients to verify that issues have been addressed to their liking * \- escalate issues to technical lead as needed * \- follow direction as given by Supervisor * Document support performed immediately or during the same shift of work, including: * \- significant IT information in the client’s IT\-information database or labor log * \- a narrative description of work that was performed * Provide timely on\-site technical support and project work at a client’s office or site as needed and scheduled. * Educate and inform other technicians regarding advanced solutions as needed. * Identify and develop system and operational improvements by investigating and implementing new technical tools, procedures, and automation tools. * Encourage, support, and educate other IT Support Specialists in growing their skills and abilities. * Act as a resource for performing routine maintenance for Managed Service clients, including documenting when actions are performed and communicating with clients about updates, challenges in performing maintenance, and summaries to the lead technician. * Perform project work as assigned, including performing project tasks as requested by supervisor. * Other duties as assigned. **Required Technical Tasks** * Design and rollout new email and file/folder storage platforms. * Migrate various IT infrastructures (email, storage, web domains, networking functions) from old infrastructures to new. * Assemble and mount IT equipment (network racks, routers, switches) * Write detailed technical documentation of a technology project, including step\-by\-step process documentation for new technology projects or improved/changed processe mmunicating with the team as necessary to brainstorm issues and potential resolutions. * Proactively identify potential obstacles that may delay or extend projects and communicate them with all stakeholders. * Communicate effectively, empathetically, and efficiently in person, virtually, and in email to convey the project status, timelines, issues, responsibilities, and next steps. * Bring a solution focused mindset to discussions. **Position Requirements** * Must be fully available and reachable within 2 hours by mobile phone, email, text, and have reliable and secure internet access during the 8:30AM\-5PM Monday\-Friday (or as mutually agreed with your supervisor) and the next business day following any network or system change. * Required to have a home office space that is secure and can support duties of the job and reflect positively upon the professionalism of the company. * Required to have a driver's license and a reliable vehicle or regular access to a vehicle to be used for client onsite visits. * Must have a workable home office environment with ability to have private phone conversations, display confidential information on a computer screen without other people being able to view information, and a secure home internet connection that is not accessible to others. * Must be able to maintain a high degree of professionalism and keep client information confidential at all times. **Other Information** * The position will receive calls, emails, and texts from a variety of clients representing many different industries and business categories. Must be able to pivot quickly between issues, questions, and conversations. * Must have the ability to remain calm and reassuring when receiving a help desk request where the client may be stressed, frustrated, or angry. Brave North does not tolerate rude or inappropriate language, tone, and verbal abuse from employees or clients. **Physical Requirements and Working Environment** **Work Rating Light\-to\-moderate Work:** Exerting 16 to 50 pounds of force occasionally and/or 10 to 12 pounds of force frequently, and/or greater than negligible up to 5\-6 pounds of force constantly to move objects. (Constantly: activity or condition exists 2/3 or more of the time) to move objects. Physical demand requirements are in excess of those for sedentary work. Even though the weight lifted may be only a negligible amount, a job should be rated Light Work: (1\) When it requires walking or standing to a significant degree; or (2\) when it requires sitting most of the time, but entails pushing and/or pulling of arm or leg controls; and/or (3\) when the job requires working at a production rate pace entailing the constant pushing and/or pulling of materials even though the weight of those materials is negligible. **Tools Used** No specialized tools, other than general office equipment. **Work Environment** Much of the day\-to\-day work is done in an office setting, and typically a home office environment. Onsite client visits may take place indoors or outdoors, with variable terrain. Will be working with a variety of people. Must be able to transport technical equipment needed for onsite client visits to and from client sites as well as pick up technical materials for hardware equipment. **OCCASIONAL** Standing, Lifting (up to 50 pounds), Bending, Kneeling, Climbing, Pushing, 1 to 100 reps/8 hrs Pulling, Driving, Twisting, Carrying, Reaching 25 min\-2 ½ hours **CONSTANT** Talking/Speaking, Hearing, Seeing, Sitting, Handling, Typing 301\-500 reps/8 hrs 5\+ hours **Driving** This position has been designated as Mandatory Driving: Administrative. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Flexible schedule * Health savings account * Paid time off * Professional development assistance Experience: * IT Network management: 5 years (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Roseville, MN 55113 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Roseville, MN 55113

jobs.title: Construction Project Engineer Associate
jobs.description: Description: **Construction Project Engineer Associate** **Location:** Avon, CO **Position Type:** Part timeSeasonal Non\-Exempt **Compensation:** $25\.00 /hr. This seasonal role runs through July 4, 2027\. **About the Role** At Breckenridge Grand Vacations, we create Grand Vacations by Sharing Smiles with every Owner, Guest, and coworker. As our Construction Project Engineer Intern, you will be the boots\-on\-the\-ground support for our Construction Management team, translating our commitment to building exceptional places into every document tracked, every site walk completed, and every detail coordinated. You will be the connector between the office and the field, ensuring our project teams have accurate information, organized records, and dependable support to keep active construction projects moving forward safely and efficiently. This role is perfect for a current student or recent graduate who is equal parts eager learner, detail\-oriented organizer, and proactive problem solver. You will gain hands\-on exposure to the entire construction project lifecycle, from document control and RFI tracking to field observations, safety walks, quality control, and project closeout, always working under the guidance of experienced Project Managers, Project Engineers, and Superintendents who are invested in your growth. You will partner with your assigned mentor to ask questions, receive feedback, and build practical construction knowledge, while supporting the team wherever help is needed. If you thrive in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same, are driven by curiosity and initiative, and find deep satisfaction in knowing you played a part in bringing a project to life, we'd love to meet you. **Responsibilities** * Assist Project Managers, Project Engineers, Superintendents, and field staff with day\-to\-day construction coordination and administrative tasks * Maintain project documents, including current drawing sets, specifications, sketches, meeting notes, logs, reports, and other project records * Help distribute, file, and track design updates, RFIs, submittals, field reports, inspection reports, and other construction documents * Review drawings, specifications, and project documents to better understand construction requirements, sequencing, and coordination issues * Assist with tracking project schedules, look\-ahead planning items, manpower needs, material deliveries, and open action items * Support quantity takeoffs, material tracking, basic budget support, and simple cost or production tracking * Participate in field walks and site observations to identify work progress, incomplete items, potential safety concerns, and coordination issues * Assist with quality control efforts by organizing inspections, testing reports, punch lists, deficiency logs, photos, and follow\-up documentation * Support project safety efforts by participating in safety walks, maintaining PPE or safety supply inventories, and reporting unsafe conditions * Attend project meetings, department meetings, trainings, safety meetings, and jobsite walks * Work closely with your assigned mentor to ask questions, receive feedback, and gain clarity on assignments * Assist with project closeout tasks such as punch list tracking, warranty documentation, turnover materials, as\-built information, and closeout file organization * Take initiative to learn, ask questions, follow directions, and support the team wherever help is needed * Uphold BGV's hospitality values and company culture in every interaction Requirements: * Current enrollment in, or recent completion of, a college or university program in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Real Estate Development, or a related field preferred * Ability to speak, read, write, and interpret in English * Ability to read basic construction documents, instructions, schedules, meeting notes, safety information, and written correspondence * Basic math skills including addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division using whole numbers, common fractions, decimals, percentages, and basic units of measure * Basic to intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office programs including Outlook, Word, and Excel * Ability to operate a personal computer, mobile device, and accurately record time worked in the correct department using the timekeeping system * Must possess a valid US driver license and an acceptable driving record if driving is required for the position * Ability to perform repetitive motions of the arms, wrists, hands, and fingers while using a computer or mobile device * Ability to sit and work at a computer terminal or in a jobsite trailer for extended periods * Ability to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, crouch, climb stairs, and navigate active construction sites * Ability to lift between 10\-25 pounds occasionally; heavier lifting should be performed only with assistance and proper direction * Requires close, distance, color, peripheral vision, close visual acuity, and depth perception * Ability to work in office, jobsite trailer, and active construction site environments * Ability to work in outdoor weather conditions such as sun, ice, snow, wind, dust, rain, and humidity * Ability to work in moderate to high noise levels, moving equipment, uneven terrain, vehicles, and other typical construction site conditions * Must wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) when working on or walking active construction areas * Willingness to work in pet friendly office areas with pets and pet dander **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior construction, trade, internship, or field experience * Familiarity with construction software such as Procore, Bluebeam, Microsoft Project, or similar tools * OSHA 10, First Aid, or CPR training * Demonstrated initiative and ability to perform tasks without being asked * Strong attention to detail and accuracy * Ability to give and receive feedback and apply direction from supervisors and mentors * Ability to treat people with respect and consideration and approach others in a tactful manner * Ability to support the team's effort to succeed by contributing to a positive team spirit * Desire to build construction knowledge and share information with others * Commitment to observing safety procedures and reporting potentially unsafe conditions **Compensation \& Benefits** * Health, vision, and dental insurance plans * Company\-paid life insurance coverage * Voluntary Life and Accidental Death/Dismemberment Insurance * HSA and FSA\-Dependent Care Accounts * Retirement plan * Generous paid time off (PTO) and sick leave to support work\-life balance * Volunteer Time Off \- Paid opportunities to give back to Summit County * Retirement plan * Generous paid time off (PTO) and sick leave to support work\-life balance * Volunteer Time Off \- Paid opportunities to give back to Summit County * Bereavement leave * Biannual bonuses * Tuition Reimbursement Program * Employee Wellness programs to support physical and mental health * Lifestyle perks: Ski/Rec center pass loan programs, lodging and gear discounts, sporting/concert event tickets, pet insurance partner discounts and access to Summit Medallions: Occasional\-use transferable passes for access to 6 premier resorts (A\-Basin to Vail) via owners’ program **About Our Company** Breckenridge Grand Vacations is a locally owned resort developer with a 40\-year history in Summit County. We've been recognized as a Top Workplace for our employee\-focused culture and commitment to responsible growth and giving back to the place we call home. Applications will be accepted until October 8, 2026\. We value diversity and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: VP, Head of Infrastructure - Sell Side, Capital Markets
jobs.description: At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. We are seeking a VP, Head of Infrastructure, Sell Side Capital Markets to lead the platforms, networks, and teams that support principal and agency trading. This leader will set infrastructure strategy, deliver secure and resilient services, and ensure that latency\-sensitive trading systems perform predictably under demanding market conditions. The role requires deep technical judgment, strong governance, enterprise\-wide collaboration, and the executive presence to connect technology decisions to trading outcomes, client confidence, and risk. ### **Key responsibilities** * **Set infrastructure strategy:** Own the architecture, operating model, investment roadmap, and service levels for trading infrastructure across data centers, colocation facilities, networks, compute, storage, and cloud services where appropriate. * **Deliver low\-latency performance:** Measure and improve the path from market\-data receipt through order submission and venue acknowledgment. Address tail latency, jitter, packet loss, throughput, and performance under peak load—not just average response times. * **Lead high\-performance networking:** Oversee exchange and venue connectivity, cross\-connects, routing, multicast market data, bandwidth and burst capacity, time synchronization, and diagnosis of congestion or microbursts. * **Support distinct trading workflows:** Ensure infrastructure meets principal trading needs for pricing, quoting, hedging, position visibility, and risk limits, as well as agency trading needs for client order intake, algorithmic execution, routing, timestamps, and complete order and execution records. * **Build resilience:** Define recovery objectives, engineer failover, test disaster recovery under realistic conditions, and maintain readiness for market\-open incidents, volume spikes, and venue disruptions. * **Lead operations and incidents:** Establish observability, capacity planning, on\-call practices, and disciplined incident response. Communicate business impact promptly and drive corrective actions that address root causes. * **Establish governance:** Set standards and decision rights for architecture, service ownership, change management, access, security, vendor risk, and operational controls. Maintain transparent reporting on service health, exceptions, and risk. * **Work across the organization:** Partner with trading desks, product and application engineering, cybersecurity, risk, compliance, operations, finance, procurement, and client\-facing teams to align priorities and resolve trade\-offs. * **Develop people and leaders:** Build, coach, and retain multidisciplinary teams; establish clear accountability, succession plans, and a culture of collaboration and sound decision\-making under pressure. * **Drive continuous improvement:** Use performance data, incident reviews, automation, and engineering feedback to remove recurring problems and demonstrate sustained gains in reliability, recovery, efficiency, and cost. * **Guide modernization:** Lead large\-scale platform change and adopt DevOps, data, and AI\-enabled engineering practices where they provide measurable value, with appropriate security, governance, and responsible\-AI controls. * **Represent infrastructure at the executive level:** Present a compelling platform vision, make evidence\-based investment recommendations, and provide calm, credible updates during incidents and periods of change. ### **Qualifications and experience** **Education** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. **Professional experience** * 15\+ years of software engineering, infrastructure engineering, or platform engineering experience, preferably in fintech, sell\-side trading, electronic markets, or regulated financial services. * 10\+ years managing engineering teams and leaders, including responsibility for leadership pipelines, organizational development, budgets, vendor relationships, and enterprise delivery commitments. * Proven record leading large\-scale, business\-critical platforms and modernization programs, including AI\-enabled engineering practices that deliver measurable business impact. * Experience improving availability, recovery, performance, and operational readiness for high\-volume services, with specific examples of decisions made during major production incidents. * Demonstrated ability to establish effective governance and sustain improvements through clear ownership, meaningful metrics, and disciplined execution. **Trading and technical expertise** * Working knowledge of principal and agency trading workflows and the different market\-risk, operational, and client consequences of infrastructure failure. * Strong understanding of market data, r application to trading infrastructure. **Leadership and competencies** * **Enterprise leadership:** Builds strong teams and future leaders, mobilizes people across organizational boundaries, and creates a healthy engineering and on\-call culture. * **Strategic judgment:** Leads through complexity and converts enterprise\-scale transformation into measurable outcomes while balancing speed, resilience, security, and cost. * **Stakeholder Management:** Aligns senior stakeholders around a clear platform vision, communicates technical and business trade\-offs plainly, and remains credible under pressure. * **Communication Skills: Deep** technical knowledge to drive a refurbishment agenda, and communicate with that with clarity and technical depth. * **Commercial and client orientation:** Connects infrastructure investment, modernization, and responsible innovation to execution capability, client confidence, and business value. * **Governance mindset:** Drives accountability, transparency, risk management, responsible AI, and disciplined delivery across technology and operations. ### **What success looks like** Trading teams have predictable, observable, and resilient infrastructure. Principal and agency workflows receive the performance and controls they require. Incidents are detected and contained quickly, recovery plans work when tested, and recurring issues are eliminated. Leaders across the organization understand service risks and investment priorities, while infrastructure improvements produce measurable benefits for trading, clients, and the business. Compensation Range: The salary range for this position is between $280,000\.00\- $300,000\.00 USD. Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education. Bonus Eligibility: Bonus Eligible Benefits Information: Please visit www.broadridgebenefits.com for more information on our comprehensive benefit offerings for this role. We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective. **Use of AI in Hiring** As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)\-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration. US applicants: Click here to view the EEOC "Know Your Rights" poster. ***Disability Assistance*** We recognize that ensuring our long\-term success means creating an environment where everyone is welcome, where everyone's strengths are valued, and where everyone can perform at their best. Broadridge provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, ethnic origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, and other protected characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you need assistance or would like to request reasonable accommodations during the application and/or hiring process, please contact us at 888\-237\-7769 or by sending an email to BRcareers@broadridge.com.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Android
jobs.description: **Staff Software Engineer \- Android** -------------------------------------- **Company Description** ----------------------- Butterfly Network, Inc. (NYSE: BFLY) is driving a digital revolution in ultrasound imaging and sensing with its proprietary Ultrasound\-on\-Chip™ semiconductor technology and software solutions. Butterfly first proved its technology in the point\-of\-care ultrasound market – commercializing the world's first single\-probe, whole\-body portable ultrasound device, which is now on its best\-selling, third\-generation: Butterfly iQ3™. The Company combines its advanced hardware with cloud software and AI, an enterprise workflow solution (Compass AI™) and other offerings to drive adoption of affordable, accessible ultrasound. Butterfly also enables third\-party development of imaging AI apps through Butterfly Garden™, its software development kit and AI partnership initiative. In addition to its medical imaging products, Butterfly Embedded™ is the Company's Ultrasound\-on\-Chip™ licensing and co\-development program designed to enable a new wave of ultrasound\-enabled technologies across non\-competitive healthcare markets and beyond. Through Butterfly Embedded™, partners can build and scale novel ultrasound applications powered by Butterfly's proprietary semiconductor chip and software platform. Butterfly's innovations have been recognized by Prix Galien USA, Fierce 50, TIME's Best Inventions and Fast Company's World Changing Ideas, among other achievements. We're a team of bold thinkers, problem\-solvers, and innovators ready to shape the future of medical imaging. Let's build something extraordinary together! **Job Description** ------------------- As a Staff Android Engineer at Butterfly, you will be responsible for building native Android apps that reinvent the ultrasound user experience for the mobile age. You'll be a champion for constantly improving the software architecture and team processes. You'll collaborate with product managers and designers to deliver elegant solutions to complex problems. You'll work alongside the hardware, cloud, machine learning, control software, and imaging science teams to integrate cross\-cutting features. You'll even participate in user research sessions to get a firsthand view into how the product you build is being used in the real world. As part of our team, your core responsibilities will be: * Collaborating and unboxing ambiguous requirements through iterative problem\-solving sessions with Android and iOS developers. * Working alongside product managers, designers, and clinical professionals to break down requirements and develop new medical imaging experiences. * Producing high\-quality, efficient, and well\-tested modern Kotlin code. * Following established team architecture patterns and evolving the codebase with the team. * Working in a complex codebase with numerous internal Android modules managed by the Android, Device Software, Imaging and AI teams. * Mentoring engineers at all levels. We are all life long learners. * Working on advanced technologies such as deep learning applications, telemedicine and integration with our cutting edge Butterfly iQ device. * Leveraging modern technologies like Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow, and GraphQL. * Product managers write requirements, engineers write tickets. We know how to break down work that builds what they want. * Perform a broad variety of tasks in support of the role and responsibilities. **Qualifications** ------------------ Baseline skills/experiences/attributes: * Bachelor of Science in Computer Science / Engineering or related field. * A track record of professional achievement and problem solving. * 5\+ years of *native* Android application development. * Strong grasp of Kotlin and coroutines/reactive framework design patterns. * A strong grasp of Jetpack Compose and View\-based UI Development * A strong grasp of JUnit unit testing and knowledge of UI automation (Espresso) * A passion for creating something meaningful. Ideally, you also have these skills / experiences / attributes (but it's ok if you don't!): * Interest and experience working in complex application structures with internal libraries that have JNI/NDK bridging layers to native C\+\+ code. * Experience with Gradle multi\-module builds and modularized Android app architecture. * Knowledge of graphics rendering and image processing (OpenGL ES, Vulkan). * Python and C\+\+ experience will help you collaborate with our Device Software and Imaging teams. **Values** ---------- Innovation is what we do. Our values are how we make it happen. Butterflies are and believe in… * Patient\-Centric Innovators: Our mission is THE mission. * Empowered to Impact: Every voice matters. * One Team, One Goal: Unity fuels progress. * Growth Champions: We embrace challenges. * Action\-Oriented Achievers: We follow through, every time. **Location** ------------ Butterfly offers a hybrid work model for most positions, with team members spending two or more days a week in the office. While flexibility is key, we value in\-person connections that spark creativity and teamwork. Our offices are designed for collaboration, with comfortable workspaces, stocked kitchens, and opportunities to connect with peers. This role is a remote role. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health insurance, encompassing dental and vision coverage, is provided to all our employees. As a health\-tech company, we prioritize the well\-being of our teams. Additionally, employees have the option to buy up for enhanced health insurance coverage. We also contribute to Health Savings Account (HSA) accounts for all enrolled employees on an annual basis. * Comprehensive Employee Assistance Program \- we provide access to tools and resources to support your emotional health and day\-to\-day needs. * 401k plan and match \- we facilitate your retirement goals. * Eligible employees will have the opportunity to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) * Unlimited Paid Time Off \+ 10 Holiday Days a Year \- recharge and come back ready to make an impact * Parental Leave \- we want to make sure our employees have plenty of time with their growing families, and additional benefits for primary caregivers to help transition back to work after leave * Competitive salaried compensation \- we value our employees and show it * Equity \- we want every employee to be a stakeholder * The opportunity to build a revolutionary healthcare product and save millions of lives! **Compensation** ---------------- Our estimated salary for this role is between $165,000 \- $180,000 \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits. Actual pay is determined by multiple factors such as skills, qualifications, experience and market demand. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Butterfly Network will not provide immigration sponsorship of any kind for this position, including but not limited to H\-1B, TN, O\-1, L\-1, or green card sponsorship (this includes applicants that are in the process of obtaining a greencard), now or in the future. Butterfly Network does not accept agency resumes. Butterfly Network is an E\-Verify Company. Butterfly Network is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, traits associated with race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or Veteran status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Butterfly requires security adherence responsibilities from all employees. These include: adhering to all company security policies and procedures, utilize provided company assets securely, and complete all required security awareness training programs. Safeguarding company data and systems from unauthorized access, modification, or destruction, contributing to the overall security posture of the organization. Immediately reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, including phishing attempts, malware infections, or unauthorized access, following the established incident response procedure \#LI\-KG \#KG\-LI

jobs.description: **About Cyngn, Inc.** Based in Mountain View, CA, Cyngn is a publicly\-traded autonomous technology company.
