Collaboration and trust drive our creative environment. At Cyngn, everyone’s perspective matters—and that’s what powers our innovation. **About the role** * We are searching for a **Senior Mechanical Engineer** to join our team. You will own mechanical design and release for our autonomous industrial vehicles and the equipment they tow — structures, drivetrain and drive\-unit integration, mechanisms, enclosures and sheet metal — from concept through engineering, design and production validation builds to production release. The vehicle engineering team is small and growing, and this hire adds a second mechanical design stream so that we can develop new vehicle programs in parallel with the ones we are launching. * You are a generalist who has shipped a vehicle or a large electromechanical machine. You have sized motors, gearboxes and brakes against real load cases, designed the weldment they bolt to, released the drawings, argued with the fab shop about tolerances, and then built and broken the first prototype yourself. Robotics, automotive, off\-highway or material handling — the domain matters less than the habit of owning the whole mechanical problem, from the first sketch to the production change order. * You are drawn to a small team where the design you release in one quarter is driving on a test lot the next. You treat the environment the machine lives in — sealing, drainage, thermal, dust and rain — as design inputs, not afterthoughts. You are comfortable making trade\-offs with incomplete information, writing them down, and revisiting them when the test data comes back. You treat electrical, firmware and autonomy engineers as peers, and you think about harness routing, sensor sight\-lines and service access while the frame is still a sketch. * You move fast but release cleanly: GD\&T, tolerance stacks and DFM feedback are part of how you design, not a step afterwards. You are hands\-on in the lab, direct in design reviews, and you mentor by review and by example. **What you'll do** * Own the mechanical technical specification, design, integration and release of vehicle systems: frame and structure, mounting and integration of supplier drive units and axles, wheel ends, braking, hitching and tire packaging, with structural analysis for industrial tow loads and duty cycles. * Lead drive\-system and long\-lead component trade studies with electrical and firmware (supplier drive units, torque / grade / brake performance, battery packaging) and drive those decisions to purchase orders on the program schedule. * Design product variants as one platform — common structures and a single bill of materials with configuration\-specific options — so that variants are released, built and certified from one design. * Own environmental readiness of the mechanical design: enclosure and compartment sealing, drainage, thermal paths, cable entries and connector selection, and the design\-for\-test needed to pass ingress, vibration, shock and temperature testing. * Co\-design operator\-interface hardware and service\-access features with electrical: hand\-held control hardware (grip, controls, sealing, cable management and docking) and the features technicians will use every day. * Own mechanical design for towed equipment and attachments — frames, steering geometry and tracking, powered conveyance, couplers and guarding — from first prototype through production release. * Release drawings, GD\&T, tolerance stacks and fabrication packages; partner with weldment, sheet\-metal, machining and molded\-part suppliers on quotes, DFM and first articles, and with our contract manufacturer on work instructions and engineering changes. * Lead the mechanical side of prototype builds and redesign loops across engineering, design and production validation; own the change list and de and industrial\-truck standards exposure (ISO 3691\-4, UL 583 / UL 3100, ANSI/ITSDF B56\.5\). * Contract\-manufacturer hand\-off and production ramp support. * Characterizing sensing systems (encoders, sensors) for closed\-loop motor control. ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision) through Aetna, Kaiser Permanente, and Guardian, with multiple plan tiers to choose from * Ancillary benefits including accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity plans (Voya) * Company\-paid basic life insurance, plus voluntary (supplemental) life for you and your dependents * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, fully paid by Cyngn * HSA and FSA (Health \& Dependent Daycare) * Employee Assistance Program * 1:1 Health Concierge * Company 401(k) * Commuter Benefits * Flexible PTO policy * Paid Parental Leave * Daily lunches for in\-office employees and fully\-stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages ### **What You Can Expect (Cyngn’s interview process)** * A real person will review your application * We’ll kick off the process with a one\-sided video interview where you’ll share a little more about yourself and we’ll get some basic questions out of the way * A Recruiter touch point will go over the process in more detail and answer your questions * A 45\-minute interview with the hiring manager * A full\-loop interview process consisting of 3\-4 additional conversations to gauge technical and soft skills and culture fit. * A final onsite interview with the team. *W**e may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.* ***Equal Opportunity Employer*** *Cyngn is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We will never contact you from a personal email (Gmail, Yahoo, etc.) or via unsolicited text message or messaging app.* * *Cyngn will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, background checks, or any other fees as part of the application or hiring process.* * *We will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information (e.g., bank account or Social Security number) before you've been extended and have accepted a formal offer through official channels.* * *If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Cyngn, please do not respond with personal information, and feel free to verify by reaching out to us directly through our official careers page.* **The pay range for this role is:** 160,000 \- 180,000 USD per year (HQ \- Terra Bella)

jobs.title: Senior Content Writer
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior Content Writer with deep experience in cloud communications, UCaaS, CCaaS, Contact Center, AI, and enterprise technology markets. This role will own the development, execution, and optimization of content strategies that drive awareness, organic visibility, demand generation, sales enablement, and customer engagement across CallTower's global portfolio. The ideal candidate can translate complex technologies into compelling business outcomes while serving as a subject matter expert and strategic content leader within the marketing team. **Duties** * Lead Content Strategy: Develop and execute content strategies aligned with marketing goals, product positioning, customer personas, and business objectives. Identify content opportunities that drive awareness, engagement, demand generation, and revenue growth. * Thought Leadership Development: Partner with executives, product leaders, engineers, solution architects, and sales teams to develop thought leadership content and industry perspectives. Conduct SME interviews and transform complex technical concepts into compelling, customer\-focused content. * Content Creation: Write, edit, and proofread high\-quality content including blogs, ebooks, whitepapers, case studies, web pages, email campaigns, sales collateral, and social media assets. Ensure all content is accurate, engaging, and aligned with brand standards. * Industry\-Specific Content: Create technical and non\-technical content that communicates the value of CallTower's UCaaS, CCaaS, AI, collaboration, and customer experience solutions. Tailor messaging to diverse audiences, including IT leaders, business decision\-makers, and end users. * AI Search, AEO, GEO \& SEO Optimization: Develop and optimize content for search engines, answer engines, AI\-powered search experiences, and generative AI platforms. Apply SEO, AEO, and GEO best practices to improve discoverability, authority, rankings, and organic performance. * Content Lifecycle Management: Manage content throughout its lifecycle, including planning, creation, optimization, updates, localization, and retirement. Conduct content audits and repurpose existing assets to maximize reach, consistency, and business impact. * Content Performance \& Revenue Contribution: Measure content effectiveness through engagement, traffic, lead generation, conversion, and pipeline influence metrics. Use performance insights to refine content strategies and prioritize high\-impact marketing initiatives. * Mentorship: Mentor and develop junior writers by providing feedback, coaching, and best practices that improve content quality and consistency. Foster a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and creative excellence. * Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, product, sales, customer success, and design teams to align messaging and support business objectives. Ensure brand consistency across campaigns, channels, and customer touchpoints. * Performance Analysis: Monitor content trends, competitive activity, and performance metrics using analytics tools. Provide actionable recommendations that improve engagement, visibility, and conversion outcomes. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Communications, Marketing, or a related field or 6\+ years of related work experience. * 5\+ years of professional content writing or content marketing experience in cloud communications, UCaaS, CCaaS, telecommunications, SaaS, AI, or enterprise technology. * Proven portfolio demonstrating expertise across technical, strategic, and marketing content formats. * Advanced knowledge of SEO, AEO, GEO, and AI\-search content optimization principles. * Experience using content management systems, marketing platforms, and analytics tools such as WordPress, HubSpot, and Google Analytics. · Strong editing, proofreading, research, and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. · Experience developing technical documentation, product marketing content, thought leadership, and sales enablement materials. · Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling content for business and technical audiences. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience leading content strategy within a B2B SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or enterprise technology organization. · Proven success marketing enterprise technology solutions from Microsoft, Cisco, Zoom, Five9, Genesys, or comparable providers. · Familiarity with customer journey mapping, content lifecycle management, and demand generation strategies. * Certifications in SEO, content marketing, digital marketing, AI marketing, or related disciplines. * Experience interviewing subject matter experts and developing executive thought leadership content. **Skills** * Exceptional long\-form and short\-form writing, storytelling, and communication abilities. * Deep understanding of B2B technology marketing, buyer journeys, and content strategy. * Strong analytical and data\-driven decision\-making capabilities. * Excellent stakeholder management, collaboration, and interviewing skills. * Ability to adapt messaging for executive, technical, partner, customer, and prospect audiences. * Experience mentoring writers and contributing to a collaborative content culture. **US Benefits:** * Annual Market comp evaluation * 85% employer paid Medical plans (HDHP and PPO options) * Dental/Vision * PTO accrual starts day one * 100% 401k match on first 4% * Paid Parental Leave * 100% Employer paid life insurance, LTD, EAP, telehealth, Gym Pass

jobs.title: Data & Analytics Platform Engineer IV
jobs.description: **Data \& Analytics Platform Engineer IV** **Hybrid role (3 days/week in office) at our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo, Portland, Vancouver, Renton, Medford, Burlington, Lewiston offices.** **Preference will be given to current employees and candidates who reside within a commutable distance from our Salt Lake City, Boise, Fargo and Lewiston offices or who are willing to relocate.** Build a career with purpose. Join our Cause to create a person\-focused and economically sustainable health care system. **Who We Are Looking For:** Every day, Cambia’s Data \& Analytics Platform Engineering team helps advance our mission to make health care easier and lives better. We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join the team as a technical lead, helping shape and deliver scalable platform capabilities that enable data engineering teams across Cambia. In this role, you will design, build, and optimize CI/CD Snowflake framework, Airflow orchestration libraries, database environment cloning capabilities, data masking solutions, and row\-level access policy frameworks, and create future accelerators and automation related to data engineering workloads. These platform\-wide solutions help teams create data products more efficiently and support conventional analytics, agentic analytics, and operational reporting across the organization. Our technology environment includes Snowflake, dbt, SQL stored procedures, PostgreSQL, Snowflake Streamlit Applications, Snowpark Container Services, Open Flow, REST API Development, Docker, and Airflow. ***If you're a motivated and experienced Mid/Senior Data Platform Engineer looking to make a difference in the healthcare industry, apply for this exciting opportunity today!*** **What You Bring to Cambi** **a:** ***Preferred Key Experience:*** We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong background in designing and building reusable Snowflake platform frameworks using Python and Snowflake SQL stored procedures. The ideal candidate has experience building data and analytics platform solutions on Snowflake that improve the velocity and productivity of data engineering teams. Experience optimizing data pipelines, applying advanced SQL skills, working with dbt, and using modern ELT practices is also highly desired. This role is well suited for someone who can break down complex work, provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, and deliver scalable, high\-quality, reusable, and performant Snowflake platform solutions in complex enterprise environments. **Qualifications and Certifications:** * The **Data \& Analytics Platform Engineer IV** should have at least 7\-8 years of relevant experience in data platform engineering or data engineering, including senior or lead\-level experience. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered in place of a degree. Experience with a business area supported by this position is preferred, such as Provider Network and Contract Management, Digital Solutions, Pricing, Membership, or Claims. * **Skills and Attributes** **:** * Deep expertise with Snowflake, SQL, dbt or other ETL tools, and ELT/ETL design patterns. * Expert\-level knowledge of developing Python applications and Snowflake Streamlit applications. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI, or similar frameworks. * Experience developing stored procedures using SQL or Python, preferably in Snowflake. * Experience in building Python based applications on Snowpark Container Services * Demonstrate experience in calling and building REST API applications * Familiarity with Airflow, Snowflake Tasks, or similar orchestration tools. * Familiarity with containerization technologies like Docker, Kubernetes, etc. * Strong data modeling, pipeline design, and performance optimization skills. * Experience migrating from one platform to another and integrating data into new and existing tables in the target platform. * Ability to think strategically, understand the full scope of work, and translate big\-picture goals into detailed execution plans. * Strong data profiling skills, including the ability to identify unique and primary keys and determine cardinality, data type, precision, scale, and skew. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate within the team and across product, QA, and other partner teams. Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance principles. * **Nice to Have** **:** * Experience in health care or complex enterprise data environments. * Experience with semantic layers, metadata management, or streaming data. Experience building AI pipelines using modern large language model frameworks. * **What You Will Do at Cambia:** * Own delivery of technical projects and mentor junior Data Engineers; drive engineering standards and best practices. * Architect, build, tune, and automate scalable Sno ytics platform solutions. * Ensure implementation quality and performant code, thorough testing, extensive documentation, and platform observability. Pay ranges vary based on the candidate's work location. The expected hiring range depends on skills, experience, education, and training; relevant licensure / certifications; and performance history. * **Oregon, Washington, Utah, and Idaho:** The expected hiring range is $114,000 \- $143,000, the full salary range is $114,000 \- $186,000, and the bonus target is 15%. * **North Dakota:** The expected hiring range is $101,000 \- $134,000, and the full salary range is $101,000 \- $167,000\. **About Cambia** Working at Cambia means being part of a purpose\-driven, award\-winning culture built on trust and innovation anchored in our 100\+ year history. Our caring and supportive colleagues are some of the best and brightest in the industry, innovating together toward sustainable, person\-focused health care. Whether we're helping members, lending a hand to a colleague or volunteering in our communities, our compassion, empathy and team spirit always shine through. **Why Join the Cambia Team?** At Cambia, you can: * Work alongside diverse teams building cutting\-edge solutions to transform health care. * Earn a competitive salary and enjoy generous benefits while doing work that changes lives. * Grow your career with a company committed to helping you succeed. * Give back to your community by participating in Cambia\-supported outreach programs. Connect with colleagues who share similar interests and backgrounds through our employee resource groups. * We believe a career at Cambia is more than just a paycheck – and your compensation should be too. jobs.description: Applied Researcher 4 (AI Foundations, LLM Customization and Finetuning) At Capital One, we are creating trustworthy and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been leading the industry in using machine learning to create real\-time, intelligent, automated customer experiences. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to building world\-class applied science and engineering teams and continue our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The AI Foundations team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. Our work touches every aspect of the research life cycle, from partnering with Academia to building production systems. We work with product, technology and business leaders to apply the state of the art in AI to our business. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, machine learning engineers and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how customers interact with their money. * Leverage a broad stack of technologies — Pytorch, AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, Lightning, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data. * Build AI foundation models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation. * Engage in high impact applied research to take the latest AI developments and push them into the next generation of customer experiences. * Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals. * Collaborate with senior researchers to prepare internal tech reports or conference submissions summarizing novel methods or findings **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers * Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state\-of\-the\-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them * Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea * A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond * Technical. You’re comfortable with open\-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands\-on experience developing AI foundation models and solutions using open\-source tools and cloud computing platforms * Has a deep understanding of the foundations of AI methodologies * Experience building large deep learning models, whether on language, images, events, or graphs, as well as expertise in one or more of the following: training optimization, self\-supervised learning, robustness, explainability, RLHF * An engineering mindset as shown by a track record of delivering models at scale both in terms of training data and inference volumes * Experience in delivering pre\-training of large language models (e.g. technical reports of pre\-trained LLMs, SSL techniques, model pre\-training optimization) + Member of team that has trained   of principles of transfer learning, model adaptation and model guidance + Experience deploying a fine\-tuned large language model * **Data Preparation** + Publications studying tokenization, data quality, dataset curation, or jobs.title: Medical Assistant Per Diem - Urgent Care
jobs.description: As a physician\-founded and led organization, ensuring everyone has access to quality healthcare is what inspires us. The magic we’ve created lies in Carbon Health’s custom EHR and the collaboration among clinical teams, engineers, and designers who work side\-by\-side to deliver innovation like our hands free AI charting tool. That’s why we hire people who genuinely care about patients, solving healthcare challenges, and making a positive impact every day. Join us and help change the future of healthcare for the better. **About The Role** The Urgent Care Medical Assistant in Clinic Operations supports providers in delivering timely, high\-quality patient care in a fast\-paced, walk\-in urgent care setting. Working 10\-hour shifts from 8:45 a.m. to 7:15 p.m. with a 30\-minute lunch, this per diem, hourly role requires flexibility, strong clinical skills, and excellent communication. You will perform direct patient care tasks, assist with clinical procedures, and manage essential administrative and documentation duties to keep patient flow efficient and ensure a positive experience for every patient who enters the clinic. **What You'll Do** * Greet and room patients, obtain and document accurate vital signs, medical histories, and chief complaints in the medical record system. * Perform blood draws (phlebotomy), administer injections, and conduct EKGs in accordance with provider orders and clinical protocols. * Prepare patients and exam rooms for procedures, ensuring proper supplies, equipment, and infection control standards are maintained. * Support providers during examinations and minor urgent care procedures by setting up instruments, assisting as needed, and providing patient support. * Manage medical records, including accurate and timely documentation of patient encounters, treatments, and test results. * Answer phones and respond to patient inquiries with professional phone etiquette, routing calls and messages appropriately. * Coordinate patient flow to minimize wait times, including communicating with front desk, providers, and other staff regarding room availability and patient status. * Perform basic diagnostic support such as point\-of\-care testing (as permitted) and ensure proper specimen handling, labeling, and documentation. * Maintain a clean, safe, and well\-stocked clinical environment, including cleaning and restocking exam rooms between patients. * Follow all clinic policies, safety protocols, and regulatory requirements to ensure patient and staff safety in the urgent care setting. * Collaborate with the urgent care team to support a patient\-centered, efficient, and compassionate care environment during 10\-hour shifts. **Qualifications** * Minimum 1 year of experience as a Medical Assistant or similar clinical support role, preferably in an urgent care, emergency, or ambulatory care setting. * Demonstrated proficiency in blood draws (phlebotomy), including safe venipuncture technique and specimen handling. * Demonstrated proficiency in administering injections, including vaccines and medications, in accordance with provider orders and protocols. * Demonstrated ability to perform and obtain quality EKGs, including proper lead placement and basic troubleshooting of equipment. * Strong patient care skills, with the ability to interact compassionately and professionally with patients of all ages in a fast\-paced environment. * Experience with medical records documentation (electronic or paper), with attention to accuracy, completeness, and confidentiality. * Professional phone etiquette and clear verbal communication skills for interacting with patients, providers, and staff. * Ability to work 10\-hour shifts (7:45 a.m. to 6:15 p.m.) with a 30\-minute lunch and to adapt to changing patient volumes and priorities * Knowledge of basic infection control practices and standard precautions in a clinical environment. * Ability to stand, walk, and move throughout the clinic for extended periods and to assist with occasional lifting or positioning of patients as needed. **The pay range for this role is:** 21 \- 23 USD per hour(CA, Sacramento Natomas: E Commerce Way \[CA00024CA])

jobs.title: Associate Cybersecurity Engineer
jobs.description: At Casey's, technology powers nearly 3,000 stores, supports thousands of team members, and helps deliver an exceptional experience to our guests every day. We're looking for an Associate Cybersecurity Engineer to join our Cybersecurity Engineering team and help protect the systems, applications, and data that keep our business running securely. This is an ideal opportunity for someone early in their cybersecurity or IT engineering career who is eager to gain hands\-on experience with enterprise security technologies, learn from experienced engineers, and grow into a more advanced engineering role. You'll work on meaningful projects, contribute to the security of a Fortune 500 organization, and build technical expertise across a broad range of cybersecurity tools and platforms. If you're curious, driven to learn, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to make a real impact while building a long\-term career in cybersecurity, we'd love to hear from you. As an Associate Cybersecurity Engineer, you'll help implement, support, and continuously improve the cybersecurity technologies that protect Casey's enterprise environment. In this role, you will: * Support the administration, monitoring, and optimization of cybersecurity platforms, including endpoint protection, threat detection, logging, and security monitoring tools. * Troubleshoot technical issues, investigate alerts, and help identify solutions that improve the reliability, performance, and security of our technology environment. * Contribute to cybersecurity engineering projects, including platform enhancements, integrations, automation initiatives, and modernization efforts. * Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and operational guides while supporting knowledge\-sharing across the team. * Collaborate with technology teams, business partners, and vendors while continuously expanding your cybersecurity and engineering expertise through training, mentorship, and hands\-on experience. **Compensation**: Starting pay range: $66,000 \- $90,800\. Great benefits including choices in medical plans, dental, vision, life insurance, charitable giving programs, parental leave and an onsite Child Development Center. * Competitive pay, 401k company match up to 6%, vacation \& sick time, paid holidays, volunteer time, and an onsite cafeteria. * Dress for your day dress code, jeans are welcomed! * The opportunity to work for a big company that has not lost our small company feel. Our senior leadership team is engaged, involved and accessible! What are you waiting for? Come be a part of a company that is growing, transforming and is here for good! Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent years of related work experience required. * At least one (1\) year of experience building and maintaining technical solutions in a business environment preferred. * Fundamental understanding of cybersecurity concepts, enterprise technologies, and technical troubleshooting. Basic knowledge of operating systems, networking, endpoint management, cloud technologies, or security platforms. * Ability to identify, analyze, and assist in resolving technical issues. Demonstrates logical thinking and sound decision making when evaluating problems and solutions. * Maintains professional communication with internal and external partners. * Demonstrates curiosity and a strong desire to learn new technologies and processes. Adapts quickly to new tools, systems, and business requirements. * Responds positively to changing business needs and evolving technology landscapes. * This position requires authorization to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based immigration sponsorship now or in the future. jobs.title: Product Manager, AI Solutions
jobs.description: **About Us** CMB is a full\-service custom market research and strategy firm based in Boston, Massachusetts. As a Top 25 Insights \& Analytics company, we’re known for our relentless business\-decision focus and cutting\-edge creativity. Our passion is helping the world’s leading brands engage, innovate, and grow. We invest in ongoing AI\-driven solutions and combine this with the best of advanced analytics, consumer psychology, and market strategy to tackle game\-changing initiatives and business challenges for our clients. What about our culture? Simply put, our people are our power. At CMB, we’re proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work, a recognition that reflects the diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment our team creates every day. We bring together bright perspectives and curious minds who challenge assumptions, share ideas, and push one another to be better. Innovation is deeply embedded in how we work. That commitment has earned us recognition as one of the GRIT Top 50 Most Innovative Companies, and it shows up daily in how we approach research, insights, and client impact. At CMB, you’ll have meaningful opportunities to achieve your full potential — from learning new skills and expanding your expertise to advancing your career in an environment where you are supported, valued, and encouraged to innovate. Our benefits say a lot about how much we value our employees: we offer a fully paid sabbatical, an annual wellness day, paid time off to volunteer, generous medical plans, a 401k match, and more. Every employee also gets to enjoy an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP). ESOP? Yes, we are 100% employee owned! An ESOP is a qualified retirement plan, similar to a 401k, but you don’t have to make any financial contributions to participate in the rewards. When we each work hard to provide exceptional service and deliverables to our clients, the positive performance of the company increases the value of our stock and enables the accumulation of wealth for all our employee\-owners. **About the Position** At CMB, the application of Behavioral Psychology and Advanced Analytics underpins our approach to uncovering deep consumer insights that help our clients make decisions with confidence. Intelligent Signals, CMB's AI\-powered market intelligence platform, is an important new extension of that approach, combining multi\-channel signal ingestion, an AI agent layer, and insight orchestration to help clients act on market signals faster and with more confidence. Working on the Applied Innovation team and closely with CMB’s VP of Applied Innovation, the Product Manager will help shape the product vision and strategy, and will own product requirements, the roadmap, and go\-to\-market execution for Intelligent Signals as it grows from its first client deployment into a scalable, sellable CMB product. This includes defining requirements and priorities, packaging the product for repeatable delivery across clients, and partnering with Sales and Client Services to bring the product to market. Technical architecture and engineering are led by PD\&I and third\-party development partners, with the Product Manager representing client and market needs in those decisions. The Product Manager will spend most of their time on Intelligent Signals and the remaining time supporting broader CMB product management needs for AI Solutions. This position offers the opportunity to help lead a new growth area for CMB and shape how its AI products are built, packaged, and brought to market, working at the intersection of applied AI, market research, and client strategy with broad exposure across the CMB organization. This position reports to the VP of Applied Innovation and works collaboratively with other teams, including, but not limited to, Product Development \& Innovation (PD\&I), Advanced Analytics \& Data Strategy, Growth Strategy, individual client\-facing project teams, and third\-party development partners. This role can be hybrid in Boston, or remote in the US. **About You** You're energized by taking something promising and bringing it to life. Whether you're representing client needs in a conversation with engineers or working with Sales to shape how a new capability is positioned, you know how to translate between technical possibility and business value. Growing a product from its first client deployment into a repeatable, sellable solution can mean making decisions without a playbook, and you have a track record of approaching that responsibility with curiosity and rigor rather than hesitation. Colleagues trust your judgment because you back it with data, and clients and internal partners alike value how clearly you communicate complex ideas. **About Your Background** You've built your career in product management or p r across teams (Sales, Marketing, Client Services, Engineering, Data Science) and influence without direct authority * Capable of being creative while analytically evaluating challenges to develop client\-focused solutions; strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills * Demonstrated ability to use data and metrics to support decisions and build business cases * Proven ability to manage multiple, competing priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment * Ability to think strategically and execute methodically * Willingness to roll up your sleeves and do whatever is necessary; general manager/owner mentality * Exposure to APIs, system integrations, or data pipelines a plus (technical architecture is led by PD\&I and development partners) * Experience with multi\-tenant or configurable software products a plus **Travel*** Up to 10% \*No agency assistance needed\* \*No visa/work authorization available\* **What to Expect as a Candidate** At Chadwick Martin Bailey, Inc. jobs.title: Lead Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Chamberlain Group (CG) is a global leader in intelligent access and Blackstone portfolio company. Powered by our myQ technology, we make access simple and secure for millions of homeowners, businesses, and communities worldwide. Our flagship brands, LiftMaster® and Chamberlain® , are found in 51\+ million homes, and 14 million\+ people rely on the myQ® app daily. **Job Summary** This role is a senior individual contributor in analytics engineering at Chamberlain Group and sets the technical standard for how curated, trusted data is modeled and published for enterprise\-wide consumption. Where our Data Engineers are accountable for reliably landing and conforming data on the Databricks platform, the Lead Analytics Engineer is accountable for what happens next: designing the curated Gold\-layer data models and domain data marts in Unity Catalog, defining enterprise business metrics once as governed Unity Catalog metric views, building the dashboards that put those metrics in front of decision\-makers, and making that layer well\-tested, well\-documented, performant, and genuinely self\-serviceable. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role without direct reports. This role will establish modeling and metric standards, reviewing the work of other Analytics Engineers and external partner resources, and mentoring engineers and analysts across the organization. Success looks like a single agreed definition for every enterprise metric, business partners who trust the numbers and stop building shadow reports, and an analytics layer that serves BI tools, SQL users, and AI agents consistently. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain curated Gold\-layer data models and domain data marts in Unity Catalog, applying dimensional modeling practices — star schema design, grain decisions, slowly changing dimensions — and conforming dimensions across domains so function\-specific marts reconcile enterprise\-wide. * Define and own enterprise business metrics as governed Unity Catalog metric views, so each metric is defined once and returns a consistent answer across SQL, dashboards, external BI tools, and AI agents. * Develop modular, idempotent transformation logic in Databricks SQL and PySpark — materialized views, streaming tables, and declarative pipelines — with data quality and validation tests (uniqueness, referential integrity, freshness, business\-rule assertions) built into every published model. * Design, build, and maintain Databricks AI/BI dashboards that make enterprise metrics visible and actionable; rationalize and retire redundant or conflicting reports by migrating their logic into governed models. * Partner with business stakeholders to translate ambiguous questions into durable data models and dashboards, facilitate agreement on contested metric definitions, and govern change to established metrics — versioning definitions, assessing downstream impact, and communicating clearly why reported numbers move. * Serve as technical lead for the analytics engineering discipline: establish modeling, naming, testing, and metric standards; conduct design and code reviews for Chamberlain Group and partner engineers; and mentor engineers and analysts to raise the team's SQL, Python, and modeling capability. * Establish data contracts with Data Engineering and upstream data producers — defining the fields, grain, timeliness, and semantics the analytics layer depends on — so source system changes are anticipated rather than discovered as breakage. * Produce and maintain documentation, column\-level lineage, and business\-friendly, agent\-ready metadata (business definitions, synonyms, display names, formatting rules), and curate natural\-language query experiences — scoped tables, instructions, example queries, and accuracy benchmarks — so business users get trustworthy self\-service answers. * Advance data literacy and self\-service by onboarding analysts and business users to the curated and semantic layers, building enablement material, and holding office hours and working sessions. * Apply software engineering discipline to analytics code — Git\-based version control, pull request review, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment via Declarative Automation Bundles — and implement data protection controls (classification, row filters, column masks) per governance and platform standards. * Use AI\-assisted development tools and agentic coding workflows to accelerate model development, testing, documentation, and migration of legacy report logic, and build reusable AI skills, prompts, and agent configurations that encode CG's modeling standards — versioned, documented, and held to the same review and testing bar as any other change. * Lead analytics engineering projects from requirements through adoption, measuring whether delivered models and dashboards are used, while tuning performance and managing platform consumption cost (materialization strategy, incremental processing, liquid clu entation, and metric arbitration * Working understanding of data classification and access control concepts for sensitive and personally identifiable data, and the ability to implement them on published data * Ability to teach — to raise the data capability of analysts and engineers through documentation, enablement material, pairing, and working sessions * Sound judgment about where AI tooling meaningfully accelerates analytics work and where it introduces risk, with the discipline to review, test, and validate AI\-generated code and metric logic rather than accepting it uncritically * Ability to influence and raise standards without formal authority, and to give and receive direct technical feedback constructively * Ability to deal with ambiguity and make quality decisions in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment * Strong presentation, written and verbal communication skills with an ability to communicate effectively to all levels of the organization, including translating technical concepts for business audiences * Insistence on high standards with a strong desire to transform and improve and a bias for action **Minimum Qualifications** **Education/Certifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent relevant work experience **Other:** * Ability to travel up to 5% **Preferred Qualifications** **Education/Certifications:** * Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional, or Databricks Certified Data Analyst Associate * Azure platform certification **Experience:** * Hands\-on experience with Unity Catalog metric views specifically * Experience with Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines (formerly Delta Live Tables) and Lakeflow Jobs * Experience with Declarative Automation Bundles (formerly Databricks Asset Bundles) or comparable deployment\-as\-code tooling * Experience building reusable AI skills, prompt libraries, or agent configurations adopted by other engineers * Experience designing governed, certified datasets and semantic definitions consumed by Databricks AI/BI dashboards and other enterprise BI tools connected to the lakehouse * Experience building or curating AI/BI Genie spaces, or comparable experience enabling natural language or AI agent access to data through curated metadata, example queries, and verified assets * Experience applying agentic AI development tools, such as Claude Code or comparable tools, to analytics engineering work including legacy report logic migration, test generation, and large\-scale SQL refactoring * Experience creating enablement material, patterns, or standards that helped other engineers or analysts use AI tools effectively * Experience with data observability or data quality tooling * Experience with agile/scrum development methodologies \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-JM2 The pay range for this position is $102,600\.00 \- $193,425\.00; base pay offered may vary depending on a number of factors including, but jobs.title: Quantitative Financial Analyst II

amortization, valuation, and performance) and strong technical skills (Python, SQL, version control) for building and automating analytics on large data sets. **Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and maintain quantitative models, calculation libraries, and data analytics tools used to value portfolios, assess financial risk, and forecast portfolio behavior. * Write production\-quality Python — modular, reusable, version\-controlled, peer\-reviewed, and covered by automated tests — and contribute to the shared libraries and internal tooling used across the team. * Build and maintain data pipelines that source, normalize, and validate security, market, and reference data consumed by financial models. * Develop, maintain, and execute test plans for financial models and their software implementations, including regression and integration testing within the existing automated testing frameworks. * Implement numerical and statistical methods — Monte Carlo simulation, solvers and root\-finding, interpolation, optimization — and stochastic models, including interest rate models, for valuation, risk, and cash flow analytics. * Provide requirements, design, and scope considerations for software development projects involving financial models, and translate model specifications into working implementations. * Identify and build opportunities for automation, including the effective use of AI\-assisted development tools, to simplify recurring analytical, validation, and documentation work. * Write and optimize SQL to extract security, position, and market data for model inputs, validation, and ad\-hoc analysis. * Independently replicate and tie out existing mathematical models across Excel and Python, and analyze large sets of model output to identify relationships, shortcomings, and improvements. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including clients, operations, and software engineers, to develop and implement financial technology solutions. * Communicate complex quantitative concepts and findings to non\-technical stakeholders through clear and concise documentation, reports, presentations, and trainings. * Stay current with advancements in financial technology, quantitative analysis techniques, software engineering practice, and industry regulation. * Participate in client conversations related to their domain. **Requirements:** * Finance, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or similar quantitative degree * One of the following: a PhD in a quantitative discipline; a Master’s degree and at least 2 years of relevant experience; or a Bachelor’s degree and at least 3 years of direct experience in quantitative analysis or development * Demonstrated programming ability in Python— writing reusable, tested code, interacting with APIs, and managing data for financial modeling and calculations * Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative software development workflows * Working proficiency in SQL, including writing and editing queries against relational databases * Extremely strong analytical skills including statistical concepts, quantitative methods, or risk management techniques * Solid understanding of financial markets, instruments, and investment strategies * Strong written and verbal communication skills **Desired Experience or Skills:** * Experience in Fixed Income Securities and Risk Analytics including cash flow analysis, OAS, duration and convexity, and numerical methods * Experience with Stochastic Modeling of Financial MarketsInterest rate modeling (e.g., Hull\-White, HJM, LIBOR Market Model) and model calibration * Experience in Derivatives Pricing Models and computing Implied Volatility * Advanced Excel modelling * Proficiency with scientific Python libraries (NumPy, pandas, SciPy) and performance optimization of numerical code * Experience building data pipelines that source and normalize data from multiple systems or vendors * Experience with automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and code review practice * Effective use of AI coding assistants and LLM\-based tooling within a development workflow * Familiarity with cloud platforms and services used for analytics workloads (e.g., AWS) * Familiarity with the software development process, i.e. Agile * Progress toward or completion of the CFA, FRM, or CQF

jobs.title: AI Forward Deployed Engineer

You will be a valued member of the Cognizant Consulting team and work collaboratively with clients, business stakeholders, architects, product managers, data scientists, and engineering teams. In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor, helping organizations accelerate digital transformation initiatives through modern cloud architectures, enterprise integrations, and next\-generation AI solutions. ### **In This Role, You Will** * Partner directly with client stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational challenges, and technical requirements while serving as a trusted technical advisor. * Lead discovery workshops, technical assessments, and solution envisioning sessions to translate business needs into scalable solution architectures and implementation roadmaps. * Design, develop, and deploy cloud\-native applications, APIs, microservices, and enterprise integrations that accelerate time\-to\-value. * Build and implement Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning, and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including AI copilots, intelligent workflows, and autonomous agents. * Own technical delivery across client\-facing initiatives, driving rapid iteration, production readiness, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. ### **Work Model** We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a **remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States**. Occasional travel may be required to client sites, Cognizant offices, workshops, solution design sessions, and project\-related meetings. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. jobs.title: Director, Solutions Architecture
jobs.description: **Opportunity Overview:** We're seeking a Director, Solutions Architecture to lead our team of Solution Architects within Cohere Health's PaaS Delivery organization. In this player\-coach role, you'll set the technical and business standard for how Cohere designs solutions for complex healthcare clients running large, mission\-critical platforms like claims systems and utilization management infrastructure. You'll partner closely with Solution Owners, Forward Deployed Engineers, Technical Program Managers, Platform Configuration, and QA to keep solution design in sync with delivery. This is a remote\-first role that may require travel to Boston, MA for new hire onboarding and occasional in\-person team meetings and company events. **What you'll do:** * Manage a team of 8 Solution Architects — hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development * Set the standard for solution design quality across the team: how SAs guide clients to existing functionality, document the BRD/FRD, and design future\-state workflows * Foster a culture of engaging with customers where they are — saying yes where we can, and pushing back constructively when we can't * Own escalations when a solution design is contested, technically infeasible, or in tension with a commercial commitment * Balance workload and account assignments across the team as new implementations continue to ramp up * Partner with Solution Owners, FDEs, Platform Configuration, QA, and TPMs across the Delivery org to keep solution design in sync with delivery timelines * Represent Solution Architecture in cross\-functional planning and with client executive stakeholders on complex or escalated accounts * Build repeatable training materials, templates, and playbooks so solution quality doesn't depend on any one architect **What you'll need:** * 12\+ years in solution architecture, technical consulting, or similar client\-facing technical roles, including significant healthcare experience * 3\+ years directly managing a technical team — solution architects, FDEs, technical consultants, or similar * Familiarity with large, complex platforms — claims systems, utilization/care management platforms, or similarly mission\-critical enterprise systems * Demonstrated ability to lead and make decisions in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments without waiting for perfect information * Strong technical judgment paired with genuine people leadership — comfortable going deep on a hard technical problem and coaching a direct report through a tough conversation in the same week * Deep experience with payer operations, utilization management, or prior authorization specifically * Background scaling a technical team through rapid company growth is a plus * Experience presenting to and influencing client executive stakeholders is a plus **Pay \& Perks:** Fully remote opportunity with about 10% travel Medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, and Employee Assistance Program 401K retirement plan with company match; flexible spending and health savings account ️ Flex Time Off \+ company holidays Up to 14 weeks of paid parental leave Pet insurance The salary range for this position is $196,000 to $215,000 annually; as part of a total benefits package which includes health insurance, 401k and bonus. In accordance with state applicable laws, Cohere is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role. Individual pay decisions are ultimately based on a number of factors, including but not limited to qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and internal alignment. **Interview Process\*:** * Connect with Talent Acquisition for a Preliminary Phone Screening * Meet your Hiring Manager! * Behavioral Interview(s) * Subject to change **About Cohere Health:** Cohere Health's clinical intelligence platform and agentic AI\-powered solutions connect health plans' strategic goals and providers' needs, optimizing the speed, cost, and quality of care. With an enterprise approach that streamlines payer\-provider decision\-making across the care continuum–including policy, prior authorization, payment accuracy, and more–the company improves collaboration and reduces burden, resulting in up to 8x ROI and 94% provider satisfaction. With the acquisition of ZignaAI, we've further enhanced our platform by launching our Payment Integrity Suite, anchored by Cohere Validate™, an AI\-driven clinical and coding validation solution that operates in near real\-time. By unifying pre\-service authorization data with post\-service claims validation, we're creating a transparent healthcare ecosystem that reduces waste, improves payer\-provider collaboration and patient outcomes, and ensures providers are paid promptly and accurately. Cohere Health's innovations continue to receive industry wide recognition. We've been named to the 2025 Inc. 5000 list and in the Gartner® Hype Cycle™ for U.S. Healthcare Payers (2022\-2025\), and ranked as a Top 5 LinkedIn™ Startup for 2023 \& 2024\. Backed by leading investors such as Deerfield Management, Define Ventures, Flare Capital Partners, Longitude Capital, and Polaris Partners. The Coherenauts, as we call ourselves, who succeed here are empathetic teammates who are candid, kind, caring, and embody our core values and principles. We believe that diverse, inclusive teams make the most impactful work. Cohere is deeply invested in ensuring that we have a supportive, growth\-oriented environment that works for everyone. **We can't wait to learn more about you and meet you at Cohere Health!** **Equal Opportunity Statement:** Cohere Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all. To us, it's personal. \#LI\-Remote \#BI\-Remote

jobs.title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer- Network
jobs.description: **Empowered to live. Inspired to work.** Compeer Financial is a member\-owned cooperative located in Illinois, Minnesota and Wisconsin. We bring together team members with a variety of backgrounds and experiences to help provide financial services to support agriculture and rural communities. Join us in a culture that not only promotes meaningful work and professional development, but provides a flexible, hybrid work environment and excellent benefits, which empower you to thrive both personally and professionally. **How we support you:** * Hybrid model – up to 50% work from home * Flexible schedules including ample flexibility in the summer months * Up to 9% towards 401k (3% fixed Compeer contribution plus up to 6% match) * Benefits: medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, life \& AD\&D insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability, wellness program \& EAP * Vacation, sick leave, holidays/floating holidays, parental leave, and volunteer paid time off * Learning and development programs * Mentorship programs * Cross\-functional committee opportunities (i.e. Inclusion Council, emerging professional groups, etc.) * Professional membership/certification reimbursement and more! Casual/seasonal \& intern team members are not eligible for benefits except for state\-mandated programs. To learn more about Compeer Financial visit www.compeer.com/careers. **Where you will work:** This position offers a hybrid work option up to 50% remote and is based out of the Bloomington, IL; Sun Prairie, WI; Lakeville, MN; Mankato, MN office locations. **The contributions you will make:** This position is an enterprise\-level individual contributor and technical leader accountable for the engineering direction, reliability, and modernization of the organization's most complex network and telephony services. The role shapes multi\-year technical direction, translates target\-state architecture into scalable implementation patterns, leads high\-impact cross\-enterprise initiatives, and establishes standards for campus, branch, data center, cloud, WAN, wireless, voice, unified communications, carrier services, automation, security, and resilience. Influences leaders, engineers, and strategic vendors to deliver sustainable connectivity and communication capabilities across the enterprise. **A typical day:** * Leads engineering direction, reference implementations, standards, and multi\-year roadmaps for enterprise network and telephony services in partnership with architecture, product, security, cloud, and service management leaders. * Designs and leads delivery of complex network transformations, WAN and wireless modernization, cloud\-connectivity programs, telephony and unified communications migrations, carrier transitions, automation initiatives, and resilience improvements. * Establishes reusable enterprise patterns for segmentation, routing, secure connectivity, quality of service, call routing, emergency calling, observability, automation, resiliency, lifecycle management, and operational support. * Leads resolution of the highest\-impact connectivity, performance, voice, carrier, and operational problems; performs deep technical analysis and drives systemic improvements across infrastructure, cloud, security, application, and vendor dependencies. * Defines network and telephony engineering measures and practices for availability, performance, capacity, call quality, failover, recoverability, security, compliance, supportability, and production readiness. * Serves as a trusted technical advisor to leaders and strategic vendors; mentors senior engineers; and influences investment, vendor, carrier, sequencing, resilience, and lifecycle decisions through executive\-ready recommendations. **The skills and experience we prefer you have:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, cybersecurity, telecommunications, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job. * Minimum 10 or more years of progressive experience in network engineering, telecommunications, infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, technology operations, or a related field. * Demonstrated success defining and leading enterprise\-scale network and telephony strategy, modernization, automation, migrations, resilience improvements, and lifecycle initiatives across complex environments. * Expert\-level experience with routing, switching, wireless, WAN, cloud connectivity, network services, telephony, unified communications, carrier services, automation, observability, security, technical governance, and vendor or partner delivery. * Valid driver's license required. * Professional or expert level Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Arista, or comparable network and telecommunications certifications preferred * Experience shaping enterprise adoption of software\-defined networking, cloud networking, network observability, infrastructure\-as\-code, or unified communications and contact\-center technologies, preferred. * Experience in a regulated financial\-services environment or with audit, risk, and control requirements, preferred. * Experience defining enterprise service\-level objectives and indicators, network performance measures, capacity baselines, and availability reporting, preferred. * Experience leading enterprise\-scale wireless, carrier, contact\-center, or multi\-site network transformation initiatives, preferred. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** * Deep expertise in enterprise network and telephony engineering, including routing, switching, wireless, SD\-WAN, cloud connectivity, network services, segmentation, voice, call routing, quality of service, unified communications, and carrier services. * Enterprise\-level systems thinking and engineering judgment, with the ability to connect business strategy, architecture, technical dependencies, service outcomes, resilience, risk, and cost. * Demonstrated ability to create clarity, establish direction, lead through ambiguity, and resolve complex technical and organizational problems. * Exceptional technical leadership, facilitation, communication, storytelling, negotiation, and influencing skills, including communication with executive audiences. * Ability to mentor senior engineers, establish enterprise standards and reusable patterns, and raise engineering capability without relying on formal authority. * Strong financial, carrier, and vendor acumen, with the ability to evaluate investments, contracts, licensing, technology lifecycle, technical debt, and total cost of ownership. * Advanced knowledge of cybersecurity, regulatory and emergency\-calling requirements, change management, operational resilience, disaster recovery, and risk management in a financial services environment. **How we will take care of you:** Our job titles may span more than one career level (associate, senior, principal, etc.). The actual title and base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role is eligible for variable compensation and other benefits. Compeer Financial is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Compeer is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time. Click here to view federal employment laws applicable for applicants.

\& Responsibilities** ---------------------------------------- ### **Marketing, Branding \& Social Media** * Help develop and maintain Coneco's overall marketing presence and brand. * Manage and grow the company's professional social media presence, including planning, creating, scheduling, and publishing content. * Develop content highlighting company projects, services, employees, recruiting efforts, community involvement, industry news, and company milestones. * Maintain consistent company branding across digital and printed materials. * Create and update brochures, presentations, advertisements, project sheets, employee profiles, and other marketing materials. * Assist with maintaining and updating company website content. * Coordinate project photographs, employee features, company news, and other content for marketing purposes. * Identify creative opportunities to increase Coneco's visibility within the industries and communities we serve. * Monitor basic social media and marketing performance and recommend new ideas and opportunities. ### **Proposals \& Business Development** * Coordinate the preparation and submission of proposals, Statements of Qualifications (SOQs), qualification packages, and other business development materials. * Work with company leadership, project managers, technical staff, and administrative personnel to gather information needed for proposals. * Draft, edit, proofread, format, and assemble professional proposal materials. * Maintain proposal templates, project descriptions, employee resumes, qualifications, and other reusable content. * Track proposal opportunities, deadlines, submissions, and outcomes. * Assist with client outreach and other business development initiatives. * Research potential clients, markets, opportunities, and industry trends. * Assist with preparing presentations and materials for client meetings, interviews, and business development activities. ### **Company Communications \& Mailings** * Coordinate company mailings and communications supporting departments throughout Coneco. * Prepare letters, mailing lists, labels, informational packets, announcements, and related materials. * Assist departments with creating polished and professional client\-facing documents. * Coordinate printing, assembly, postage, and distribution of materials when necessary. * Maintain organized contact and distribution lists. * Assist with internal company communications and announcements. ### **Administrative \& Team Support** * Provide general administrative support to company departments and leadership as needed. * Assist with document preparation, formatting, scanning, filing, data entry, and electronic record organization. * Help coordinate company meetings, events, employee activities, community initiatives, and special projects. * Assist with ordering marketing materials, promotional items, and related supplies. * Provide backup administrative support and coverage when needed. * Work collaboratively with Operations, Human Resources, Accounting/Billing, project managers, technical departments, and company leadership. * Take on new responsibilities and special projects as the positio eds of the company. **Qualifications** ------------------ We recognize that great candidates can come from a variety of educational and professional backgrounds. **Recent college graduates and entry\-level candidates are encouraged to apply.** * Bachelor's or Associate's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, English, Public Relations, or a related field preferred, but not required. * **0–3 years of relevant professional experience.** * Internships, college projects, student organizations, freelance work, social media management, writing experience, or other relevant experience will be considered. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. * Ability to write, edit, and proofread professional content. * Comfortable using social media and learning to manage professional social media accounts. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. * Experience with Canva, Adobe products, social media platforms, or other creative tools is helpful but not required. * Previous proposal, engineering, environmental, or professional services experience is **not required**. * Ability and willingness to learn new technology, software, industries, and business processes. * Valid driver's license and ability to travel locally on an occasional basis for business purposes. **Who We're Looking For** ------------------------- More than a specific number of years of experience, we're looking for someone who is: * A strong writer and communicator. * Creative and interested in marketing, branding, and social media. * Organized and able to manage multiple projects and deadlines. * Detail\-oriented and takes pride in producing high\-quality work. * Curious and willing to ask questions and learn. * Comfortable taking initiative while also accepting feedback and direction. * Dependable, professional, and willing to follow through on assignments. * Comfortable collaborating with employees across different departments and levels of the company. * Flexible and willing to help outside of their primary responsibilities when jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Tools
jobs.description: Join the company that's building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world's biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what's next. We're one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we're remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd. **Why You'll Love This Role** You will help build Cribl Engineering's AI platform and productivity rails: the shared systems, runtimes, and workflows that let engineers use autonomous AI across the software delivery lifecycle. Instead of one\-off prompts or single\-feature AI experiments, you will focus on intent engineering, orchestration and harnesses, and production agent infrastructure that other teams can trust and extend. You will work with a small, high\-impact team alongside tech leads, principals, and partner engineering groups. You will ship systems that plan, implement, review, test, and operate work with strong guardrails, then drive adoption until those tools become part of how Cribl builds software. You will also bring a builder mentality: use the product yourself to solve real team and Engineering problems, then turn that lived experience into better systems. Cribl strives to be a great place to work for everyone. **As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…** * Design, build, and operate production agentic workflows and the platform harnesses they run on (orchestration, tool integrations, shared context, extension points for other teams) * Practice intent engineering: turn goals into clear specifications, rules, constraints, and acceptance criteria that AI systems can execute reliably * Stay current on AI tooling and practices, and evangelize what works across Engineering so partners adopt proven patterns * Engage hard in design discussions and healthy debate while the direction is open, then pivot with equal energy into implementation once the team decides * Build observability and guardrails: tracing, regression detection, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, safe rollout, and operability for agentic systems others depend on * Own critical pieces of agent runtime: job isolation, scheduling, execution environments, secrets and access, and production operations in the cloud * Design and operate event\-driven architectures where it fits (queues, streams, webhooks, async job fan\-out) so agentic systems stay scalable and loosely coupled * Ship safely and often: keep agentic systems on automated CI/CD paths with progressive delivery and clear rollback * Bring a builder mentality: dogfood what we ship. Use the platform to unblock yourself and the team, surface sharp edges, and turn real usage into product and platform improvements * Compress software delivery loops by improving how AI helps engineers write, test, review, debug, and validate changes in real repositories and pipelines * Partner across Engineering to understand workflows, ship tools that fit how people work, and drive adoption through playbooks, examples, demos, and enablement * Evaluate build vs. buy; stay current on models, agent frameworks, MCP\-style tool protocols, and the broader AI tooling ecosystem * Define and track success metrics for adoption, quality, reliability, and satisfaction; use feedback and data to decide where to invest * Partner on security and data access so tools are useful while respecting permissions and company policy * Take designed projects from zero to production: own the path from agreed design through implementation, rollout, and day\-two operability * This position may include stand\-by, on\-call, or off\-hours duties for systems you own **If You've Got It \- We Want It** * Staff\-level (or equivalent) professional software engineering experience building and operating production distributed systems * Strong TypeScript (and modern JavaScript) plus Node.js experience shipping production services; polyglot comfort is welcome, TypeScript is the primary stack for this team * Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to ship quickly: design, testing, debugging, APIs/services, and code quality * You have lived (or thrived in) a continuous deployment culture: automated pipelines, progressive delivery or safe rollout, monitoring and rollback, and a bias toward frequent, reversible production changes rather than infrequent manual releases * Hands\-on fluency with modern LLM and agentic coding workflows in production or serious internal platforms (not curiosity\-only) * Experience building backend services, integrations, automation, and internal tools; comfort across product surfaces when needed * Professional experience with agent orchestration, tool\-calling systems, evaluation or guardrail techniques, and connecting agents to reliable backend systems * Familiarity with agent frameworks, orchestration layers, and integrating external tools and data sources into LLM\-based systems (MCP or equivalent experience is a plus) * Experience with event\-driven systems: queues, streams, pub/sub, webhooks, or similar async patterns in production * Observability fluency: metrics, logs, traces, and using them to operate and improve production systems * Clear communication, documentation, and teaching ability; comfort driving adoption, not only writing code * Good judgment around security, permissions, data access, and safe tool rollout * Ability to problem\-solve from first principles, make sound trade\-offs, and drive work independently through ambiguity * **Nice to have** + Hands\-on Kubernetes in production + Terraform or similar infrastructure\-as\-code for cloud provisioning + Temporal or other workflow\-platform experience + Deeper AWS / cloud\-native ops fluency (IAM, networking, running production workloads end to end) \#LI\-JB1 \#LI\-Remote **Bring Your Whole Self** Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We're building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
