jobs.title: Systems Administrator I
jobs.description: Description: The System Administrator I is responsible for controlling and monitoring of the organization's systems infrastructure. This individual monitors the performance of systems to ensure maximum system uptime. Evaluates and monitors server utilization, applications, Operating Systems, domain integrity including server and software patching and potential firmware/software upgrades. This position also deals with a variety of complex issues, and the team member must rely on sound personal judgement and direction from IT Infrastructure Manager to decide on appropriate and necessary action. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities. Requirements: * Monitors and maintains the entire Credit Union Information Systems \& Server Infrastructure to ensure maximum uptime. Generates daily/weekly/monthly reports to measure performance, propose and take corrective action * Researches and recommends innovative, and where possible, automated approaches for system administration tasks. Identifies approaches that leverage company’s resources and provide economies of scale * Contributes to and maintains system standards, technical documentation and procedures * Ensures compliance with Member Information Security Policies and Procedures as well as other regulatory mandates * Participates in IT Systems Audits and examinations, as needed, and provides appropriate information to required resources * Performs regular file archival and purge as necessary, to clean up storage * Works with IT Infrastructure Manager and Network Engineer to develop IT budget and recommend IT related purchases ensuring most cost effective infrastructure solutions * Coordinates LAN/WAN and application server activities including establishing, installing, specifying system requirements, and maintaining network users, user environment, directories and security * Troubleshoots application server performance issues, creates, maintains and documents procedures including disaster recovery, security, anti\-virus, backup and restore situations * Manages upgrades \& security patches on all application servers and desktops using automation tools; troubleshoots issues related to patching to ensure all systems are patched * Reviews vulnerabilities identified through penetration tests or vulnerability scans and works to resolve them, based on service level agreements and severity * Perform daily backup operations, ensuring all required file systems and system data are successfully backed up to the appropriate systems, recommends changes to backup procedures to ensure most cost effective models; resolves any failures and monitors for disk space utilization * Performs ongoing performance tuning, hardware upgrades, and resource optimization as required following standard change control processes * Prepares and maintains documentation of server configurations and server layouts * Manages and documents licenses and usage for all application software, to ensure compliance with licensing * Coordinates, maintains and works with team to test IT related disaster recovery plans * Provides Tier 2 support to Desktop Support personnel * Performs other duties, as assigned, including Help Desk/Desktop Technician responsibilities * Provide on\-call support, including after\-hour, weekend and holiday as needed **Required Experience and Education** * High School Diploma * 1\-2 years experience with all aspects of systems administration (servers and endpoints) * Demonstrated ability to be fiscally responsible

jobs.title: AI Agent & Infrastructure - Lead Engineer
jobs.description: Working independently, the Lead Engineer owns development of software products and works on improving the overall quality of the product throughout the software development life cycle and mentors other Software Engineers. Reports directly to a Director or Senior Director.**Overview:** * Architects and builds the infrastructure and tooling that powers AI agent development across the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). * Develops production\-grade agentic systems, orchestration frameworks, and observability solutions that enable teams to build, deploy, and monitor reliable AI agents at scale. * Plays a key role in defining and implementing the next generation of SDLC through AI\-first innovation and comprehensive instrumentation. **What We're Looking For:** * You demonstrate sharp product sense for high\-impact automation opportunities, technical taste in implementation decisions, and the ability to clearly articulate trade\-offs. You know when to apply AI agent solutions versus simpler approaches and can explain the "why" behind architectural choices. * You excel at 0\-to\-1 (and 1\-to\-100\) product development, comfortable operating in ambiguous environments where requirements emerge through experimentation and iteration rather than upfront specification. **Key Responsibilities:** **AI Agent Development \& Automation** * Develop production\-grade AI agents that eliminate manual handoffs across the SDLC * Create custom integrations and CLI tools that give agents deep understanding of internal systems and codebases * Design comprehensive testing strategies to ensure agent reliability and output quality * Implement "Golden Path" scaffolding that embeds organizational standards into new projects * Build AI solutions that improve codebase navigation, documentation, and developer workflows * Identify workflow bottlenecks and deliver measurable impact through intelligent automation * Shape SDLC evolution by identifying AI\-first opportunities and proving outcomes through experimentation **Agent Infrastructure \& Platform:** * Architect and maintain production infrastructure supporting agent deployment, lifecycle management, and scaling * Develop agent frameworks, templates, and SDKs that accelerate agent development * Create governed Model Context Protocol (MCP) catalog enabling compliant agent\-to\-agent and agent\-to\-MCP communication * Implement governance controls for agent behavior, permissions, and system access **Observability \& Performance Analytics:** * Design and implement metrics, monitoring, and logging infrastructure for AI agents and development workflows * Build dashboards that provide actionable insights into developer productivity, tool adoption, and agent performance * Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks to quantify the impact of AI\-powered automation * Create alerting and anomaly detection systems to ensure reliability of agents and tooling * Analyze telemetry data to identify optimization opportunities and guide strategic investment decisions **Collaboration \& Impact:** * Partner across teams to drive adoption of AI\-powered tooling and process transformation * Stay current with LLM technologies and coach colleagues on AI\-assisted development and automation best practices * Rapidly prototype solutions to validate use cases and prove value quickly * Communicate data\-driven insights to stakeholders through clear visualizations and reports **Full\-stack technical proficiency:** * Languages: Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript * Frameworks: Angular, Spring Boot * CI/CD platforms and cloud infrastructure (AWS) * Monitoring/observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch) **Education/Experience Requirements:** -------------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline with at least 7 years of related experience, or equivalent training and/or work experience. * Strong system design experience * Strong experience in object\-oriented development * Strong experience with cloud technologies * Strong experience in data storage technologies * Strong experience in performance tuning and optimization * Strong experience in DevOps and CI\\CD technologies * Strong experience test automation and unit testing * Strong experience software security **Working Conditions**: * Hybrid work environment, with defined in\-person presence requirements. * Occasional travel and extended hours may be required. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: **Hi! We're Forerunner.** ========================= Stronger, more resilient communities are built by the people inside government and regulated industries who keep critical infrastructure running. But they're working against real headwinds: fragmented data, field crews without the right tools, and high\-stakes decisions made without a complete picture. Forerunner exists to fix that. We build intelligent software that connects the systems these agencies and firms already rely on, fills the gaps those systems can't, and turns fragmented information into decisions and actions that reduce liability, surface revenue, and prevent small problems from becoming emergencies. **About the role** ------------------ As a Deployment Specialist, you will own the end\-to\-end deployment experience for our customers — from discovery to go\-live — ensuring the outcome aligns with business impact. You’ll act at the intersection of strategy, project management, and operational delivery, collaborating with customers, internal teams, and technical resources to make deployments high\-quality, repeatable, and outcome\-driven. **What you'll do** ------------------ ### **Customer Discovery \& Planning** * Lead structured workshops with customers to uncover business objectives, operational constraints, and success metrics. * Translate findings into a clear deployment roadmap and set of deliverables. * Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and governance. ### **Project Leadership** * Serve as the primary point of contact for the customer during deployment. * Coordinate across cross\-functional teams (Forward Deployed Engineer, Customer Success Manager, other internal stakeholders) to ensure alignment and momentum. * Proactively identify risks, manage dependencies, and escalate when necessary. * Provide regular status updates to both the customer and internal leadership. ### **Solution Design \& Oversight** * Using both the product front\-end and Forerunner MCP, configure client systems and ensure system design stays aligned with business goals. * Work with the Forward Deployed Engineer to scope integrations and customizations. * Ensure that deployment deliverables map back to the business requirements and success criteria. ### **Customer Enablement \& Handoff** * Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) and drive readiness for go\-live. * Collaborate with the Customer Success Manager to ensure a smooth transition to the ongoing success phase. * Document lessons learned, refine the playbook, and drive continuous improvement across deployments. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 4\-6 years of experience in project management, SaaS implementation delivery, customer consulting, and operations. Experience with GIS or construction project management is a plus. * Strong ability to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured, executable plans. * Excellent communication skills with both technical and executive stakeholders. * Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, customer\-facing environment where you are building repeatable processes ### **You’ll thrive in this role if you…** * Believe in delivering measurable outcomes to customers, not just checking off tasks. * Enjoy being the glue across teams, driving clarity, and removing friction. * Are comfortable juggling strategic thinking and tactical execution. * Want to build and refine playbooks that scale, not just follow them. **Our team has a lot to offer.** -------------------------------- Forerunner is an early stage company with an interdisciplinary team. We are motivated by seemingly intractable problems and work hard to support one another. * **We're mission\-driven.** Our mission orients our business strategy and pushes us to work with a sense of urgency. We’re in the weeds \- our entire team spends time engaging with our partners in the field to better understand the real\-world problems they face. * **We're a small team.** As a member of our growing team, you will quickly become an invaluable part of our organization and have a meaningful impact on our business and technical direction. We welcome unique perspectives and backgrounds. Your opinion matters and we hope you'll share it. * **We value in\-person collaboration**. Some of our best work happens when we're solving problems together in the same room, so this role is hybrid and based near one of our offices: New York City, San Francisco, or Portland, Maine. * **We want you to be happy and healthy.** Forerunner offers competitive compensation, health/vision/dental coverage, and commuter benefits. We also have a quarterly wellness reimbursement so that you can have flexibility in defining what “health” means to you. The salary range for this position is 120,000\-165,000\. This posting may span more than one career level. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including an individual's skills, experience, and qualifications. Forerunner is an equal opportunity employer committed to embracing diversity and the perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds.

jobs.description: Process Engineer serves as a strategic partner to business leaders, shaping how the organization designs, governs, and scales its operations. This position leads complex, cross\-functional transformation initiatives, and is accountable for ensuring that process design decisions align with long\-term organizational strategy rather than isolated functional goals. Working across business units, technology teams, and executive stakeholders, the Process Engineer leads the end\-to\-end lifecycle of process transformation. initiatives from discovery through implementation, defining scope, milestones, risks, and expected benefits. * **Stakeholder partnership**: Present data\-driven recommendations to leadership, drive stakeholder alignment and change adoption, and coach Process Analysts and Consultants. * **Measurement \& governance**: Establish KPIs, baselines, and benefit\-realization metrics; build dashboards and scorecards; conduct post\-implementation reviews; design governance and control structures. * **Technology enablement**: Partner with technology teams to define requirements, workflow design, and automation opportunities (RPA, AI, process mining) that support—not overcomplicate—optimized processes. * **Implementation support**: Support testing, adoption, and post\-implementation validation of technology\-enabled improvements. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** This role does not have formal people leadership responsibilities but may provide guidance, mentorship, or subject matter expertise to others **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** * Advanced analytical and structured problem\-solving capabilities. * Strong process\-design and systems\-thinking skills. * Ability to translate complex operational issues into scalable solutions. * Strong facilitation, stakeholder\-management, and influencing capabilities. * Ability to lead complex initiatives with limited oversight. * Strong business acumen and understanding of downstream process impacts. * Ability to use data to develop recommendations and quantify benefits. * Ability to coach others in process\-improvement practices. * Strong written, verbal, and executive presentation skills. **Education Level** * Bachelor's Degree * Degree in Business, Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, or related field regulated, financial\-services, insurance, healthcare, technology, or other complex operational environment preferred. * Experience with process modeling, process mining, and/or analytical tools preferred. * Experience identifying and implementing automation, workflow, RPA, AI, or system\-enhancement opportunities preferred. **License/Certification Preferred** * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt * jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Data
jobs.description: The Director, Enterprise Data, is responsible for defining and executing Flexential's enterprise data strategy, governance framework, architecture roadmap, integration services, analytics enablement capabilities, and information management practices. This leader provides strategic direction and operational oversight for the people, platforms, architecture, governance, and operating model needed to make enterprise data trusted, reliable, discoverable, reusable, and fit for purpose. This role leads the Data vertical as a distinct function that works in a dotted\-line matrix with the AI vertical. The role owns the data foundation that enables analytics, operational integration, automation, and AI readiness, including governed data products, reusable pipelines, consistent metrics, metadata, lineage, quality, classification, and access controls. The successful candidate is a leader who balances long\-term strategy with near\-term execution and builds practical governance that enables the business rather than slowing it down. Success in this role will be measured by Flexential's ability to leverage trusted, governed, and reusable data assets through self\-service analytics, automation, and emerging AI capabilities that drive measurable business outcomes. **Key Responsibilities and Essential Job Functions** * Develop, maintain, and execute the enterprise data strategy and multi\-year roadmap aligned to Flexential priorities, measurable business outcomes, and AI readiness requirements. * Lead the evolution of Flexential's data capabilities from report\-centric delivery toward governed data products, trusted enterprise metrics, reusable business capabilities, self\-service analytics, automation, and emerging AI enablement that improve operational efficiency, accelerate decision\-making, and deliver measurable business value. * Establish a clear operating model for the Data organization, including decision rights, service ownership, delivery intake, prioritization, capacity planning, and engagement with business and technology teams. * Translate enterprise priorities into a sequenced portfolio of data platform, integration, governance, and data product initiatives, with clear outcomes, owners, dependencies, and measures of value. * Guide investment and rationalization decisions across the data ecosystem, favoring reuse, platform standards, and incremental modernization over unnecessary tool proliferation or wholesale replacement. * Partner with the AI vertical to identify the minimum viable governed data needed for priority AI use cases and sequence data work according to business value and readiness. * Collaborate with Enterprise Architects to ensure enterprise data architecture, integrations, models, and governance standards align with Flexential's broader technology strategy and future\-state architecture. * Own the future\-state enterprise data architecture and the standards that govern how data is sourced, moved, stored, transformed, secured, documented, and consumed. * Provide architectural leadership across the SQL Server\-based Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and Operational Data Store (ODS), including landing, staging, dimensional, fact, reporting, and operational schemas. * Establish and enforce data modeling, schema design, master and reference data, data lifecycle, interoperability, performance, reliability, and scalability standards. * Define authoritative systems of record and approved patterns for analytical, operational, and third\-party data exchange. * Ensure architecture decisions support governed data products, reusable semantic layers, historical analysis, operational reporting, automation, and AI consumption. * Lead the design, delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise data pipelines, APIs, integrations, transformations, and orchestration workflows. * Maintain clear separation of tool responsibilities: Boomi as the preferred platform for application\-to\-application, API, event\-driven, and near\-real\-time operational integrations; Pentaho Data Integration as the primary platform for batch analytics ingestion and data warehouse population; and custom code only for justified exceptions. * Establish reusable integration patterns, data contracts, error handling, retry, logging, monitoring, testing, deployment, and support standards. * Oversee SQL Server stored procedures and other in\-database transformations used for complex or performance\-sensitive processing, ensuring they remain maintainable, documented, and appropriately scoped. * Partner with application owners for Salesforce, NetSuite, ServiceNow, Workday, Anaplan, and other source or target systems to improve data reliability and reduce brittle point\-to\-point dependencies. * Establish and mature a business\-owned, enablement\-first enterprise data governance program with clear Data Owner, Data Steward, Domain Lead, and technical custodian responsibilities. * Create lightweight policies, standards, and decision forums d. * A pragmatic leader\-builder who can set strategy, make architecture decisions, coach a team, and personally work through ambiguity when the organization needs direction. * Balances enterprise standards with speed and recognizes that good governance creates clarity, trust, and reuse rather than process for its own sake. * Understands the full enterprise data lifecycle and can connect source\-system design, integration, storage, transformation, quality, metadata, reporting, and AI readiness. * Comfortable challenging fragmented designs, duplicated logic, weak ownership, and unmeasured work while proposing practical alternatives. * Trusted by business and technology partners for sound judgment, transparent tradeoffs, follow\-through, and an ownership mindset. * Thrives in an agile environment that uses Scrum, sprint planning, visible work management, and measurable outcomes to organize and accelerate delivery. * Builds a high\-performance culture grounded in accountability, curiosity, documentation discipline, operational resilience, reuse, and continuous improvement. **Base Pay Range** The annual salary range offered for this position is estimated to be **$175,000 \- $200,000**. However, the actual pay range depends on each candidate's experience, location, and qualifications. **Variable Pay** Discretionary annual bonus, based on personal and company performance. At Flexential, we value diversity and believe that different perspectives and unique skills make us stronger as a team. While we've outlined the qualities and skills we are looking for in this job posting, we understand that there may be attributes and abilities that aren't explicitly listed but could be a perfect fit for our team. We want to emphasize that you shouldn't hesitate to apply if you don't meet every requirement. We're enthusiastic about assembling a diverse team of individuals who bring various talents to the table. Your unique perspective and abilities may be just what we need to drive innovation and success. If you believe you have what it takes to thrive in our environment, we encourage you to apply. **Benefits of working at Flexential** * Medical, Telehealth, Dental and Vision * 401(k) * Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) * Life and AD\&D * Short Term and Long\-Term disability * Flex Paid Time Off (PTO) * Leave of Absence * Employee Assistance Program * Wellness Program * Rewards and Recognition Program *Benefits are subject to change at the Company's discretion.* **Work Location Eligibility** At this time, we are only able to employ individuals who reside and perform work in states where the company is authorized to do business and maintain employment registrations. We are currently unable to consider applicants who reside or will perform work in the following states: Arkansas, Alaska, Alabama, Delaware, Hawaii, Iowa, Kansas, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Wisconsin, Wyoming, Washington DC. jobs.title: Senior Estimator/Preconstruction Manager
jobs.description: Senior Estimator / Preconstruction Manager **Florida Palm Construction \| South Florida** Florida Palm Construction is a growing South Florida General Contractor and Construction Management firm specializing in commercial construction, tenant improvements, institutional projects, and select high\-end residential work. We are looking for an experienced **Senior Estimator / Preconstruction Manager** to lead our Preconstruction and Estimating Department. This is not simply an estimating position. We are looking for someone who can **own the preconstruction process \-** from the moment an opportunity enters our pipeline through estimating, proposal, award, and a successful handoff to our Operations team. The right person is an experienced construction professional who enjoys estimating but also wants to lead: improving systems, developing subcontractor relationships, managing priorities, identifying risk, mentoring others, and helping determine which projects Florida Palm pursues. What You'll Own **Lead the Estimating Pipeline** Manage approximately 8–10 active estimates at a time, establishing priorities, assigning workload, and ensuring deadlines are consistently met. Own each opportunity from initial review through bid submission and award, including: * Initial project and opportunity review * Conceptual and preliminary budgeting * Detailed estimating * Scope and bid package development * Subcontractor solicitation and coverage * Bid leveling and scope review * Value engineering * Proposal preparation * Client presentations and negotiations * Preconstruction\-to\-Operations handoff Manage clear internal milestones for every estimate so that projects are reviewed thoughtfully rather than rushed at the finish line. **Build Accurate, Competitive Estimates** Review drawings, specifications, addenda, contracts, and other bid documents to understand project requirements and identify risks, missing information, and potential scope gaps. Develop and review: * Conceptual and detailed estimates * Scopes of work and bid packages * Allowances and alternates * Exclusions and clarifications * Client proposals * RFIs and design clarifications Evaluate constructability, logistics, phasing, scheduling, long\-lead items, permitting, bonding, insurance, and other project\-specific requirements. **Lead Our Subcontractor Strategy** Develop strong relationships with subcontractors and vendors while continuously expanding Florida Palm's subcontractor network. Manage subcontractor solicitation and bid coverage across required trades. Review and level proposals, identify scope gaps and overlaps, negotiate pricing, and determine the appropriate numbers and qualifications to carry in the estimate. Work collaboratively with subcontractors, architects, engineers, and clients to identify value\-engineering opportunities and practical solutions. **Connect Sales, Preconstruction \& Operations** Partner closely with our Sales and Business Development team to evaluate incoming opportunities, determine project fit, and prioritize the company's estimating resources. Participate in our weekly Sales/Estimating meeting and provide leadership with clear visibility into: * New opportunities * Active estimates and upcoming deadlines * Bid coverage * Proposal status and follow\-up * Potential awards * Pipeline value * Estimating performance and hit rates * Department workload and staffing needs * Project and preconstruction risks For awarded projects, lead a comprehensive handoff to the Project Manager and Superintendent so Operations clearly understands the estimate, subcontractor proposals, assumptions, allowances, exclusions, schedule, procurement priorities, and known risks before construction begins. **Help Us Build a Better Preconstruction Department** We want someone who doesn't just work within a system; we want someone who helps us continuously improve it. You will help refine our estimating procedures, templates, historical cost data, subcontractor database, bid tracking, departmental KPIs, and SOPs. We are also actively integrating **AI automations to** improve estimating accuracy, productivity, follow\-up, reporting, and scalability. We want this person to manage this effort. **Who We're Looking For** Our ideal candidate has significant estimating and preconstruction experience with a General Contractor and is comfortable operating at both the **leadership level and in the details**. You should be able to lead a department while still personally taking ownership of complex estimates when needed. You will likely be successful in this role if you are: * Highly proficient in reading plans and specifications * Strong in conceptual and detailed estimating * Experienced with commercial construction and subcontractor buyout * Comfortable negotiating and building subcontractor relationships * Skilled at identifying scope gaps, constructability issues, and project risks * Organized and capable of managing multiple deadlines simultaneously * Confident communicating with owners, architects, engineers, subcontractors, and internal teams * Comfortable using data and KPIs to manage performance * Interested in improving processes rather than simply following them * A strong leader who holds yourself and others accountable * Calm under pressure and proactive when problems arise Commercial General Contractor experience is strongly preferred. Experience with tenant improvements, institutional work, ground\-up construction, and/or high\-end residential projects is a plus. **Why Florida Palm Construction?** Florida Palm Construction has built its reputation by **protecting our clients' investments through proactive communication, accountability, careful planning, and strong execution.** We are large enough to take on meaningful and complex projects, but small enough that great people have a direct impact on how the company operates and grows. For the right person, this is an opportunity to do more than produce estimates. You will have a seat at the table, influence which projects we pursue, help shape our systems and team, and play an important role in the next stage of Florida Palm Construction's growth. Benefits: * Competitive Bonus Structure * PTO and Company Holidays * 401k Matching * Health Insurance, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance * Opportunities for growth

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Electrical Equipment
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Austin, TX; Los Angeles; CA; New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Development **Compensation** ---------------- * $200K – $250K • Offers Equity *To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US\-based job postings. Our compensation package includes base salary, equity for all full time roles, benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans.* *This range reflects a good\-faith estimate based on the applicable pay scale, the range previously established for this role, the compensation of individuals currently in equivalent positions, and/or the budgeted amount for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, qualifications, and other factors.* *We welcome compensation discussions if this range doesn't meet your requirements. Outstanding candidates may be eligible for adjusted terms, plus meaningful equity that ensures you benefit directly from the company's long\-term performance.* *Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.* **About Fluidstack** ==================== We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built \- but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them \- with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization\-scale infrastructure for AI. **We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!** **How We Operate** ================== * **Be a barrel.** Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role. * **Insane urgency.** We drive everything forward as fast as possible. * **Reason from first principles.** Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins. * **Love of the game.** The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward. * **Build something that actually matters.** If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world. **The Engineering Program Management Team** =========================================== You'll join the technical program managers who run Fluidstack's infrastructure R\&D programs. This role sits with the Electrical Equipment product engineering group, which is designing the medium\-voltage switchgear, low\-voltage switchboards and busway, and prefabricated electrical skids and e\-houses that Fluidstack will manufacture in its own factory rather than buy from the market. Your job is to drive those designs from concept to a released, manufacturable product on a schedule the factory and the build can hold. **Examples of key problems the team is working on** * Taking equipment that the industry buys as catalog products and re\-engineering it as Fluidstack\-owned designs with a bill of materials, drawings, and test procedures a factory line can build to. * Running concept, preliminary, and critical design reviews across several equipment families in parallel and closing the actions they generate. * Qualifying the components and sub\-suppliers each design depends on, with second sources, before the design is frozen. * Handing a released design to manufacturing engineering with the documentation, tooling, and test plan needed for the first production lot. **Role Scope** ============== * **Drive the design program.** Own the integrated plan for one or more electrical equipment product lines from requirements through design release, and hold the engineering team to its gates. * **Run the design reviews.** Schedule and run concept, preliminary, and critical design reviews, capture decisions and actions, and close them before the next gate. * **Make it manufacturable.** Bring manufacturing engineering, quality, and supply chain into the design early so bills of materials, tolerances, and test procedures are ready when the design releases. * **Manage the component supply.** Track long\-lead components, sub\-supplier qualification, and second sourcing against the design schedule, and escalate what will slip. * **Hold the configuration.** Keep specifications, drawings, and change requests in one controlled set so the factory builds what engineering released. * **Report the truth.** Keep program status, risks, and spend visible to engineering leadership without waiting to be asked. **What We're Looking For** ========================== **The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,** **tell us where you would.** * 5\+ years of technical program management on electrical or electromechanical hardware that was designed and manufactured in house, ideally switchgear, switchboards, power distribution, or electrical enclosures. * You have taken at least one hardware product from concept through design release and first production lot, running the design review gates along the way. * You understand design for manufacturing, configuration management, and how a bill of materials, drawing package, and test procedure get a design onto a factory line. * You read electrical single\-lines, equipment schedules, and mechanical drawings well enough to catch a problem before the engineer does. * You have managed component suppliers and sub\-supplier qualification to a design schedule. * You write clear, short status that an executive can act on and an engineer will not dispute. * **Bonus:** Electrical engineering degree or PE license. UL 891, UL 1558, or IEEE C37 product certification experience. New product introduction in a low\-volume, high\-mix factory. We are committed to pay equity and transparency. Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law. *You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you* ***did not*** *receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application\- someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** **Your role at GEI.** The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data pipelines and integrations that power GEI’s AI solutions and digital initiatives. This role focuses on ensuring enterprise data is accessible, reliable, and governed so that AI capabilities can be deployed and scaled with confidence. The Data Engineer plays a hands\-on role by preparing and integrating the data foundations that AI solutions depend on. This includes building ingestion pipelines, managing data stores, implementing quality and governance controls, and supporting retrieval patterns such as RAG. This role works closely with AI Engineers, solution architects, and platform teams to ensure data infrastructure is production\-ready, secure, and aligned with GEI standards. **Essential Responsibilities \& Duties** * Design, build, and maintain data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver enterprise data to AI solutions and business applications. * Develop and manage integrations across enterprise data sources using APIs, Graph connectors, event\-driven architectures, and batch/streaming patterns. * Build and maintain data stores and indexing infrastructure that support retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and other AI consumption patterns. * Implement data quality, validation, and lineage controls to ensure accuracy and trustworthiness of data feeding AI workflows. * Support and optimize data models underpinning Power BI dashboards and AI\-enabled analytics. * Collaborate with AI Engineers to define data contracts and ensure pipeline outputs meet solution requirements for schema, latency, and freshness. * Instrument data pipelines for monitoring, alerting, cost control, and performance optimization. * Implement data governance and security controls including access management, encryption, and compliance with organizational data policies. * Identify data\-related risks and support mitigation strategies in collaboration with architecture and platform teams. **Minimum Qualifications** * 4\+ years of data engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to build and operate production data pipelines. * Proficiency in Python and SQL; experience with PySpark or Spark is strongly preferred. * Experience with Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure SQL. * Familiarity with Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB, or similar services used to support AI retrieval and storage patterns. * Experience building and managing ETL/ELT pipelines with structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data sources. * Knowledge of data modeling, schema design, and indexing strategies for both analytical and AI workloads. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD practices for data pipeline deployment (e.g., Terraform, Azure DevOps). * Knowledge of data governance principles, including data cataloging, lineage, access control, and privacy requirements. * Knowledge of security best practices for data solutions, including encryption at rest and in transit, role\-based access control, and private networking. * Experience with Databricks, including Delta Lake and Unity Catalog, is a plus. * Prior experience in professional services, engineering, or construction environments is a plus. * Azure or Databricks certifications (e.g., Azure Data Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Databricks Data Engineer Professional) are a plus. **We are GEI.** Some of the world’s most pressing problems – from climate change to sustainable development, to critical infrastructure and the future of our energy supply – need our brightest and diverse minds working together to create safer, more resilient communities for tomorrow. We are technical experts, collaborators, and entrepreneurs who draw from diverse backgrounds to solve our clients’ most complex challenges. With several offices across North America, we offer a range of engineering, science, and technical consulting services. Our range of expertise, project types, and culture make us the choice for top talent in the AEC industry. See all our office locations here. **Employee\-owned. We are committed to employee growth with career development opportunities, competitive total rewards, a well\-being program, flexible work arrangements and more. Our company culture is driven by our 4 Cs – we are Client\-Centered, Curious, Collaborative, and Community Minded – which support our focus on sustainability, safety, diversity, equity and inclusion. jobs.description: **Why Join GEICO?** At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities. Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide. jobs.description: **We believe power is a promise \- a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.** ===================================================================================================== For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future. Ready to Power a Smarter World with us? The Senior Control Systems Engineer position oversees the development, execution and delivery of control system projects for the Generac Advanced Manufacturing MOM (Manufacturing Operations Management) Team. Responsibilities include automation controls systems design, PLC/SCADA programming, simulation and testing, and start up commissioning. The Senior Control Systems Engineer also contributes to overall team performance by training/mentoring associates, providing technical assistance, and improving processes and standards. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Develop Machine Integration Plan and schedules for Manufacturing Execution System (MES); * Execute Machine Integration Plans – PLC/SCADA Programming, Testing, Start up Commissioning * Acts as the SME for plant IE/ME resources on control systems programing. * Prepare project deliverables including statements of work, status reports and budgets. * Ensure adherence to Company standards and methodologies; * Discuss needs with internal customers in a non\-technical language; * Analyze customer requests, understand need, and document in Functional Specification; * Translate functional requirements into System Design Specifications; * Develop programs to comply with system requirements; * Mentor and guide project team members to deliver on the project/program requirements; * Ensure customer acceptance by testing validation, and training users in changes to business processes. * Other duties as assigned. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering; * 5 \+ years’ experience with programming Industrial controls, PLC’s, HMI’s and Industrial communication protocols; **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor degree in Industrial Automation, Engineering, Computer Science or MIS; * Experience with PLC programming using Rockwell Logix and GE RXi Platforms; * Experience with GE Proficy Suite – Machine Edition, Cimplicity, iFix and Historian; * Experience configuring OPC Servers, Historians; * Thorough understanding of Industrial Communication Protocols \- Modbus, DeviceNet, Profinet; * Experience with SQL Server databases. * Experience successfully managing technical projects through the entire project cycle including initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, commissioning, and closing phases. * Formalized training and/or education in Industrial Automation, Engineering, Computer Science or MIS; * Experience implementing software used in 24x7 shop floor environments. **Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:** * Ability to develop and integrate software packages and solutions for industrial controllers. * Ability to establish strong working relationships with both technical and non\-technical members of staff. * Ability to be hands on with MOM software configuration, scripting and database connectivity; * Ability to communicate effectively in both written and oral format, with both vendors and internal customers; * Ability to multi\-task in a fast paced, dynamic environment; * Self\-motivated and driven to accomplish company goals. **Great Reasons to work for Generac:** * Competitive Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, 401k and many more * Scheduled events throughout the year that allow our employees, both current and retirees, to gather together and enjoy their time with their families and co\-workers * Pride! When a storm strikes, Generac employees always rise to the occasion. Each time a storm hits many employees volunteer their time with the customer support team or on the production line while others go right into storm\-affected areas to repair generators * We believe in having fun. From minor celebrations to major events, our employees balance their work by building a strong culture of teamwork and collaboration through a variety of occasions, including our Fun Days. * Every day is Jeans Day! Dress for your day. * Product loan and discount programs **Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear; and use hands to manipulate objects or controls. jobs.title: Program Engineering Manager – Software & Electronics Platform
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Work Arrangment:** **Hybrid:** This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Warren Technical Center, Warren MI or Milford Proving Grounds, Milford, MI three times per week, at minimum, or other frequency dictated by the business. **Our Mission:** At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human\-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next\-generation safety and entertainment features. Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale. **The Role:** ============= The Software \& Electronics Platform team is building the execution foundation for GM’s software\-defined electric vehicles. We are looking for a Program Engineering Manager (PEM) to lead, define, and organize the physical assets that make persistent HIL, night regression, Co\-Sim, CVF, and related validation environments effective for SDV2 and future platform architectures. This role is accountable for making complex work executable. You will establish the asset strategy, portfolio, standards, ownership model, configuration baseline, capacity plan, and lifecycle approach required to support platform and vehicle\-program commitments. You will work directly with the platform PEMs and APEMs to connect bench and lab readiness to integrated execution plans, milestone confidence, issue resolution, launch readiness, and recovery actions. You will also work directly for and with the Chief Engineer, translating platform strategy into investment priorities, physical infrastructure decisions, cross\-functional operating rhythms, and an enterprise\-ready model for onboarding future programs. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable shaping strategy with senior leaders, solving complex technical and infrastructure problems, driving disciplined execution across engineering organizations, and turning a collection of benches and labs into a coherent persistent capability. **What You'll Do:** **Define the persistent HIL and physical\-validation strategy** * Establish the current\-state and future\-state strategy for persistent HIL benches, night\-regression environments, Co\-Sim, CVF, and related physical validation assets. * Define and align asset purpose, capability, ownership, location, users, capacity, availability, lifecycle, upgrade path, and retirement criteria with the physical asset build team and engineering leaders responsible for testing * Build a prioritized physical\-asset roadmap aligned to SDV2, vehicle\-program timing, build events, launch needs, and future program onboarding. Identify common\-platform capabilities, program\-specific needs, capacity gaps, duplicated infrastructure, and obsolescence risks. * **Partner with the PEM to drive integrated execution** * Work directly with the PEMs to integrate asset readiness into the platform execution plan. * Translate physical infrastructure needs into accountable owners, dates, dependencies, decision points, readiness criteria, and recovery actions. * Provide a single, decision\-ready view of bench and lab readiness, open issues, configuration risks, capacity constraints, and milestone confidence. * Drive asset\-related issues across organizational and technical boundaries from ambiguity to ownership, decision, implementation, and verified closure. revenue engine. *Pipeline Management \& Forecasting* * Own the company's revenue pipeline reporting and forecasting processes. * Establish rigorous pipeline inspection and forecasting methodologies. * Develop and maintain dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline coverage, conversion rates, sales velocity, deal progression, win/loss trends, and forecast accuracy. * Partner with GTM leadership to identify pipeline gaps and develop strategies to address them. * Create a consistent executive\-level view of current and future revenue performance. *CRM \& Revenue Technology* * Own workflows, automation, reporting, and data standards. * Evaluate and implement technologies that improve sales productivity, intelligence, forecasting, and customer engagement. * Integrate CRM data with financial and operational systems where appropriate. *Sales Performance \& Productivity* * Develop metrics and reporting that measure sales\-team productivity and effectiveness. * Analyze performance by representative, territory, market segment, customer type, and sales stage. * Support territory planning, account segmentation, quota setting, and sales capacity planning. * Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, shorten sales cycles, and increase conversion rates. *Revenue Analytics* * Build a comprehensive revenue\-performance reporting framework for the executive team and Board. * Develop reporting around Key Metrics such as (ARR, Pipeline Coverage, Renewal/Retention, Win\-Rate, ACV, Sales Velocity, Forecast Accuracy, CAC, other) *Cross\-Functional Revenue Alignment* * Establish common operating processes across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partnerships, Finance, and Product. * Improve handoffs between functions throughout the customer lifecycle. * Develop a shared understanding of target accounts, opportunities, customer requirements, implementation status, renewals, and expansion opportunities. * Partner with Finance to ensure revenue sales organization. * Strong   Experience in healthcare technology, SaaS, AI, or enterprise software. * Experience selling to health systems, hospitals, health plans, or other healthcare organizations. * Experience with long, complex enterprise sales cycles. * Experience with Salesforce or another leading enterprise CRM. * Experience building Revenue Operations functions within a growing company. * Familiarity with SaaS metrics and financial concepts including ARR, ACV, NRR, GRR, CAC, LTV, pipeline coverage, bookings, and revenue forecasting. **About GW RhythmX** GW RhythmX is Its solutions are deployed across more than 150 health systems, touching more than 85M patients including 8M U.S. military veterans. SAIGroup is backed by a $1 billion commitment from Founder and CEO Dr. Romesh Wadhwani, a noted entrepreneur and philanthropist. Learn more at www.saigroup.ai and follow SAIGroup on LinkedIn. You'll create service estimates, design camera and access control systems, coordinate with fire alarm designers, perform material takeoffs, and build accurate, client\-ready proposals. Every proposal you send represents Gotcha to the client, and the install team builds from your design, so accuracy is critical. Beyond producing estimates, you'll own the estimating process itself and continuously look for ways to make it faster, more accurate, and more consistent. This can be a work from home position (95%/5%) for the right candidate, as in you do not report to an office everyday. Occasional office visits might be needed. This position will require site visits. \*\*\*This position requires significant experience in working with security products as an installer, estimator, or sales engineer. This is not an entry\-level role.\*\*\* Major Duties and Responsibilities Sales Engineering * Own estimates from start to finish: review the request, gather what's needed, research what you don't know, and deliver a complete, accurate proposal without needing to be walked through it. * Build every scope for the specific project in front of you. Templates are a starting point, but the equipment, scope language, and project type must match the actual job. * Perform accurate material and conduit/wire takeoffs from drawings using tools such as BlueBeam, Visio and AI * Verify every line item before submittal: correct part numbers, specs, colors, quantities, and supporting components (storage, power, mounting, licensing). * Specify products according to Gotcha's equipment standards and approved manufacturer lines. * Read and act on all communication, including emails you're CC'd on. When a commitment has been made to a client, make sure it's reflected in the proposal or change order. * Assist the sales team with site surveys and client meetings to identify technical or project challenges that affect cost, schedule, or expectations. * Document special conditions such as PPE, scheduling requirements, and scope provided by others so resources are in place and the project protects Gotcha's margin. * Evaluate bid documents and develop a submittal strategy that keeps Gotcha's expected profit. * Work with vendors so all costs are known before an estimate goes out. * Work with the admin team to keep parts and pricing current in our quoting software. * Create project designs so clients can approve device placement and the install team has a clear installation guide. * Revise designs and estimates with sales and the client as needed. Attend manufacturer trainings and webinars to stay current on products and maintain our manufacturer relationships. * **Process Improvement** * Continuously evaluate and improve Gotcha's estimating process: templates, checklists, parts databases, takeoff methods, and proposal workflow. * Research new tools, software, and integrations that improve speed and accuracy, and bring recommendations with a clear case for cost and benefit. * Use AI tools (such as ChatGPT or Claude) in day\-to\-day work, for example scope drafting, spec sheet research, bid document review, and proposal QA, while personally verifying everything that goes to a client. * Track estimate accuracy against actual job costs and use the results to refine pricing, labor assumptions, and standards. Document improvements so the process works for whoever touches it next * ### **Requirements** **What We're Looking For** * **Attention to detail:** You proofread your own work and catch your own errors. Client\-facing documents leave your desk free of typos, placeholder text, and leftover template language. * **Follows through on instructions:** You read the whole email, track what's been promised, and close the loop. * **Product knowledge:** You understand how CCTV, access control, gates, intrusion, and/or fire alarm products work, how they're installed, and how local codes affect them. You know the difference between a UPS and a PDU without looking it up. * **Independent problem solving:** When you hit something you don't know, you research it first (spec sheets, manufacturer support, drawings) and come with a proposed answer when you do need input. * **Tool proficiency:** Comfortable with takeoff and design software, and willing to learn ours (D\-Tools SI, ConnectWise, BlueBeam). * **Sense of urgency:** You make timely decisions without sacrificing accuracy. * **Planning and organizing:** You prioritize work, manage your own time, and set realistic plans. * **Communication:** You write clearly, listen, ask clarifying questions, and present well to clients. * **Documentation:** You keep project notes, client communications, and change orders updated so the team can track the job. * **Availability:** Able to work extended hours when deadlines require. * **Continuous improvement mindset:** You're not satisfied with "the way we've always done it." You spot inefficiencies, research better options, and take ownership of making changes stick. * **Tech\-forward:** You pick up new software quickly and are already using, or eager to use, AI tools to work smarter. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with D\-Tools SI, Visio, BlueBeam, HubSpot and/or ConnectWise * Manufacturer certifications (access control, VMS, fire alarm, etc.) * Experience estimating multifamily and commercial projects * Hands\-on experience using AI tools in a professional workflow Experience building or improving templates, checklists, or estimating standards * Working Conditions · Outside in heat/cold * Ladders * Construction sites * PPE as required by customer * Office Environment Physical Requirements · Ascends/descends ladders, scaffolds, stairs * Walk on project sites for 2\-3 hours * Sit at a computer Required Licenses * Georgia driver’s license and ability to drive a pickup truck or van. ### **Benefits** Benefits: · $70K\-85K salary DOE · Paid holidays · Paid vacation · Paid training · Company gas card

jobs.title: Battery Materials QC Technician
jobs.description: **About Graphenix Development Inc. (GDI)** GDI is creating the future of energy storage. GDI’s battery technology will allow electric vehicles to go much farther and batteries to last much longer. When a battery is running low, it will charge in a fraction of the time needed by conventional lithium\-ion batteries. But that’s not good enough, not even close. GDI is focused on safety, and we’ve got the technology to prove it. But even that’s not enough, which is why we need your help to make the apex lithium\-ion battery needed throughout the new economy. GDI is an investor\-backed company focused on electrode development, manufacturing, and advanced materials. Our team has decades of experience and holds over 40 patents. We create cutting\-edge technology that will make the world a better place. **Position Summary** We are seeking a Battery Materials QA/QC Technician to support internal quality assurance, incoming materials inspection, and process improvement activities within a battery research and development laboratory setting. This position will be responsible for inspecting and evaluating incoming anode materials, collecting and analyzing quality data, assigning numerical quality grades, and communicating results to battery engineers and scientists. The successful candidate will operate specialized scanning and inspection equipment with proprietary/internal software to evaluate incoming electrode materials against established quality specifications and criteria. The role will combine hands\-on laboratory work with data analysis, root cause investigation, quality trending, and process improvement. This is an excellent opportunity for an early\-career scientist or technician interested in developing expertise at the intersection of battery materials, quality control, data analysis, and manufacturing process development. **Key Responsibilities** **Incoming Material Inspection \& Quality Control** * Receive, identify, sample, and inspect incoming anode materials according to established procedures and specifications. * Operate specialized scanning and imaging equipment to inspect incoming electrode materials for defects, variation, and other quality characteristics. * Utilize internal software and analytical tools to process inspection data and evaluate material quality. * Analyze scanned material data and assign numerical quality grades based on established quality criteria. * Identify material defects, abnormalities, dimensional variation, surface characteristics, and other indicators of potential quality issues. * Compare incoming material quality against specifications, historical data, and established acceptance criteria. * Maintain accurate and complete records of incoming material inspections and quality grades. * Identify and document out\-of\-specification or unusual material conditions. * Maintain full traceability of material lots, samples, inspection results, and quality grades. **Data Analysis \& Quality Trending** * Analyze inspection and quality\-control data to identify trends, patterns, variation, and potential sources of material or process instability. * Develop and maintain spreadsheets, databases, reports, prepare presentations, and other tools used to track material quality. * Monitor quality metrics and communicate changes or trends to engineering and R\&D personnel. * Compare material quality across suppliers, lots, batches, and processing conditions. * Support development of statistical methods and quantitative approaches for evaluating material quality. * Help establish and refine quality thresholds and acceptance criteria using historical and experimental data. * Identify correlations between incoming material characteristics and downstream electrode\-processing or cell\-performance results. **Root Cause Analysis \& Corrective Action** * Participate in investigations of material\-quality issues, defects, and unexpected process results. * Perform structured root cause analysis using inspection data, historical trends, process information, and laboratory observations. * Work with engineers and scientists to identify potential relationships between incoming material quality and downstream process performance. * Support investigation and documentation of nonconformances and out\-of\-specification results. * Help evaluate corrective and preventive actions designed to reduce defects and improve material consistency. * Track the effectiveness of corrective actions through subsequent inspection and quality data. **Engineering \& Process Improvement Support** * Provide engineers and scientists with timely feedback regarding incoming material quality and observed trends. * Communicate material\-quality findings that may impact electrode processing, yield, or battery performance. * Work collaboratively with engineering teams to identify opportunities for process improvement and yield enhancement. * Support development of experiments and data\-collection plans designed to investigate quality  on to detail and ability to consistently identify differences and abnormalities in material or inspection data. * Comfortable working with computer\-based inspection and analysis systems. * Strong quantitative and analytical skills. * Ability to accurately collect, organize, analyze, and document data. * Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or similar data\-analysis tools. * Ability to follow standardized procedures while recognizing when results fall outside expected conditions. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively with engineers, scientists, and laboratory personnel. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with battery materials, electrodes, lithium\-ion batteries, or battery manufacturing. * Experience inspecting or characterizing anode or cathode materials. * Experience operating scanning, imaging, microscopy, or other inspection equipment. * Experience working with specialized laboratories. * Experience with statistical analysis, data visualization, SPC, or quality trending. * Familiarity with root cause analysis methodologies such as 5 Whys, fishbone/Ishikawa analysis, or similar structured problem\-solving approaches. * Experience working with material specifications, Certificates of Analysis, and lot\-level traceability. * Experience with laboratory information management systems (LIMS) or quality\-management systems. * Familiarity with DOE and experimental data analysis. * Experience working in a battery R\&D or manufacturing environment. **Key Performance Areas** Success in this role will be measured by the technician's ability to: * Enjoy hands\-on laboratory work * Accurately and consistently inspect incoming anode materials. * Produce reliable, repeatable material\-quality grades. * Identify quality trends and potential issues early. * Maintain accurate material and inspection records. * Support timely root cause investigations. * Translate inspection data into useful information for engineers and scientists. * Identify opportunities to reduce defects and material variation. * Contributes to increasing process yield and improving overall material quality. **Career Development** This position provides an opportunity to develop practical expertise in battery materials characterization, quality engineering, automated inspection, statistical data analysis, root cause analysis, and process improvement. The role is well suited for an early\-career candidate interested in progressing toward positions in battery materials engineering, quality engineering, process engineering, or battery R\&D. **Location:** Rochester, NY. **Compensation:** GDI offers competitive market compensation as well as medical, dental, vision, and a 401k matching plan, and stock options. This position is full\-time and pays hourly at the rate of $23\-30 per hour. **Eligibility**: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States and have reliable transportation. Please send a cover letter and resume to: apply@graphnx.com GDI is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices and laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. **Third Party Agency and Recruiter Notice** Agencies that present a candidate to GDI must have an active, non\-expired, GDI Services Agreement with the GDI Human Resources Department. Additionally, agencies may only submit candidates to positions that they have been engaged to work on by a GDI Human Resources Department. All resumes must be sent to the GDI Human Resources department under these terms, or they will be considered a GDI candidate. 6GswWdAOst

jobs.title: IT Field Operations Engineer
jobs.description: **The Role** ------------ The IT Operations Engineer is a mid\-level technical role responsible for independently supporting, troubleshooting, installing, and maintaining end\-user technology and core IT infrastructure across multiple business locations. This position builds upon the foundational responsibilities of the Associate IT Operations Engineer by taking greater ownership of assigned systems, resolving more complex incidents, and completing infrastructure work with limited supervision. The IT Operations Engineer serves as a reliable escalation resource for routine and moderately complex technical issues, contributes to projects and system improvements, and helps developing team members follow established standards. This role is expected to travel up to 40% to support company sites and participate in after\-hours, weekend, and holiday on\-call rotations. * This is a remote role that requires up to 40% travel. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- **End\-User Hardware and Application Support** * Independently troubleshoot, install, configure, repair, and maintain PCs, laptops, retail Point of Sale (PoS) systems, registers, receipt and label printers, iPads/iOS devices, VoIP phones, and related end\-user technologies. * Diagnose hardware, software, peripheral, account, and connectivity issues; implement solutions and document work performed. * Coordinate equipment deployments, replacements, moves, and lifecycle activities while minimizing disruption to business operations. **Technology Infrastructure Support** * Support and maintain Dell and Nutanix server environments, Windows Server 2016/2019, Meraki and Fortinet switches, firewalls, wireless access points, manufacturing IoT devices, ISP circuits, and related infrastructure. * Perform standard configuration changes, software installations, firmware updates, patching, testing, and preventive maintenance under established change\-management procedures. * Troubleshoot copper Ethernet and single\-mode fiber connectivity, network performance, wireless coverage, and site interconnectivity issues. * Take primary support ownership for assigned systems or locations while escalating high\-risk, highly complex, or architecture\-level issues to Senior Engineers or management. **Incident and Service Management** * Monitor, prioritize, investigate, and resolve incidents and service requests through the Freshservice helpdesk platform. * Proactively and reactively respond to alerts generated by the SolarWinds monitoring platform and other operational tools. * Act as an escalation resource for Associate Engineers on routine and moderately complex incidents. * Coordinate technical response activities during assigned incidents, communicate status to stakeholders, and engage Senior Engineers or vendors when broader leadership or advanced expertise is required. * Contribute technical findings to root\-cause reviews and implement approved corrective or preventive actions. **Project and Site Support** * Complete assigned portions of infrastructure upgrades, site openings, remodels, equipment refreshes, and technology deployments. * Review project requirements, identify technical dependencies, provide status updates, and communicate risks or delays to project leads. * Work effectively at offices, retail locations, manufacturing facilities, warehouses, and active construction sites, including environments that may be hot, cold, dusty, or temporarily without normal facilities. * Travel as required, including occasional last\-minute trips, to support business\-critical issues and scheduled project work. **Documentation, Standards, and Team Development** * Create and maintain accurate technical documentation, installation records, support procedures, diagrams, asset information, and knowledge\-base articles. * Follow and reinforce company standards for security, change control, incident management, equipment installation, and customer communication. * Provide practical guidance and knowledge sharing to Associate Engineers without serving as the team's primary mentor, technical authority, or highest escalation point. * Identify recurring issues and recommend practical improvements to system reliability, support processes, and operational efficiency. **On\-Call and Other Duties** * Participate in after\-hours, weekend, and holiday on\-call support rotations. * Support information systems planning, implementation, administration, and operational readiness across multiple IT functional areas. * Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by management. ### **Qualifications / Requirements:** * High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field preferred. * Flexibility to participate in on\-call rotations and travel up to 40%, including occasional last\-minute travel. * 3\+ years of progressively responsible experience in IT operations, infrastructure support, field services, systems administration, or a related technical role. * Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve moderately complex hardware, software, server, network, wireless, and connectivity issues. * Working knowledge of end\-user devices, retail PoS technology, Windows environments, server infrastructure, network equipment, monitoring platforms, and IT service\-management practices. * Experience performing installations, configuration changes, patching, equipment deployments, and preventive maintenance using documented procedures. * Ability to organize work, manage multiple priorities, communicate status, and complete assignments with limited day\-to\-day supervision. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and a professional approach when working with internal customers, vendors, contractors, and team members. * Ability to document technical work clearly and provide appropriate guidance to less\-experienced team members. * Ability to pass state cannabis licensing requirements, including federal background checks. * Valid driver's license and ability to meet company travel requirements, where applicable. **Physical and Work Environment Requirements** * Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and perform equipment setup, boxing, unboxing, mounting, and cable installation. * Ability to walk, stand, bend, kneel, climb stairs and ladders, use basic hand tools, take accurate measurements, and perform minor installation or carpentry\-related tasks when required. * Ability to work safely around low\-voltage cabling and electrical infrastructure while following company safety requirements and using qualified electrical personnel when required. * Ability to work in active construction sites and operational facilities where conditions may include heat, cold, noise, dust, limited access, or temporary lack of restroom facilities. \#LI\-REMOTE

jobs.description: **About Guild Technology Group** Guild Technology Group is a premier Value\-Added Reseller (VAR) and strategic IT solutions partner. software vulnerabilities. * Drive adoption of new engineering tools and technical standards by partnering with software\-development teams, gathering feedback, resolving adoption barriers, and continuously improving the developer experience. * Collaborate with Software Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Security, and other technical stakeholders to define technical technical solutions, or development practices in a complex software environment. * Ability to operate under broad direction, lead technically complex initiatives, collaborate across engineering functions, and influence technical decisions without relying on direct organizational authority. **Preferred** * Experience in Developer Experience, developer productivity, engineering enablement, reference architectures, technical standards, engineering scorecards, automated repository assessments, or reusable implementation patterns across multiple software\-development teams.
