jobs.title: Clinical Engineer Associate
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Healthcare needs a better rhythm: one that keeps care continuous and deeply human. Heidi is building an AI Care Partner that works alongside clinicians to make that possible. We're a team of doctors, engineers, designers, researchers, and creatives building tools that help clinicians stay focused on what matters most: their patients. In just 18 months, Heidi has given back more than 18 million hours to healthcare professionals, supporting 73 million patient visits in 116 countries. Today, more than two million patient visits each week are powered by Heidi worldwide. Backed by significant venture funding, we're growing rapidly across the US, UK, Canada, and Europe, partnering with leading health systems and thousands of clinicians globally. **The Role** ------------ As a **Clinical Engineer Associate**, you’ll be the person who makes Heidi actually work in the real world. Serving as the technical counterpart to the Applied AI Managers, you’ll work to translate customer business needs into agentic solutions helping customers realize what's possible with our platform. You'll own the full technical lifecycle from first deployment through to a thriving, self\-sufficient customer: building custom clinical and operational workflows, debugging production issues, and becoming a trusted technical partner to the clinicians and operational teams you work with. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Work directly with clinical and operational stakeholders to design and build custom workflows that fit how care is actually delivered. * Be the escalation point for complex agentic issues — diagnosing problems, coordinating with engineering, and closing the loop with the customer. * Lead demos, technical discussions, and solution architecture for clinical AI workflows * Define what success looks like for each deployed workflow, then build the evaluations that prove it * Visit the clinics and hospitals we work with, so you understand the teams we're building for firsthand * Own the margin trade\-offs on when to build, customise or roll out existing knowledge flows * Run the safety audits and recommend constant eval refinements **What you'll bring** --------------------- * 3\+ years in an implementation engineering, or customer\-facing technical role \- ideally in SaaS, healthtech, or enterprise software. * Comfortable owning ambiguous, high\-stakes problems end\-to\-end without a playbook. * Sharp communicator \- you can explain a complex integration failure to a CTO and a head nurse in the same breath. * Experience working embedded with enterprise customers or health systems is a strong plus. **Other Things To Know** ------------------------ * This role can be based in\-office in either New York or San Francisco. * You will work directly on North America's most important commercial problems. * You will have significant autonomy and ownership from day one. **The Way We Work** ------------------- * **Live Forever**: We build for healthcare's next decade, not next quarter. We set outrageous targets, lead healthcare forward, and follow the evidence, even when it's uncomfortable. * **Practice Ownership**: Everyone here carries the company. We raise the bar on hiring and excellence, own the outcome end\-to\-end, and focus on what matters over process. * **Move Fast, Fix Faster**: The more we do, the more we learn. We ship atoms daily, learn from every release, and stay precise at pace. * **Get Better**: The best clinicians teach. So do we. We live in clinicians' reality, bring warmth to the work, and choose clarity, not cleverness. **Why You Will Flourish With Us** --------------------------------- * Become an owner, with significant shares (equity) in the company. If Heidi wins, we all win. * Healthcare, Dental and Vision benefit options. * 401k with 3% match. * $100/month Healthy Heidi's budget. * $700/year learning and development budget. * $500 home office setup budget. * Recharge Days after major pushes. * The rare chance to create a global impact as you immerse yourself in one of the world's fastest\-growing healthtech companies.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Technical Product Owner
jobs.description: * Plano, Texas, United States * IT, Software \& Digital * Experienced Professionals * 21098 **Drive Platform Strategy and Technical Excellence** ---------------------------------------------------- We are looking for a Senior Platform Technical Product Owner to join our organization. This is a high\-visibility, business\-critical role responsible for shaping and delivering the platform capabilities that power multiple software applications and teams across the business. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with product ownership discipline, someone who can converse fluently with engineers about architecture and trade\-offs, while also owning the tactical roadmap, backlog, and stakeholder relationships that make a platform successful. You will work across multiple software applications and engineering teams, acting as the connectivity between business needs, architecture, and execution. You will be a key partner to the Head of Software Platform in defining platform strategy and ensuring the platform serves as a genuine enabler for the rest of the organization. **What You'll do** ------------------ Product Ownership \& Strategy * Co\-own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Software Platform, aligning it with broader business unit and company objectives. * Translate business goals into a clear, prioritized backlog of epics, features, and technical initiatives. * Define and track success metrics for platform capabilities, and report on value delivered to stakeholders and leadership. * Balance short\-term delivery needs against long\-term platform health, technical debt, and scalability. Technical Depth \& Cross\-Application Coordination * Develop a working technical understanding of the platform's architecture, APIs, data flows, and integration points across multiple applications. * Partner directly with engineering, architecture, and DevOps teams to evaluate technical trade\-offs, feasibility, and sequencing of work. * Coordinate dependencies and priorities across multiple software applications and teams that consume or contribute to the platform. * Participate in technical design discussions and provide product input on architecture decisions, APIs, and system integrations. * Understand and help manage platform\-level concerns: scalability, reliability, security, observability, and performance. Backlog \& Delivery Management * Own and refine the product backlog. Write clear, well\-structured business specifications, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements. * Work closely with Delivery Leads to plan sprints, releases, and roadmaps. * Make day\-to\-day prioritization decisions and trade\-off calls in collaboration with engineering leads. * Identify and manage risks, blockers, and dependencies across teams. Stakeholder Management \& Communication * Serve as the primary point of contact between engineering teams and business stakeholders (business units, leadership, and other product owners). * Gather, synthesize, and prioritize requirements from multiple internal stakeholders with competing needs. * Communicate roadmap, progress, and trade\-offs clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Represent the Platform in cross\-functional forums, steering committees, and planning sessions. AI\-Enabled Product \& Engineering Practices * Champion spec\-driven development practices, ensuring requirements and acceptance criteria are structured clearly enough to be consumed by both engineers and AI coding/agentic tools. * Evaluate and help introduce AI\-assisted engineering workflows (e.g., AI coding assistants, agentic development tools) into the platform's delivery process, in partnership with engineering leads. * Identify opportunities to apply AI/ML capabilities within the platform itself (e.g., business\-critical features, automation, intelligent tooling, developer productivity features) and incorporate them into the roadmap where they add clear value. * Stay current on AI engineering trends and tooling and help the team assess build\-vs\-buy and adoption decisions for AI\-related platform capabilities. Leadership \& Mentorship * Act as a senior voice within the Technology and Product organization, mentoring junior product owners as needed. * Champion product and agile best practices across the platform teams. * Contribute to the continuous improvement of how the Software Platform team operates. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * This position is not eligible for employer\-sponsored work authorization or visa sponsorship (including initial, transfer, or extension), and candidates must be authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and remain authorized for the duration of employment without the need for sponsorship. Required Qualifications * 7\+ years of experience in product management/product ownership roles, with significant experience in technical or platform products (not purely customer\-facing feature teams). * Demonstrated expe ucts that span multiple applications, services, or systems. You understand integration complexity, not just single\-app feature delivery. * Strong technical fluency. Comfortable reading architecture diagrams, understanding APIs/microservices, discussing data models, and engaging credibly with engineers on technical trade\-offs. (Does not need to be a hands\-on coder, but must have real technical grounding.) * Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum environments as a Product Owner (certification a plus: CSPO, SAFe POPM, or equivalent). * Strong experience managing and prioritizing a backlog with competing stakeholder demands, at senior/enterprise scale. * Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, able to translate between engineering and business language fluidly. * Experience defining and tracking product/platform KPIs and communicating outcomes to leadership. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with platform engineering concepts: internal developer platforms, shared services, API gateways, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP). * Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns (event\-driven architecture, message queues, REST/GraphQL APIs, MCP). * Experience in a role that required coordinating across 3\+ engineering teams or business units simultaneously. * Background in a regulated, complex, or large\-scale enterprise environment. * Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence and Miro. * Experience working with or adopting AI engineering practices, such as AI coding assistants (e.g., Kiro, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot), agentic development workflows, or spec\-driven/AI\-assisted delivery processes. * Understanding of how AI/ML capabilities can be applied within a software platform (e.g., intelligent automation, developer tooling, copilots for internal teams), and how to evaluate their product value. * Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM\-based tooling, or MCP (Model Context Protocol)–style integrations is a plus, even if not hands\-on. * Prior hands\-on technical experience (developer, QA engineer, DevOps, or solutions architect background) is a strong plus. **What’s In It for You** ------------------------ In addition to a competitive base salary and bonus potential, we offer a robust benefits package including a generous paid time off policy that includes vacation, personal days, health \& wellness, and 2 days per year to give back in your local community, paid family leave, educational reimbursement, 401(k) matching, medical/dental/vision coverage, and a variety of other benefits to fit the needs of our employees. **Why Hilti** ------------- Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork. **Commitment to Inclusion** --------------------------- At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together. Hilti, Inc is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

industrial field service experience** * **3\+ years of hands\-on field service experience** with rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, or similar systems) * **3\+ years of experience PMT focuses on improving operational efficiency, reliability, and safety through innovative products and integrated solutions, including rotating equipment services that optimize asset performance and uptime. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Perform field service activities with **100% compliance to safety regulations and mandatory training requirements** * Provide technical support for **centrifugal pumps and compressors, including API and non\-API equipment** * Lead installation, pre\-commissioning, commissioning, and startup activities at customer sites ( **3–5 projects/month typical workload** ) * Troubleshoot complex failures involving **mechanical, electrical, process, and control system issues** * Utilize PLC and control system logic to diagnose and optimize equipment performance * Lead **Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA) investigations (minimum 2–4 per quarter depending on workload)** * Create and manage service cases in **CRM systems (e.g., Microsoft CRM or equivalent platforms)** * Train customers and channel partners through **quarterly or scheduled technical training sessions (1–4 per quarter)** * Oversee on\-site work performed by customer technicians to ensure **OEM/API compliance standards are met (100% adherence required)** * Generate accurate and timely technical reports, warranty evaluations, and service documentation ( **within 48–72 hours of site activity completion** ) * Perform equipment evaluations to determine **warranty vs. non\-warranty failure classification** * Support rebuild, repair, and retrofit activities of rotating equipment per OEM specifications Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission\-focused execution. Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else. Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next. Every horizon. Every mission. Every day. Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on\-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board. As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17\.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com Engines \& Power Systems provides the propulsion, auxiliary power and electrical systems that keep aircraft flying. With engines across roughly 120 aircraft types and more than 47,000 APUs in service today, we support operators across commercial and defense markets — backed by an aftermarket network built for the long service life of every platform we power. As a Software Engineer II here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will contribute to the design, development, and implementation of software solutions that support aerospace applications. You will work on innovative projects that enhance the performance, safety, and reliability of aerospace systems. You will report directly to our Space Sr Engineering Manager and you’ll work out of our Moca, Puerto Rico location on an On\-site work schedule. In this role, you will impact the development of critical aerospace software components that enable advanced aircraft systems and improve overall flight experience and safety. At Honeywell, our people leaders play a critical role in developing and supporting our employees to help them perform at their best and drive change across the company. Help to build a strong, diverse team by recruiting talent, identifying, and developing successors, driving retention and engagement, and fostering an inclusive culture KEY RESPONSIBILITIES * Develop, test, and maintain software components for aerospace systems in accordance with project requirements and industry standards. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including hardware engineers, systems engineers, and quality assurance to ensure seamless integration and high\-quality deliverables. * Participate in code reviews, debugging, and troubleshooting to enhance software performance and reliability.

With engines across roughly 120 aircraft types and more than 47,000 APUs in service today, we support operators across commercial and defense markets — backed by an aftermarket network built for the long service life of every platform we power. **Job Summary** We are seeking a motivated, early\-career **Systems Engineer II** to join our aerospace engineering division. In this role, you will be pivotal to our digital engineering transformation and new product development, applying **Requirements\-Based Engineering (RBE)** and **Model\-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)** methodologies to develop next\-generation aerospace systems. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to translate complex stakeholder needs into robust technical requirements and system architecture. You will work with the lead System Architect to support architecture definition and execute trade studies. standards, integration patterns, and reusable connectivity frameworks * Build and manage ETL/ELT pipelines, orchestration frameworks, event\-driven processes, observability, monitoring, retry strategies, and operational support * Design secure and compliant data movement across internal, external, and regulated environments * Lead integration efforts with banking and payment systems, including ACH, wire processing, payment networks, custodians, and financial infrastructure providers * Develop integration endpoints and services supporting Salesforce, workflow platforms, customer applications, and external partners * Create data structures and architectures optimized for AI agents, machine learning models, retrieval systems, and intelligent automation * Establish scalable architectural patterns that support future business capabilities while minimizing technical debt * Partner closely with business and technology teams to translate business processes into scalable technical solutions * Evaluate emerging technologies related to AI, data engineering, integration platforms, and cloud architecture **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, integration engineering, platform engineering, solution architecture, or related technical roles * Demonstrated experience building platforms with limited resources and small teams, with a track record of delivering practical solutions that scale as the business grows * Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise data platforms from architecture through production support * Hands\-on experience integrating with banking, payment, fintech, or financial services platforms * Strong experience designing APIs, integration services, event\-driven architectures, webhooks, and distributed systems * Deep understanding of data modeling, canonical data design, master data management, governance, lineage, and data quality practices * Hands\-on jobs.title: WordPress Developer
jobs.description: JLOOP is a creative agency building unforgettable digital products for enterprise customers world wide. We're on the hunt for a full\-time WordPress Developer employee and teammate. This junior role handles new site builds, content updates, targeted front\-end changes, and hands\-on troubleshooting, identifying whether issues originate in plugins, themes, or custom code and resolving them within their capabilities. This role supports a portfolio of approximately 80 and growing WordPress sites across JLOOP and Athena Advisors, including custom themes and sites built with several page builders, like Elementor. The work centers on maintaining and extending existing websites using established designs and client requirements. You'll collaborate daily with Producers, PMs, designers, and developers to clarify requests, implement changes, verify results, and escalate more complex technical issues. **KEY FOCUS AREAS** **1\. New Site Builds and Content Implementation** * Build new WordPress pages and sites from clear requirements, working from approved UX/UI designs when they exist and using sound design judgment to fill gaps on the fly when they don't * Manipulate and optimize images and other graphics for web use (resizing, cropping, compressing, format conversion) before adding them to a page or build * Update pages and create content directly in the WordPress dashboard, including adding, replacing, and removing text, modules ,documents and media assets. * Work across Elementor, WPBakery, and Gutenberg blocks, adapting to the themes and page builders already in use. Familiarity with Divi is helpful. * Investigate custom themes and inherited site structures before editing, identifying how content, templates, and styles connect. * Repurpose approved designs and existing components to build or revise content while preserving established layouts, branding, and user flows. * Check content accuracy, links, document access, and page layout before marking an update complete. * Clarify incomplete requests with the PM or Producer and flag work that requires new design direction or more advanced development. *The WordPress Developer turns clear requirements, available design direction, and supplied graphics into new sites, and routine content requests into accurate, consistent updates, across the client website portfolio.* **2\. Front\-End Development and Responsive Behavior** * Read inherited CSS and use browser developer tools to diagnose styling issues and make targeted changes without disrupting other pages. * Apply intermediate CSS skills and basic HTML knowledge to troubleshoot layouts, spacing, typography, and content presentation. * Use foundational JavaScript and jQuery knowledge to understand existing behavior, place provided scripts, and verify that they work as intended. * Add, remove, or modify approved third\-party scripts and front\-end code according to client specifications. * Check that layouts and functionality transition correctly across desktop, tablet, and mobile, correcting issues within the assigned scope. * Coordinate with designers and developers when a change requires a new interaction, custom scripting, or a broader technical solution. *The WordPress Developer makes focused front\-end changes that preserve approved designs and work across screen sizes.* **3\. WordPress Troubleshooting and Site Support** * Reproduce WordPress issues and determine whether the cause is a plugin, theme, custom code, or content configuration. * Understand parent and child theme relationships and investigate theme behavior before applying changes. * Work with Gravity Forms and Advanced Custom Fields, troubleshooting form behavior, field configuration, and how field content appears on the site. * Resolve issues within junior\-level capabilities and escalate complex PHP debugging or custom development with clear findings and reproduction steps. * Understand WordPress migrations, including databases, URLs, themes, and media assets, and assist with migrations under technical guidance. * Navigate a MySQL database and understand its relationship to WordPress content and configuration; advanced raw SQL development is not required. * Verify fixes in the appropriate test environment and check affected pages and functionality for unintended changes before release. *The WordPress Developer diagnoses issues methodically, fixes what they can, and gives senior developers clear evidence when escalation is needed.* **4\. Forms Integrations and SEO Implementation** * Configure and troubleshoot forms against supplied requirements, checking validation, submissions, and expected data handling. * Implement provided integration specifications, including form data passed to Salesforce; Salesforce expertise is not required. * Place and verify supplied Google meta tags and other approved tracking or integration code. * Implement the marketing team’s SEO instructions using Yoast, including meta descriptions and approved keyword content. * Confirm that form, integration, and SEO changes meet the request and communicate missing specifications before delivery. *The WordPress Developer translates supplied marketing and integration requirements into working, verified website changes.* **5\. Uphold Development Standards \& Clear Communication** * Follow JLOOP’s established development workflows, documentation practices, and review requirements for assigned WordPress work. * Stay aligned with Producers and PMs on priorities, scope, timelines, and completion expectations across multiple client sites. * Report blockers and technical risks early, describing what was found, what has been tried, and where additional expertise is needed. * Document changes, troubleshooting findings, and verification results so teammates can understand and continue the work. * Keep relevant code, files, and version history organized according to the project workflow. * Build deeper knowledge of the portfolio’s themes, plugins, and page builders and share useful troubleshooting lessons with the team. *The WordPress Developer delivers dependable work through clear communication, consistent verification, and documented handoffs.* **Requirements** * Hands\-on WordPress experience with content updates, page builders, and troubleshooting; able to explain their specific contributions to example sites. * A methodical problem\-solver who can isolate plugin, theme, and custom\-code issues and explain their reasoning in a live WordPress sandbox. * Intermediate CSS skills, basic HTML understanding, and foundational JavaScript and jQuery familiarity, including use of browser developer tools. * Comfortable with Elementor and able to work across WPBakery, Gutenberg, and inherited custom themes; Divi familiarity is a plus. * Experience working with Gravity Forms and Advanced Custom Fields, including troubleshooting an implementation against specific requirements. * Understands responsive web behavior, WordPress migration components, and how to navigate a MySQL database. * Practical design judgment and general SEO knowledge, including hands\-on Yoast work and implementation of approved designs and marketing direction. * Organized and collaborative; communicates clearly, manages varied client requests, and knows when to ask for technical guidance. * Nice to have: PHP familiarity and debugging experience, theme modifications, or custom WordPress functionality, supported by code examples where available. * Nice to have: WordPress core, plugin, and theme maintenance; failed\-update troubleshooting; Plesk, hosting, and WordPress API familiarity. Success Criteria NOTE: the success criteria shared below are proposed examples for this role and are subject to final alignment. * Follows established WordPress delivery workflows and completes assigned work against agreed requirements and priorities. * Content updates and front\-end changes match approved designs and function correctly across desktop, tablet, and mobile. * Diagnoses WordPress issues accurately, resolves problems within their capabilities, and escalates complex issues with actionable evidence. * Form, integration, and SEO changes meet supplied specifications, with verification results and changes clearly documented. * Communicates progress and risks promptly and incorporates feedback from technical teammates, Producers, and PMs. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Work From Home

jobs.title: Operations Automation Specialist
jobs.description: ### **About Lantern** Lantern is the specialty care platform connecting people with the best care when they need it most. By curating a Network of Excellence comprised of the nation's top specialists for surgery, cancer care, infusions and more, Lantern delivers excellent care with significant cost savings to employers and their workforces. Lantern also pairs members with a dedicated care team, including Care Advocates and nurses, for the entirety of their care journey, helping them get back to good health, back to their families and back to work. With convenient access to specialists nationwide, Lantern means quality care is within driving distance for most. Lantern is trusted by the nation's largest employers to deliver care to more than 6 million members across the country. Learn more about us at lanterncare.com. Job Overview As an Operations Automation Specialist, you will personally resolve provider inquiries — and then build the tools that make resolving them one\-by\-one unnecessary. Today, resolving a provider's question well requires detailed manual auditing and review across multiple systems. It's careful work, and it doesn't scale. The data needed to answer these questions faster and more accurately already exists across our data sources — and modern AI tools give us the opportunity to bring that work together and scale it in a way we haven't yet. You'll start by doing the job as it exists today: working real provider inquiries, learning the systems, and building the judgment that comes from firsthand experience with the problem. From there, your job shifts toward building — using AI\-assisted workflows to resolve inquiries faster, surface patterns worth fixing at the root, and move providers toward getting their answers without needing to contact us at all. This is a new kind of role for Lantern, built specifically because this problem is ready for it. This is a technical role in the lowercase\-t sense: you don't need to arrive as a software engineer, and this isn't the data\-analyst track either — it's for people with the instinct to spot patterns and automate them away, even without the formal technical background yet to do it at scale. For the right person, it's a deliberate stepping stone toward more technical roles at Lantern over time. We're deliberately not writing this as a data\-engineering job. Someone who already codes fluently can thrive here, but so can a business\-minded person with real communication skills and the drive to build — the second profile is just as much the target as the first. We're not narrowing this to one experience level. A recent grad with the right instincts is a big part of who we want in the pipeline — but so is someone with five or ten years of practical business experience who has been deliberately building toward exactly this kind of role. More time doing the work often means sharper pattern recognition, not a worse fit. We'll teach you the domain — you don't need to know claims or healthcare going in. What we won't do is teach you SQL or Claude Code step by step; the expectation is that you go figure new tools out largely on your own, the same way people have always picked up new tools on the job. What You'll Do: Resolve, hands\-on * Work a live queue of provider claims inquiries — status, payment amount, denial and rejection questions, aged\-claim batches — through to accurate resolution * Audit individual claims across systems to confirm they were submitted, validated, priced, and paid correctly * Escalate genuine pricing or appeals determinations, and document what you learn so the pattern can eventually be automated Understand the problem at scale * Query claims, pricing, and provider data directly using SQL — you'll pick up our specific tools (including Databricks) on the job — to characterize inquiry volume, root causes, and cost to serve — much of which isn't measured today * Separate inquiries caused by real payment problems from inquiries caused by providers simply lacking visibility — they need different fixes Build the fix * Design and build AI\-assisted workflows that triage inquiries, retrieve the relevant claim and contract facts, validate payments, and draft accurate, provider\-ready responses * Build in verification, not just automation — a confident wrong answer about a payment amount is worse than a slower correct one * Test against real ticket volume, measure impact honestly, and iterate Push upstream * Where a category of inquiry traces back to a fixable upstream issue — deferred claims, ingestion errors, notification gaps — work the root cause, not just the symptom * Contribute to provider self\-service so fewer questions need to reach us in the first place About You: We're looking for someone with the business and communication fundamentals to do this job well today, plus the eagerness to build the automation that makes it unnecessary tomorrow. This is not a data\-engineering posting — a business background, a support/ops background, uter science degree — you're not building distributed systems, you're using tools that already exist to make an operational process dramatically better * Already being an expert in SQL, Python, or AI tooling — what we're looking for is real curiosity and a track record of teaching yourself new tools; we'll give you real problems, context, and room to grow into them, not a step\-by\-step curriculum * Hands\-on experience with Databricks or other enterprise data\-engineering tooling — that's specific to our internal stack, and you'll pick it up here with real access and context once you're on the team * Any specific number of years of "AI experience" — the tools are too new for that bar to mean anything yet; genuine, demonstrated use matters, not tenure **What Success Looks Like** At 3 months: You're resolving provider inquiries independently, including complex ones. The inquiry population is measured and segmented for the first time. At least one AI\-assisted workflow is live and measurably cutting down manual handling. At 6 months: A growing share of provider inquiries are resolved without a manual research step. Cost per resolved inquiry is down, resolutions per person are up, and more providers are getting answers without needing to contact us at all. **Location \& Logistics** Hybrid \| Dallas, TX or New York, NY \| 3 days per week in office (required due to the sensitivity of the data this role handles) Lantern does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in the provision of employment opportunities and benefits. **Benefits:** * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Short \& Long Term Disability * Life Insurance * 401k with company match * Paid Time Off * Paid Parental Leave **Compensation**: Base salary range: $90,000–$120,000, depending on relevant experience, location, and qualifications. **About You:** * You use **LOGIC** in your decision making and understand that progress is critical to making change. You focus on the execution of your content while balancing a fast\-paced environment and you take the time to celebrate both the small \& big wins. * **INCLUSION** is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. A diverse and inclusive environment is incredibly important to you. You understand and desire to be a part of a diverse team with different experiences and perspectives \& you cherish the differences in each individual that you interact with. * You have the **GRIT**, drive and ambition to tackle big problems. Big problems require big ideas and a team that supports new ideas. * You care deeply for your customers are driven to keep **HUMANITY** in all decisions. Your customers aren't just the individuals using your product. They are the driving factor in your motivation to make a change. * Integrity guides you in life. Focusing on the **TRUTH** vs. giving people the answers they want to hear. * You thrive in a Team Environment. Collaboration is key in innovation and creating change. These pillars of **LIGHT** are a reminder to our team that we are making a difference by providing guidance and support in navigating the often complex and confusing landscape of healthcare. We hope that through this **LIGHT**, individuals can find their way to the best care, resources, and support they need to get back to life. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect to speak further about career opportunities at Lantern. Please apply to our role \& someone from our Talent Acquisition Team will reach out to help you navigate our interview process. Lantern does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Accelerator Safety System Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: Lawrence Berkeley National Lab’s (LBNL) Engineering Division has an opening for an **Senior** **Accelerator Safety System Engineer** to join the team. You will be responsible for ensuring that the safety systems of the Advanced Light Source (ALS), the Berkeley Lab Laser Accelerator (BELLA), the 88\-Inch Cyclotron, and other radiation\-generating facilities and systems at LBNL meet regulatory and programmatic requirements. The BELLA Center uses one of the world’s most powerful lasers in its campaign toward the next landmark in laser plasma accelerator energy — 10 GeV — and is developing numerous spinoff applications. The ALS has been a global leader in soft x\-ray science for more than two decades and is currently undergoing a large\-scale upgrade (ALS\-U) that will endow the facility with state\-of\-the\-art x\-ray capabilities. It's an exciting time to join our team! The Senior Accelerator Safety System Engineer will direct the efforts of Engineers, Associate Engineers, and Technicians, while collaborating with Engineers and Scientists within LBNL, DOE labs, and the international accelerator community, and reporting directly to the Lead Accelerator Safety Systems Engineer. As part of the Engineering Division, you will join a workforce of dedicated 300\+ engineers working closely with our science partners. The largest accelerator project at LBNL is the Upgrade of the Advanced Light Source (ALS\-U). Therefore, this position will initially support completion of the design and implementation of the ALS\-U safety system. Your responsibility will require you to support a team of engineers in analyzing, designing, implementing, and testing the Safety Interlock Systems. It will also require analysis of the existing ALS Safety System and an implementation that preserves the functionality of the existing safety systems. In the function as labwide safety engineer, you are expected to guide a small group of safety engineers and support upgrade implementations through in\-house designs or outside contracts. An important component of this function is organizing required design reviews and safety system certification, as well as overseeing required periodic testing and recertification in collaboration with the operations groups of the various accelerators. This will require close collaboration with the institutional Radiation Protection Group (RPG) within the EH\&S division, as well as the Radiation Physics (RP) Group within the ALS division. Additionally, you are expected to participate in R\&D activities developing active interlock systems and systems for complex scientific facilities and instruments, as needed in the future. A typical background for a well\-rounded candidate includes safety interlock systems for accelerators or industrial controls for the automotive, petroleum, or nuclear industry. This position will be filled at a level commensurate with the successful candidate's skills, experiences, and abilities. **What You Will Do:** * Develop safety systems for the ALS\-U project, including the study of codes of federal, state, and local regulations, DOE orders, LBNL policies, and procedures. Maintain compliance with applicable LBNL policies and standards (Engineering Process, Electrical Equipment Inspection Program, Safety Software Quality Assurance, safety protocols, respectful workplace, etc.) * Oversee and ensure technical implementation for interlock and safety systems for LBNL accelerator and laser facilities. Contribute to the development of innovative solutions in the safety systems for existing and future particle accelerators. * Independently plan and complete safety system projects, ranging from small to large. jobs.description: **Build More Than Projects. Build Your Career With Lloyd Construction.** At Lloyd Construction, construction is about more than buildings—it’s about people, relationships, and strengthening the communities we serve. Since 1969, our success has been built by talented people who take pride in their work, support one another, and share a commitment to doing things the right way. We are looking for an experienced **Construction Estimator** to join the Lloyd family and become an important part of our continued growth. Excellence. Community. Courage. Heart.** If those values resonate with you and you are passionate about construction, problem\-solving, collaboration, and delivering exceptional work, we want to meet you. As a **Construction Estimator**, you will play a key role in helping shape projects from early planning through bidding and handoff to the project team. You will work closely with project managers, subcontractors, architects, engineers, and clients to develop accurate, competitive, and comprehensive estimates. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys digging into the details, understands how buildings come together, and thrives on solving complex problems. You should be comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining the accuracy and attention to detail that successful estimating requires. Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to be part of a team—not simply fill a position. Role \& ResponsibilitiesRelationships \& Collaboration * Build and maintain fair, honest, and professional relationships with subcontractors and suppliers. * Develop strong working relationships with architects, engineers, clients, and industry partners. * Help make Lloyd Construction a client's first choice by bringing value, expertise, and solutions to every project. * Collaborate with the estimating administrator to maintain an accurate and current subcontractor database. * Work closely with project teams to support a successful transition from estimating into construction. * Demonstrate the Lloyd Way through communication, collaboration, accountability, and integrity. Estimating \& Project Planning * Prepare estimating assignments according to project schedules and requirements. * Analyze project plans, specifications, geotechnical reports, and other bid documents for completeness and accuracy. * Perform accurate takeoffs and quantity surveys. * Prepare and maintain project qualifications and exclusions. * Identify, evaluate, and track value\-engineering opportunities. * Evaluate labor, material, equipment, and subcontractor costs. * Stay current on market conditions and construction costs. * Review addenda and bulletins and ensure subcontractors are working from the most current information. * Participate in final estimate reviews and project strategy discussions. * Attend design meetings and contribute value analysis, constructability recommendations, and construction means and methods. * Identify potential project risks, scope gaps, and cost\-saving opportunities. Bidding * Attend pre\-bid meetings and coordinate site visits with subcontractors. * Prepare invitations to bid and assist with subcontractor selection. * Verify adequate bid coverage for assigned trades. * Identify gaps, duplications, conflicts, and ambiguities within construction documents and coordinate resolutions with architects and subcontractors. * Prepare and maintain RFI logs. * Develop detailed scopes of work for assigned trades. * Coordinate specialty subcontractor and cost\-consultant participation in the estimating process. * Review subcontractor proposals for scope, qualifications, inclusions, exclusions, and completeness. * Thoroughly understand the parameters, inclusions, and exclusions of subcontractor estimates. * Assist with the preparation of complete and accurate bid packages. * Prepare bid tabulations and analyze subcontractor proposals for completeness. * Prepare estimating information for a thorough handoff to the project management team. What We're Looking For We're looking for someone who brings both strong technical knowledge and the ability to work well with people. The ideal candidate will have: * Strong knowledge of commercial construction, estimating, building systems, materials, and construction methods. * Experience with conceptual, schematic design, design development, and construction document estimating. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. * A collaborative, team\-oriented approach. * A commitment to accuracy, accountability, and exceptional client service. * A strong work ethic and dedication to meeting deadlines. * A passion for construction, process improvement, and continued professional development. * Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Procore, Bluebeam, estimating software, and cloud\-based takeoff tools. * Associate Estimating Professional certification or equivalent applicable estimating credentials. * Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and proof of insurance. * Ability to travel occasionally as project needs require. Education \& Experience * Bachelor's degree in **Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred**. * **Five or more years of commercial construction estimating experience preferred**, including experience with conceptual, schematic design, design development, and construction document phases. Why Join Lloyd Construction? We believe great work happens when great people feel valued, supported, and connected to the team around them. At Lloyd Construction, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects while working alongside experienced construction professionals who believe in **Communication, Coordination, and Collaboration**. When you join Lloyd, you're joining a company that values its people and believes that our success is built together. Benefits * Competitive salary based on experience * Bonus opportunities * Medical, dental, and vision plans * Short\- and long\-term disability * 401(k) with company match * Paid time off * Generous paid holiday schedule * Team\-building and company events * Opportunities for professional development and career growth **Compensation for this position will be based on the selected candidate's experience and qualifications and may differ from salary estimates displayed by Indeed.** About Lloyd Construction Lloyd Construction is a Tucson\-based general contractor that has been building relationships and strengthening communities since 1969\. Our work spans commercial construction across healthcare, education, public safety, industrial, historic preservation, and other specialized markets. Our mission is simple: **Strengthening communities through excellence in construction.** We are proud of the projects we build, but we're even more proud of the people who make them possible. If you're looking for a company where you can contribute, grow, build lasting relationships, and be part of a team that cares about its work, its people, and its community, we'd like to hear from you. **Come build with us. Come be part of the Lloyd family.** Physical \& Work Environment Requirements * May involve periods of standing. * Regularly required to work with a computer. * Occasionally required to reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and/or crawl. * Occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. * Must be able to visit active construction sites and navigate typical jobsite conditions as needed. * This position may require occasional work or site visits outdoors in varying weather conditions, including Arizona's extreme summer heat, cold winter temperatures, wind, dust, and other seasonal conditions. Equal Opportunity Employer Lloyd Construction is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Sr. Engineer AI
jobs.description: **Job Summary** The Senior AI Engineer is a hands\-on AI, data, analytics, and automation practitioner embedded within a business domain such as Commercial, Operations, Product, or Corporate Functions. The role identifies, designs, prototypes, and delivers practical solutions that drive measurable business value. * The Senior AI Engineer works directly with business teams to understand workflows, decisions, pain points, and opportunities, then rapidly translates them into working proofs of concept, pilots, demonstrations, automations, agents, copilots, analytics solutions, and decision\-support tools. This is a hands\-on builder role. * The Senior AI Engineer is expected to use modern AI\-assisted development tools and approved enterprise platforms to create solutions directly, not simply define requirements or coordinate delivery. The role owns outcomes, not tickets. * The Senior AI Engineer selects the simplest effective approach. A solution may use process improvement, traditional workflow automation or RPA, analytics, machine learning, generative AI, or a combination of these approaches. The role determines what can be delivered directly and what should transition to engineering, data science, platform, product, or automation teams for production deployment and scale. * The role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, combining strong communication, business understanding, product thinking, technical problem solving, and hands\-on execution. The Senior AI Engineer remains engaged through testing, transition, adoption, and measurable value realization. **Job Description** **Trusted Partnership \& Opportunity Identification** ===================================================== * Embed within a business domain and develop a deep understanding of its processes, workflows, systems, decisions, handoffs, and operational challenges. * Build trusted relationships with business leaders and frontline users; serve as a primary partner for AI\-, data\-, analytics\-, and automation\-enabled problem solving. * Continuously identify opportunities to improve decisions, productivity, customer experience, quality, cycle time, or business performance. * Shape and manage demand, focusing teams on opportunities with the highest potential value, feasibility, and readiness. * Challenge existing ways of working and help teams envision materially different workflows, not only incremental improvements. **Solution Design \& Rapid Prototyping** * Lead hands\-on discovery sessions to define the business problem, user need, current workflow, constraints, baseline performance, and success measures. * Translate ambiguous business problems into clear solution hypotheses, experiments, and technical requirements. * Determine whether the best response is process improvement, workflow automation, RPA, analytics, machine learning, generative AI, or a combination of approaches. * Design AI\-enabled workflows, agents, copilots, retrieval\-augmented generation solutions, analytics and decision\-support tools, workflow automations, and process automations. * Build working proofs of concept, prototypes, pilots, demonstrations, and minimum viable solutions using real data and approved enterprise platforms. * Test directly with users, incorporate feedback rapidly, and assess business value, usability, technical feasibility, controls, and scalability. * Make practical tradeoffs among speed, user value, technical complexity, and enterprise requirements. **Hands\-On AI, Analytics \& Automation Delivery** * Personally build functional solutions when the scope and technology are appropriate, including AI applications, agents, copilots, RAG solutions, analytics tools, workflow automations, RPA solutions, integrations, and decision\-support tools. * Use Python, SQL, APIs, low\-code tools, automation platforms, and AI\-assisted coding capabilities to move quickly from an idea to a usable solution. * Work across enterprise data, APIs, business applications, AI platforms, analytics platforms, and workflow technologies to turn ideas into working outcomes. * Apply sound engineering practices for solution design, testing, documentation, security, reliability, maintainability, and secure data handling. * Define evaluation criteria with the business owner and incorporate testing, explainability, monitoring, controls, and human review as appropriate. * Troubleshoot technical and workflow issues during prototyping, piloting, implementation, and transition. * Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, privacy, and Responsible AI requirements. * Maintain a bias for working solutions and measurable outcomes, not presentations or intermediate artifacts. **Scale, Transition \& Business Impact** * Determine which solutions can be owned and supported directly and which require transition to engineering, data science, platform, product, automation, or business technology teams. * Partner with techn d iterative delivery. * Ability to communicate clearly with technical and non\-technical audiences and influence across organizational boundaries. * Ability to balance rapid experimentation with enterprise architecture, security, data governance, privacy, and Responsible AI requirements. * Sound judgment on when to build directly, when to use low\-code or RPA, and when to transition execution to specialized teams. * Bias for action, hands\-on problem solving, and ownership from idea through outcome. **PREFERRED JOB REQUIREMENTS** **Education** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Business Administration, or a related field. **Certification / Licensure** * Relevant cloud, AI, data, analytics, automation, agile, or product certifications preferred. **Work Experience** * Experience building generative AI applications, agents, copilots, RAG solutions, intelligent workflow automations, RPA solutions, analytics products, forecasting models, optimization tools, or decision\-support solutions. * Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, Power Platform, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, or comparable enterprise platforms. * Experience in forward deployed engineering, solution engineering, technical consulting, analytics engineering, automation engineering, or another business\-facing technical role. * Experience integrating enterprise systems, APIs, data platforms, analytics platforms, automation tools, and business applications. * Experience in healthcare, medical products, supply chain, manufacturing, distribution, commercial operations, or corporate functions. **Knowledge / Skills / Abilities** * Ability to move fluidly between business discovery, solution design, coding, user testing, demonstration, and implementation planning. * Strong facilitation and storytelling skills; able to lead working sessions, demonstrate solutions, explain technical concepts simply, and drive decisions. * Comfort working in environments with imperfect data, evolving processes, and incomplete requirements. * Demonstrated ability to deliver results in fast\-paced, collaborative, and execution\-oriented organizations. * Equally comfortable engaging business stakeholders, building working solutions, and partnering with technical teams to productionize and scale them. Click here to learn more about a career in IT at Medline! Medline Industries, LP, and its subsidiaries, offer a competitive total rewards package, continuing education \& training, and tremendous potential with a growing worldwide organization. The anticipated salary range for this position: $154,000\.00 \- $231,000\.00 Annual The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s location, education, experience, skills, and abilities. Medline will not pay less than the applicable minimum wage or salary threshold. Our benefit package includes health insurance, life and disability, 401(k) contributions, paid time off, etc., for employees working 30 or more hours per week on average. For roles where employees work less than 30 hours per week, benefits include 401(k) contributions as well as access to the Employee Assistance Program, Employee Resource Groups and the Employee Service Corp. We’re dedicated to creating a Medline where everyone feels they belong and can grow their career. We strive to do this by seeking diversity in all forms, acting inclusively, and ensuring that people have tools and resources to perform at their best. Explore our Belonging page here . Medline Industries, LP is an equal opportunity employer. Medline evaluates qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, neurodivergence, protected veteran status, marital or family status, caregiver responsibilities, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 9 Oct 2026 Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. **A Day in the Life** ===================== The Neuroscience portfolio group develops life\-restoring therapies and healthcare solutions that span the care continuum. Our teams develop innovative medical technologies that help improve patient outcomes and quality of life around the world. As a **Senior Firmware Engineer** , you will be responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, verification, and maintenance of embedded software and firmware for next\-generation neuromodulation products. You will work closely with systems, electrical, software, quality, and test engineers to develop highly reliable and safety\-critical medical device solutions. This role requires strong technical leadership, ownership of complex technical challenges, and a passion for delivering high\-quality products in a regulated environment. **Primary Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded firmware for medical device products. * Develop software for microcontrollers, processors, and hardware interfaces. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate system requirements into firmware designs and implementations. * Participate in firmware architecture, design reviews, risk analyses, and technical decision\-making. * Develop and execute unit, integration, and system\-level testing. * Support hardware bring\-up, debugging, and root cause investigations. * Create and maintain software design documentation in compliance with quality and regulatory requirements. * Contribute to continuous integration, automated testing, and software quality initiatives. * Participate in Agile development activities, including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. * Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and contribute to engineering best practices. Stay current with emerging embedded technologies, development techniques, and industry trends. * **Required Qualifications** Bachelor's degree in related field with 4 years of relevant experience OR a Master’s degree with 2 years of relevant experience * **Preferred Qualifications** * Strong proficiency in C and C\+\+ for embedded systems development. * Experience with real\-time operating systems (RTOS) such as FreeRTOS, ThreadX, VxWorks, or similar. * Experience developing firmware for microcontrollers, embedded processors, or medical devices. * Familiarity with communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, BLE, USB, or Ethernet. * Experience with hardware/software integration, debugging, and laboratory testing. * Knowledge of software development lifecycle processes in regulated environments. * Experience with source control and DevOps tools such as Git, SVN, or GitLab. * Understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and object\-oriented programming concepts. * Experience with automated testing and continuous integration practices. * Understanding of Systems Engineering and requirements\-based development. * Experience supporting products developed under FDA, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, or related quality standards. * Experience working in Agile development environments. jobs.title: Android Engineer III
jobs.description: **Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted** In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all. **About the Role** As a key member of our Android team, you will play a vital role in developing and maintaining the Hinge Android mobile application. Your focus will be on implementing new product features, fixing issues, and improving the mobile application user experience. All while leveraging the latest Android tools such as Kotlin, jetpack compose, coroutines, room, hilt and many more. Collaborating within a cross\-disciplinary team, including product managers, technical project managers, designers, data engineers, backend engineers, and QA specialists, you will work closely with the Tech Lead and peers to advance our product and contribute to our engineering community. This role offers the opportunity to do high\-impact work, directly contributing to a consumer mobile application used by millions. Over time you can expect to grow into an independent, capable, and confident Android developer. ### **Responsibilities** * **Cross\-Disciplinary Collaboration:** Work closely with a diverse team of developers, designers, and product managers to build features that prioritize high quality and user engagement. * **Kotlin Proficiency:** Develop and continuously enhance your understanding of Kotlin fundamentals, applying them to create efficient and effective solutions. * **Android Expertise:** Gain a thorough understanding of Android development principles and design patterns, applying them to build intuitive and user\-friendly applications. * **Issue Resolution:** Triage, debug, and effectively resolve software issues, ensuring the stability and performance of our application. * **Codebase Stewardship:** Actively contribute to the long\-term health and evolution of the codebase, implementing best practices and innovative solutions. * **Code Reviews:** Regularly perform code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers to foster a culture of excellence and continuous improvement. * **Active Team Participation:** Engage actively in team ceremonies such as stand\-ups, planning sessions, and retrospectives to ensure alignment and promote agile methodologies. * **Effective Communication:** Maintain clear and positive communication with team members and other departments, supporting an empowering and inclusive team environment. ### **What We're Looking For** * **Professional Android Development Experience:** You have 3\-5 years of experience in Android development, demonstrating the ability to design and implement mobile applications effectively. * **Google Play Publication:** You have experience publishing at least one application on the Google Play Store, showcasing your understanding of the deployment process and maintaining a production application. * **Proficiency in Kotlin and Android SDKs:** You are proficient in Kotlin, which is strongly preferred, and have a good understanding of Android SDKs and frameworks. Experience with Java in the context of Android development is also beneficial. * **Solid Software Development Fundamentals:** You possess a good foundation in software development principles and are capable of creating efficient and maintainable code. * **Strong Communication Skills:** You are able to communicate clearly and effectively, facilitating productive collaborations within technical and non\-technical teams. * **Ownership and Quality Focus:** You take pride in your work and are committed to creating high\-quality user experiences, demonstrating attention to detail and a user\-centric approach to application development. $150,000 \- $180,000 a year Factors such as scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/training, job\-related skills, internal peer equity, as well as market and business considerations may influence base pay offered. This salary range is reflective of a position based in New York City. This salary will be subject to a geographic adjustment (according to a specific city and state), if an authorization is granted to work outside of the location listed in this posting. **As a member of our team, you’ll enjoy:** **401(k) Matching:** We match 100% of the first 10% of pre\-tax 401(k) contributions you make, up to a maximum of $10,000 per year. **Professional Growth:** Get an annual Learning \& Development stipend once you’ve been with us for three months. You also get free access to Udemy, an online learning and teaching marketplace with over 6000 courses, starting your first day. **Parental Leave \& Planning:** When you become a new parent, you’re eligible for 100% paid parental leave (20 paid weeks for both birth and non\-birth parents.) **Fertility Support:** You’ll get easy access to fertility care through Carrot, from basic treatments to fertility preservation. We also provide a stipend towards fertility preservation. You and your spouse/domestic partner are both eligible. **Date Stipend:** All Hinge employees receive a $100 monthly stipend for epic dates– Romantic or otherwise. Hinge Premium is also free for employees and their loved ones. **ERGs:** We have eight Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)—Asian, Unapologetic, Disability, LGBTQIA\+, Raices, Women/Nonbinary, Parents —that hold regular meetings, host events, and provide dedicated support to the organization \& its community. **At Hinge, our core values are…** **Authenticity:** We share, never hide, our words, actions and intentions. **Courage:** We embrace lofty goals and tough challenges. **Empathy:** We deeply consider the perspective of others. **Diversity inspires innovation** Hinge is an equal\-opportunity employer. We value diversity at our company and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We believe success is created by a diverse workforce of individuals with different ideas, strengths, interests, and cultural backgrounds. ***If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre\-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please let your Talent Acquisition partner know.*** *\#Hinge* .

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, AI Strategy & Execution
jobs.description: Merge medical imaging solutions, offered by Merative, combine intelligent, scalable imaging workflow tools with deep and broad expertise to help healthcare organizations improve their confidence in patient outcomes and optimize care delivery. Merge is one of the most widely deployed medical imaging platforms in the world. Radiologists and cardiologists rely on us to store, move, and read imaging studies across enterprise health systems, teleradiology reading centers, and community hospitals. We are focused on putting AI governed intelligence directly into the reading experience. This is a rare chance to shape how AI reaches the point of care at real scale. The opportunity The market does not want more point tools; it wants one place where intelligence is governed and lives in the workflow. You will set where AI shows up across the portfolio and why, then carry the highest\-leverage capabilities all the way to clinicians in production. You will partner closely with engineering, design, clinical advisors, and our partner ecosystem — and you will report directly to the VP, Product. This is a builder’s role, not a slideware role. We are looking for a product leader who can hold a multi\-year AI strategy in one hand and ship a governed model into the reading room with the other. What you’ll own * **AI product strategy.** Define and maintain the AI vision and roadmap across the Merge portfolio — where AI shows up in the data layer, the workflow, and the read, and how it compounds into a durable moat. Draw and defend the line between the workflow and data intelligence we build and the pixel AI that arrives through our partner marketplace. * **AI feature delivery.** Take the highest\-priority AI capabilities from discovery through launch, co\-designed with radiologists and cardiologists on their own studies and case mix. * **Model governance in the workflow.** Own the registry, governance, and monitoring that wrap every model, tied to our quality system so speed never costs safety. * **Time\-to\-value for AI.** Drive time\-to\-add\-a\-model from quarters to weeks, so the next capability is configuration rather than a project. What you’ll do * Turn a portfolio\-level AI strategy into a sequenced, evidence\-backed roadmap, validated with win/loss data, product\-readiness reviews, and early\-access customers. * Write crisp problem definitions and success metrics — % of reads AI\-assisted in\-workflow, measurable turnaround\-time reduction, governed models live and growing. * Lead an empowered, single\-threaded team through the AI\-native product development lifecycle, iterating with UX and engineering on the solution rather than handing off requirements. * Represent Merge’s AI direction with customers, clinical advisors, analysts, and internal leadership — and bring what you hear back into the roadmap. What you bring * 8\+ years in product management, including senior ownership of AI/ML\-powered products shipped to production at scale. * A track record of both setting strategy and delivering — you have owned a roadmap and personally carried hard features across the finish line. * Fluency in applied AI/ML product decisions: model lifecycle, evaluation, governance, monitoring, and the trade\-offs of putting models in front of expert users. * Experience partnering with engineering and design in an empowered\-team operating model, closer to the work than to the org chart. * Clear, plain communication — you can make a complex AI strategy legible to clinicians, executives, and engineers alike. Nice to have * Background in healthcare, medical imaging, clinical workflow, or another regulated domain. * Experience with platform, marketplace, or partner\-ecosystem products. * Familiarity with quality management systems (QMS) and regulated software development. Why this role matters Fewer than 4% of buyers cite AI as a main reason they choose a PACS — which tells us the value is not in another model, but in intelligence that is governed and lives in the workflow. If you want your AI work to reach clinicians at real scale, in the moment they are reading, this is the seat. **Compensation** The salary range provided in this job posting is intended to reflect the general market value for the position.
