jobs.title: Senior Application Support Engineer
jobs.description: Take your career to the next level! In the last few years our goal has been expansion, creating growth opportunities for many of our team members. Not only are we serious about growth, but we are also serious about helping our customers during hard financial times. We take pride in providing solutions and offering a helping hand, not only to our customers but also to the communities we serve. As we continue to expand and grow into a national leader in consumer financing, we invite you to consider joining our team. If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and bringing a personal touch to finance, we'd love to have you on board! **Job purpose** The Senior Application Support Engineer serves as a senior technical resource for the support, reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of critical business applications. This role provides advanced Level 2 and Level 3 support, leads complex incident and problem investigations, partners with business, development, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams, and mentors other support engineers. The incumbent helps ensure application services meet availability, service\-level compliance, and operational objectives. **Duties and responsibilities** * Serve as the senior escalation point for complex Level 2 and Level 3 application incidents, owning investigation through restoration, root\-cause identification, and documented resolution. * Assess business impact, establish priority, coordinate technical resources, and provide timely, audience\-appropriate communications during major incidents. * Lead problem management for recurring issues by performing trend analysis, identifying root causes, and driving permanent corrective and preventive actions. * Partner directly with Level One Business Support teams and coach engineers on troubleshooting methods, escalation practices, and customer service. * Collaborate across application development, infrastructure, database, network, security, and vendor teams to resolve cross\-platform and cross\-product issues. * Act as a subject matter expert for assigned applications, including architecture, integrations, dependencies, data flows, configurations, operational risks, and business processes. * Monitor application health, availability, capacity, logs, interfaces, batch processes, and performance; improve alerts, dashboards, and operational thresholds to detect issues proactively. * Own and improve scheduled operational processes, support procedures, runbooks, knowledge articles, system diagrams, and recovery documentation. * Plan and support application releases, configuration changes, patches, upgrades, and deployments across test and production environments, including validation and post\-implementation review. * Ensure adherence to established Release, Incident, Problem, Change, Configuration, Access, and Service Management processes and controls. * Review proposed solutions, technical designs, scripts, code, and deployment plans for supportability, reliability, maintainability, and operational risk. * Develop or enhance scripts, queries, utilities, and automation that reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and accelerate diagnosis and recovery. * Participate in software testing through test planning, review, analysis, execution support, defect triage, production\-readiness assessment, and release certification. * Track service\-level performance, support volumes, recurring defects, and operational risks; recommend and lead measurable service improvements. * Provide technical support and operational guidance to projects, ensuring new or changed services transition effectively into production support. * Participate in an on\-call support rotation and coordinate after\-hours response for business\-critical production incidents as required. * Lead technical discussions, triage sessions, knowledge\-sharing activities, and post\-incident reviews; mentor less experienced team members. * Perform other duties as assigned by Leadership. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * Five or more years of progressive experience supporting enterprise or production applications, including advanced Level 2 or Level 3 troubleshooting. * Demonstrated experience leading complex incident resolution and performing root\-cause analysis, problem management, and corrective\-action follow\-through. * Experience using an IT service management platform and working within structured Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Configuration Management processes. * Strong working knowledge of Microsoft development technologies, including .NET, C\#, and Visual Basic, with the ability to review and troubleshoot application code. * Advanced Microsoft SQL Server skills, including complex querying, stored procedure analysis, data validation, and performance troubleshooting. * Experience supporting integrations, APIs, scheduled jobs, services, and multi\-tier applications across test and production environments. * Proficiency with application monitoring, logging, alerting, and diagnostic tools. * Proficient understanding of source control and software delivery tools such as Git and Bitbucket. * Ability to create clear technical documentation, runbooks, support procedures, incident communications, and executive\-ready summaries. * Strong customer orientation and the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business users, vendors, and leadership. * Demonstrated ability to mentor colleagues, lead technical work, manage competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment during high\-impact incidents. * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel. * Must pass drug screen and other pre\-employment screenings. **Preferred Qualifications** * Graduate degree or relevant technical certifications, such as Microsoft, database, cloud, or Agile credentials. * Experience supporting applications in the consumer finance or broader financial services industry. * Experience supporting loan management systems and related business processes. * Experience with cloud\-hosted applications, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, scripting, or operational automation. * Experience with high availability, disaster recovery, application security controls, audit evidence, and regulated operating environments. * Experience developing service metrics, dashboards, or continuous improvement plans. **Critical Competencies** * Advanced analytical, diagnostic, and problem\-solving skills. * Technical leadership, mentoring, and knowledge\-sharing capability. * Ownership, accountability, sound judgment, and composure during critical incidents. * Clear written and verbal communication tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences. * Strong collaboration across business, technology, security, infrastructure, and vendor teams. * Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment, organize work independently, and manage multiple priorities. * Continuous\-improvement mindset with attention to service quality, operational risk, documentation, and sustainable solutions. **Working conditions** This position primarily works in an office environment, sitting at a desk, working on a computer. \#LI\-hybrid jobs.title: Automation Engineer II
jobs.description: A career at Resilience is more than just a job – it’s an opportunity to change the future. Resilience is a technology\-focused biomanufacturing company that’s changing the way medicine is made. We’re building a sustainable network of high\-tech, end\-to\-end manufacturing solutions to better withstand disruptive events, serve scientific discovery, and reach those in need. For more information, please visit www.resilience.com Job Description **Position Summary** The Automation Engineer II is an engineer responsible for enhancing programs across a broad spectrum of functions at the West Chester Site. In this role, you will lead and advise on projects spanning various departments within the site, including Formulation, Aseptic Filling, Automated Inspection, Device Assembly, Packaging, Building Automated System, AMHS, and a site\-level Historian system. Collaboration with cross\-functional teams, such as MS\&T, Engineering, Digital, Quality, Validation, and other key stakeholders, is integral to defining requirements, project execution, and the sustained operation of multiple automated systems on\-site. This position is an excellent fit for Automation Engineers who possess problem\-solving abilities and a service\-oriented mindset. It provides an opportunity for professionals to expand their technical expertise while gaining exposure to a diverse array of systems and actively contributing to their growth and optimization. **Responsibilities** * Participate and support in the design, optimization, commissioning, or validation of newly procured or existing equipment as the automation lead. * Interface with several types of equipment and systems, including but not limited to PLCs, SCADAs, HMIs, Servers, Databases, Data Historian, Visualization, and other automation equipment. * Consult cross\-functionally and assist system owners in process development as the automation subject matter expert. * Review and approve requirements, specifications, drawings, coding procedures, and guidelines. * Provide technical guidance and train others on systems, software, equipment, machines, procedures, and/or processes. * High technical ability with a troubleshooting approach * Identify temporary and permanent fixes to address issues. * Review and approve documentation needed for the qualification of equipment and processes. * Author, review, and revise SOPs and specifications to maintain equipment, systems, and/or facilities. Comply with all SOPs. * Ensure proper documentation practices during maintenance processes. * Recommend and initiate activities to ensure area and equipment are maintained in a state of compliance. * Assess and implement improvements in productivity, waste generation, quality, and cost. * Lead and coordinate investigations and studies with little supervision. * Interact with regulatory agency personnel during audits and inspections. * Perform quality audits to ensure devices used are in proper working condition. * Provide 24/7 support to others as part of a rotating on\-call support system. * All other tasks as needed or assigned by the supervisor. **Minimum Qualifications** * Experience supporting manufacturing operations in a regulated or cGMP environment * Experience with some of the following Automation systems (PLC, HMI, SCADA): Rockwell, Inductive (Ignition), Aveva (Wonderware), Siemens, Emerson (GE), or B\&R * Ability to work independently with excellent attention to detail and a desire to learn about manufacturing technologies **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline * Experience with FactoryTalk Batch * Experience with Data Historian and Visualization systems such as Aveva PI (OSI PI) * Experience with Microsoft SQL database design * Knowledge of GAMP 5 and ISA standards * Knowledge of change control, deviation, CAPA, validation, and qualification principles ***Sponsorship or support for work authorization, including visas, is not available for this position.*** Resilience is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or characteristic, or other non\-job\-related characteristics or other prohibited grounds specified in applicable federal, state, and local laws. Requests for reasonable accommodation can be made at any stage of the recruitment process. Resilience offers employees a robust total rewards program including an annual cash bonus program, a 401(k) plan with a generous company match and our benefits package which is thoughtfully designed to support our employees with great healthcare (including medical, dental and vision), family building benefits, life and disability insurance, paid vacation, paid holidays, other paid leaves of absence, tuition reimbursement and support for caregiving needs. Our target base pay hiring range for this position is $70,000\.00 \- $107,500\.00 per year. Actual base pay is dependent upon a number of factors, including but not limited to, the candidate’s geographical location, relevant experience, qualifications, skills and knowledge. Excited about Resilience? We encourage you to apply and start a conversation with one of our recruiters.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** At Resilience, we're creating a new category that integrates cybersecurity, cyber insurance, and cyber risk management. Founded in 2016 by experts from across the highest tiers of the US military and intelligence communities – and built by prominent leaders and innovators from the insurance, technology, and cybersecurity industries – Resilience is rewriting the rules of how cyber risk is assessed, measured, and managed. Our integrated cyber risk solutions connect risk quantification software, cybersecurity experts, and A\+ rated cyber insurance, all purpose\-built for middle and large organizations. We are a cybersecurity company, a Cyber and Tech E\&O\-focused MGA, a fintech startup, and a data science powerhouse, all purposefully built into one. Resilience is proud to be backed by leading technology investment firms, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Intact Ventures, Founders Fund, CRV, and Shield Capital. **The Hook: Why this role matters now** Step into a critical technical role driving the core data architecture that powers our category\-defining platform. As a Data Engineer at Resilience, you won't just maintain existing pipelines; you will take full ownership of building, scaling, and optimizing the data infrastructure that connects cybersecurity visibility with cyber insurance analytics. Sitting at the heart of our engineering team, you will ensure efficient and reliable data integration, storage, and processing across cross\-functional teams, transforming complex datasets into seamless, high\-performance systems. **The Mission: What you will achieve in the first 6 months** In your first six months, you will take complete accountability for developing and maintaining our data pipelines, data modeling, and infrastructure strategy: * **Data Pipeline Development:** Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and storage, ensuring data quality, reliability, and integrity throughout the pipeline lifecycle. * **Data Modeling \& Integration:** Partner closely with data scientists, analysts, and application teams to design and implement scalable data models supporting business intelligence and analytics while integrating diverse internal and external sources. * **Performance Optimization \& Infrastructure:** Address system bottlenecks, conduct capacity planning, and implement optimizations to elevate performance and reliability across our cloud\-based data systems. * **Governance \& Security:** Establish and enforce data security policies, access controls, and compliance standards in alignment with regulatory measures. * **Mentorship \& Collaboration:** Provide technical mentorship to fellow engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning while communicating technical concepts effectively to non\-technical stakeholders. **The Toolkit: Technical skills vs. "nice\-to\-haves"** * **Core Requirements:** + 3\+ years of proven data engineering experience with hands\-on expertise in data integration, data modeling, and ETL processes. + Proficiency in programming languages including **SQL**, **Python**, and **JavaScript/TypeScript.** + Solid working knowledge of data warehousing concepts, cloud architectures, and modern data stack tooling (e.g., **Dagster**, **AWS**, **Snowflake**, **dbt**). + Familiarity with data governance, security, and compliance best practices. + Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience). + Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and cross\-functional communication skills, with a track record of managing multiple projects in a dynamic environment. * **Nice\-to\-Haves:** + Master's degree in Computer Science or Data Science. + Advanced certifications in data engineering or cloud platform domains. **The Culture: How we work** We move fast, operate with zero ego, and embrace a bias to action. We are guided strongly by our four core values: transparency, excellence, grit, and humility. This is a full\-time, remote\-friendly role operating loosely on Eastern Standard Time, with engineering team members distributed across Baltimore, New York, San Francisco, and the eastern seaboard. **The Benefits: Standardized perks** You will work alongside prominent leaders and innovators from the insurance, technology, and cybersecurity industries, as well as experts from the highest tiers of the US military and intelligence communities.**What Resilience Offers You** Innovative company culture Flexible work schedules Family paid leave Paid healthcare for employees 401k/Pension Professional development \& career advancements Flexible paid time off Employee referral bonus **Accommodations and Accessibility** We want to ensure you're able to perform as well as possible in your interview. As part of that, if you have any accessibility\-related needs to ensure a comfortable visit, please let us know. We'll do our best to provide reasonable accommodations to suit your working style during your interview and if you join our team. If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please let your recruiter contact know. **Beware of Job Scams** Resilience is excited to welcome talented individuals to explore career opportunities with us. However, we urge you to stay vigilant against recruitment scams where fraudsters may impersonate our company. We will never ask for payments, conduct interviews via chat rooms, or contact candidates from personal email accounts. All job applications must be submitted through our official platform at greenhouse.io , and interviews will only take place via approved Resilience accounts. If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns, please let your recruiter contact know. Thank you for helping us maintain a safe and secure recruitment process.

jobs.description: Position: Full time, in person (Murray, Utah) Team: Internal Software Development **Summary:** Resolut is hiring a Software Developer to join a small but growing team whose custom tools are critical to daily engineering and business operations. Projects are varied and often full stack. **About Us:** Resolut is a Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) engineering firm whose dedication to our clients is matched by our commitment to our employees. We offer stability in a comfortable, challenging, fast\-paced, and welcoming work environment. Beyond competitive benefits including health, dental, vision, 401(k), HSA and FSA plans, we invest in our employees' mental and physical well\-being through an on\-site gym, and a game room. We also provide access to low\-cost mental health counseling through our health insurance plans. We are a diverse group of people from all backgrounds who work hard and enjoy working together. Our internal Software Development team builds custom solutions to complicated engineering and business operations challenges. Our work ranges from integrated engineering calculations and automations to full stack standalone applications and mobile apps. We are also integrating AI into our workflows in a careful, controlled way. **Responsibilities:*** Design, build, and maintain custom software, from engineering calculation tools to full stack web and mobile applications. * Debug and improve existing code, often where the solution process is developed alongside the product. * Coordinate with teammates and internal stakeholders to scope requirements and set priorities. * Manage projects from request through delivery, including timelines and status updates. * Lead training sessions and debugging walkthroughs for engineers and staff who use our tools. * Help shape how AI is responsibly introduced into our workflows. **Qualifications:*** Experience: 1–3 years of professional software development experience. * C\#: professional experience writing and maintaining C\# applications. * Dynamic problem solving: comfortable debugging and developing custom code as requirements take shape. * Project management: able to plan, prioritize, and deliver multiple projects at once. * Team coordination: clear communication and collaboration with developers, engineers, and business staff. * Public speaking: confident presenting to groups for training sessions and live debugging. * GitHub: working knowledge of basic workflows such as branching, commits, and pull requests. * Bachelor’s (or greater) degree in Computer Science / Software Development (or similar field) from an EAC/ABET\-accredited university required or equivalent experience, required. jobs.title: FULL-STACK BUSINESS APPLICATIONS DEVELOPER
jobs.description: **Position Overview** The Full\-Stack Business Applications Developer works across C\#/.NET, Python, and SQL to build and maintain the applications that run the business \- adding features, fixing issues, and creating reports \- while handling the operational and data investigations that keep our systems running smoothly. In a Microsoft SQL Server and MySQL environment, this role resolves technical and business\-data issues, supports EDI and data\-import pipelines, and continuously improves the internal applications our teams rely on. It combines hands\-on application development with operational support and requires strong problem\-solving skills across the full stack. **Essential Job Responsibilities** * Application Feature Development: Design, build, and ship new features across the Blazor/MAUI client application and the C\#/.NET API, following the established application architecture. * Maintaining Existing Codebases: Debug, refactor, and enhance the existing C\#, Python, and SQL codebases to improve functionality, correctness, and performance. * Operational Investigations \& Data Fixes: Investigate business\-data issues \- including pricing discrepancies, EDI and UPC problems, planogram classification, and promotion or import matching \- using established procedures and appropriate change controls. Resolve data and code\-level root causes, and clearly document or escalate complex issues when appropriate. * SQL \& Reporting: Write, optimize, and debug SQL and stored procedures across Microsoft SQL Server and MySQL, and build reports end\-to\-end (stored procedure, report definition, deployment, and permissions). * EDI \& Data Imports: Maintain the trading\-partner EDI and vendor/customer import pipelines, and triage, reprocess, and reconcile failed or exception imports. * Reliability \& Error Triage: Monitor client\-error telemetry and back\-end processes, prioritize and resolve production issues, and handle routine master\-data and user\-account maintenance. * Testing \& Quality: Write automated tests at the appropriate layer (unit, integration, and end\-to\-end) and keep the test suites passing before changes ship. * Collaboration \& Issue Resolution: Communicate directly with employees across departments to understand reported issues, gather context, reproduce problems, and carry them through resolution. Partner with the IT/IS Director and business teams to streamline processes and increase efficiency, escalating complex issues as needed. **Knowledge and Qualifications** * At least 3 years of professional software development experience, with a focus on C\#/.NET and relational databases. * Proficiency in C\#/.NET (including an ORM such as Entity Framework Core) and working proficiency in Python. * Experience building web application interfaces with a component framework — Blazor/Razor preferred; React or Angular experience transfers. * Strong SQL skills across Microsoft SQL Server and MySQL, including writing and optimizing stored procedures. * A habit of writing automated tests and working within an established, version\-controlled (Git) codebase. * Ability to read existing code and written documentation as the source of truth, and to handle multiple priorities on short notice with strong attention to detail. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with every preferred technology is not required; demonstrated ability to learn unfamiliar systems is valued. * .NET MAUI or Blazor Hybrid application development. * Python data\-pipeline or workflow orchestration (e.g., Apache Airflow). * SSRS / RDL report development. * EDI / X12 document exchange (e.g., 810, 850, 867, 875\). * Experience in grocery, retail, distribution, or ERP systems — Microsoft Dynamics GP a plus. * Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services (App Service, Key Vault, Blob Storage). **Key Competencies** * Problem\-Solving Ability: Analytical, detail\-oriented, and naturally inquisitive. Able to investigate and solve complex technical problems efficiently. * Adaptability and Flexibility: Thrives in dynamic environments with shifting priorities, works comfortably within an established and well\-documented architecture, and remains calm under pressure while delivering results. * Collaboration and Teamwork: Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. Able to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Self\-Motivation and Independence: Capable of working autonomously, taking initiative, and managing projects without needing constant supervision. * Technical Curiosity and Continuous Learning: Passionate about technology, with a drive to stay updated on emerging trends in cloud computing, development practices, and software architecture. * Attention to Detail: A meticulous approach to writing code, debugging, optimizing systems, and ensuring high\-quality deliverables. **Schedule** * Monday \- Friday * 8\-hour shift * Reliable attendance is an essential function of this position. **Physical Demands** * Must use sensory skills to effectively communicate and interact with other employees and the public using the telephone and personal contact as defined by the ability to see, read, talk, hear, handle, or feel objects and controls. * Frequent sitting, walking, grasping, fingering, repetitive motion, and reaching. Occasional standing, bending, and crouching. * Ability to lift to 30 pounds occasionally. * Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential tasks. jobs.title: Engineer - Manufacturing
jobs.description: Summary Responsible for the operational performance of their assigned area including quality, productivity, and on time delivery. The Manufacturing Engineer contributes to elimination of waste in all aspects of manufacturing by combining engineering training with lean manufacturing principles and a focus on quality to drive waste out of the production system. Works as a member of a team to contribute to continuous improvement activities throughout our facility. Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other Duties not listed may be assigned. Daily Responsibilities * Provide oversight of the manufacture of products to ensure that engineering documentation is consistent with manufacturing and service methods employed. * Work within the company policies to manage the aspects of new product introduction. * Verify performance validation tests for introduction into Production Test. * Determine root cause of handling problems of products. * Assist with Assembly and Test personnel training. * Provide leadership and commitment in supporting continuous improvements in quality, productivity, and delivery performance by deploying a continuous improvement framework. * Supports Environmental Health and Safety projects to promote a Zero Incident Safety Culture. * Manage all assigned projects in support of division, plant, and project objectives. * Develop approaches to solving problems in processes, tooling, equipment, facilities, and cost. * Plans, details, and implements required industrialization methods, tooling, and equipment in the manufacturing and service operation. * Appropriate and track expense and capital expenditures within planned budgets. * Develop and implement cost reductions to meet or exceed departmental and plant goals. * Design, develop, and implement new manufacturing processes to support customer products. * Develop application software and tooling for a comprehensive set of complex machines and mechanical process steps within a manufacturing sector. * Implement plan and lead the assessment of the capability of machines and process applications using Design of Experiments and statistical methods across the full manufacturing process, ensuring maximum utilization of critical resources, maximum throughput, minimum cost and capacity growth. * Lead disciplined process for solving complex single stage or multistage product, process, component, and related problems that affect the efficient operation and/or manufacture of products through the full manufacturing process. * Project Management \- Ability to manage a single line engineering project with a limited number of participants. Create a project/change management plan, establish and distribute project roles, and communicate what is needed from the project participants in order to make the project successful. Education and/or Experience * High school graduate or equivalent. Preferably graduated from computer school/college with major in industrial engineering. * Minimum 2 years’ experience in Electronic Manufacturing Engineering role. * Solid understanding of manufacturing process structure. * Must be able to work occasional overtime. * Lean Manufacturing/Continuous Improvement Kaizen Leadership * PLC and HMI programming and interface will be a plus element **Essential Skills:** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work well with tight schedules and rapid development cycles. * Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with a professional and credible demeanor. * Ability to effectively communicate concepts with various levels of the organization. * Ability to multi\-task and manage multiple priorities. * Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. * Flexible to work overtime for special projects or business supports. * Requires hands\-on, ambition, and drive to succeed \- “Makes things happen”. * Must be goal oriented and accustomed to achieving results through teamwork. Competencies: * Shows determination to achieve excellent results. * Finds better ways to achieve. Working Conditions While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to sit for long periods. Employee must be able to lift objects approximately up to 25 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Must be able to tolerate moderate to high noise levels in a warehouse environment. Office and outside environmental conditions found in the warehouse, hot in the summer, cold in the winter. Individuals may need to walk for an extensive period of time while working and walking the facilities; to reach over shoulder heights; bend or stoop below the waist; repetitive wrist, hand, or finger movement.

jobs.title: Residential Drafting Manager
jobs.description: Saddletree Homes, an award\-winning Colorado Springs home builder, is seeking an experienced **Residential Drafting Manager** to lead our residential drafting and design operations. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical drafting skills with a solid understanding of the residential construction process. The ideal candidate can take ownership of projects from start to finish, manage multiple priorities, work effectively with homebuyers and internal departments, and provide leadership and direction within the drafting department. This is a **hands\-on management position**. The Residential Drafting Manager will oversee the drafting process while also actively working on plans, revisions, and design solutions. **Experience with residential construction and homebuilding is required.** Responsibilities * Manage the day\-to\-day operations and workflow of the drafting department * Coordinate drafting schedules, priorities, deadlines, and project assignments * Manage residential projects from initial plans through construction\-ready documents * Prepare and revise floor plans, roof layouts, framing plans, exterior and interior elevations, and site plans * Make framing, layout, and design modifications as needed * Review and respond to engineering comments and coordinate required plan revisions * Review drawings for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and constructability * Work directly with homebuyers on design changes and modifications * Coordinate with construction, sales, purchasing, engineering, management, and other departments * Ensure buyer selections and approved changes are accurately incorporated into construction documents * Manage multiple active projects and competing deadlines * Establish and maintain drafting standards, procedures, and file organization * Provide guidance, training, and support to drafting department staff * Identify opportunities to improve drafting efficiency and processes * Develop practical and creative solutions to design and construction challenges * Support the use of emerging design technologies, including AI\-assisted tools, to create architectural renderings and visualize future projects. Qualifications * **5\+ years of architectural drafting/design experience** * **Residential construction/homebuilding experience required** * Strong working knowledge of **2D AutoCAD** * Ability to publish and print complete drawing sets * Experience creating and saving DWF files * Knowledge of residential floor plans, framing, roof layouts, elevations, and site plans * Ability to read and address engineering comments * Understanding of the residential construction process from design through construction * Strong organizational and project\-management skills * Ability to effectively manage multiple projects simultaneously * Strong attention to detail * Ability to communicate professionally with homebuyers, coworkers, engineers, and trade partners * Self\-motivated and able to work independently while following established procedures * Strong problem\-solving skills and a creative approach to residential design * Interest in and willingness to learn new design and visualization technologies, including AI\-assisted rendering tools. **Previous drafting department supervisory or management experience is preferred but not required for a highly qualified candidate with strong residential drafting and project leadership experience.** Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Paid time off Application Question(s): * How many years of experience do you have preparing or modifying construction drawings for single\-family residential homes? * How many years of professional experience do you have using 2D AutoCAD? * Do you have professional experience creating or modifying residential construction documents, including floor plans, elevations, roof plans, framing plans and/or site plans? * Have you independently managed residential drafting projects from initial plans through construction\-ready documents, including plan revisions and coordination with engineering and/or construction teams? * Are you able to work full\-time, in person in Colorado Springs, Colorado? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **WHY DO WE NEED YOU?** Saint\-Gobain is seeking an experienced **Automation Engineer** to support the implementation and ongoing advancement of automation, systems integration, and data acquisition solutions across our Specialty Grains and Powders manufacturing operations. **This role will be based out of our Amherst, NY manufacturing facility with domestic travel up to 50%.** In this role, you will design and implement Industry 4\.0 solutions that improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, and overall manufacturing performance. You will work with plant teams, process experts, and technical partners to deliver projects involving Manufacturing Execution Systems, quality management systems, robotics, controls, instrumentation, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who enjoys solving complex manufacturing challenges, working directly with plant teams, and taking projects from initial concept through installation and startup. The position reports to the Digital Transformation Manager and supports multiple manufacturing locations. What You Will Do * Plan, design, implement, test, and support Industry 4\.0 projects, including Manufacturing Execution Systems and digital Quality Management Systems. * Lead automation projects through requirements definition, design and build, installation, startup, and ongoing support. * Develop and implement automation solutions involving PLCs, robotics, collaborative robots, automated production lines, controls, and instrumentation. * Perform requirements gathering, technical analysis, and gap assessments to translate business needs into effective technical solutions. * Manage technical deliverables and communicate project scope, schedules, risks, issues, and progress. * Develop modeling, artificial intelligence, and machine\-learning solutions focused on reducing operational losses and improving process and product stability. * Troubleshoot newly installed and existing automation systems, controls, and manufacturing processes. * Work directly with operators and manufacturing teams to identify improvement opportunities and implement practical solutions. * Coordinate internal and external resources, including automation integrators, to complete projects. * Create and maintain technical, process, training, and compliance documentation. * Train plant employees and local system champions on new equipment, systems, processes, and procedures. * Support integration between manufacturing systems, enterprise systems, production operations, supply chain, and quality processes. * Ensure projects comply with applicable company standards, plant requirements, IT controls, and governmental regulations. * Collaborate with the broader Industry 4\.0 and Operational Excellence teams to develop and share technical knowledge across the organization. * Balance long\-term project responsibilities with unplanned operational and troubleshooting priorities. **IS THIS JOB FOR YOU?** Required Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Chemical, Mechanical, Industrial, Control Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * Five to ten years of experience in process optimization, automation, manufacturing engineering, or a related technical field. * Strong data analysis and problem\-solving capabilities. * Strong organizational and project\-management skills. * Effective interpersonal and communication skills. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively across technical, operational, and business teams. * Self\-motivated approach with the ability to gather and coordinate the resources needed to complete projects. * **No Sponsorship will be offered for this role** Preferred Qualifications * Experience executing Manufacturing Execution System projects, including requirements analysis, solution design, software development, and implementation. * Experience with Ignition or a comparable industrial application platform. * Experience with Python or other programming languages. * Experience implementing process\-automation solutions in a manufacturing environment. * Experience integrating manufacturing systems with ERP platforms. * Experience with robotics, collaborative robots, PLCs, automated equipment, industrial controls, or production\-line instrumentation. * Exposure to artificial intelligence, machine learning, or manufacturing data\-modeling applications. **A LITTLE MORE ABOUT US** ***Why work for us?*** Saint‑Gobain is a global company with a 360‑year legacy, combining the stability of a Global 500 organization with the agility and entrepreneurial spirit of small, innovative start‑ups. It is one of only two companies worldwide consistently recognized as both a Top Global Employer and a Top 100 Global Innovator, supported by nearly 200,000 diverse employees collaborating across the globe. Saint\-Gobain Ceramics Division specializes in ceramic\-based solutions for industrial clients. Our product range spans from advanced ceramic grains and powders, to specialty refractories and ceramic systems. We offer “Material Solutions That Make a Difference”, in the sense that our ceramic products and services are mission\-critical to our customers’ own applications. At the heart of industry, we pride ourselves in serving segment\-leading customers across the world, through long\-term, trust\-based relationships. At Saint\-Gobain, our employees have pride in belonging to an organization whose culture is made up of these core values: Trust, Empowerment, \& Collaboration. Our company encourages diversity and inclusion in all its forms while our products make the world a more beautiful, safer, and sustainable home. **LEGAL STATEMENT** Saint\-Gobain provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - NY
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Scope Labs builds products for startups and modernizes systems for enterprises. As a preferred Cognition partner, we pair our engineers with Devin, their AI software engineer, to move at a speed traditional teams can't match. Scope is a team of founders consisting of experienced product managers, designers, and developers. Our expertise lies in challenging fundamental assumptions, dissecting legacy behaviors, simplifying intricate processes, and delivering experiences that leave a lasting impact. We are a small, but driven team and are looking to expand! **Our Team** We're currently a small team passionate about developing the next generation of digital products. Our founding team has spent time building, designing, and scaling products at places like Google, Tesla, Palantir, Peloton, Scale AI, MIT, Yale, Columbia, Y Combinator, and more. We're currently hiring for an in person role working from warm and sunny New York City. **What We're Looking For** As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Scope Labs, you won't just be implementing solutions. You'll be embedded directly with our startup customers, owning the entire technical relationship from day one. We're looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering, product instinct, and customer partnership; someone who can walk into a startup's codebase on Monday and ship something meaningful by Friday. This role is for a builder who is equally comfortable digging into a customer's production environment and white boarding a new AI workflow with their engineering lead. You'll be deploying cutting\-edge AI tooling into real startup workflows at the frontier of what's possible, and you'll be the reason those deployments succeed. The specifics of what we're building are still under wraps, but if you're excited by the idea of being one of the first people to bring genuinely new technology into the hands of fast\-moving teams, this is that role. You will represent Scope Labs in the field. That means operating with autonomy, exercising strong judgment under ambiguity, and holding yourself accountable for outcomes, not just outputs. **Responsibilities** You'll own the full technical customer lifecycle. From initial deployment through activation and ongoing utilization, you are the person who makes sure our customers are actually getting value, not just access. You'll identify and champion high\-impact use cases. You'll work closely with startup engineering teams to understand their workflows, identify where AI can meaningfully accelerate them, and get those integrations shipped. You'll be the voice of the customer internally. You'll bring patterns, friction points, and product insights back to our Product and Engineering teams, helping shape the roadmap based on what you're seeing in the field. **Preferred Qualifications** * 3\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Software Engineer with consulting or startup experience. Former technical founders are strongly encouraged to apply. * Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript with a track record of shipping production software. * Hands\-on experience deploying or integrating AI tooling, including LLMs, AI agents, or AI\-native developer tools, into real workflows. * High agency with comfort operating in ambiguous environments and limited direction. * Strong communication skills across audiences, from senior engineers to non\-technical founders. * Team\-first attitude with the ability to juggle multiple customer engagements simultaneously. **Bonus Points** * Experience with AI agent frameworks, MCP servers, or autonomous coding tools in production. * Background in a specific startup or enterprise vertical such as fintech, developer tools, or healthcare. * Direct UX/UI experience or strong product sense. * A portfolio of passion projects or initiatives you've directly built or majority\-contributed to. *If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!* **Salary and Benefits** The expected salary range for this role is based on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Salary Range: $150,000\-$200,000 or monthly contract equivalent. This position is based in New York, NY, and requires candidates to reside in or be willing to relocate to the area. **Equal Opportunity Employer** At Scope we take pride in our best asset, our people! We focus on ensuring that our culture makes life better for the team! Scope Labs is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to diversity in its workforce. We actively encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters innovation and creativity, and we welcome candidates who share our values of respect, collaboration, and excellence. To perform this job successfully, the employee(s) will possess the skills, aptitudes, and abilities to perform each duty proficiently. Some requirements may exclude individuals who pose a direct threat or significant risk to the health or safety of themselves or others. The requirements listed in this document are the minimum levels of knowledge, skills, or abilities. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an at will relationship. To confirm you've read this far, please include the word "lighthouse" as the first word of your cover letter or application answer. Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

We are seeking an experienced **Data Engineer** to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines within a Databricks E2 environment hosted on AWS and governed by FISMA High and multi\-tenant security and compliance standards. The ideal candidate has strong hands\-on experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, and the broader AWS data ecosystem. collect data from various sources, including relational databases, APIs, external data providers, and real\-time streaming sources. * Design and implement efficient, scalable data pipelines to cleanse, transform, and aggregate data for downstream reporting and analytics. * Build and maintain Databricks solutions using medallion architecture, including Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers, to create structured, reliable, and progressively refined datasets. * Develop source\-to\-target mapping documentation for all data pipelines and conduct thorough unit testing to validate data accuracy and pipeline logic. * Write advanced SQL to create aggregations across complex datasets and analyze data for anomalies, quality issues, and inconsistencies. * Implement real\-time and near\-real\-time data ingestion using AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) and other AWS\-native services. * Develop data\-processing logic using Python and/or R, leveraging Spark and related packages such as PySpark and Pandas for large\-scale data transformation. * Manage source code, versioning, and deployments using GitLab, and support automated build and release processes through CI/CD pipelines. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams in an Agile project environment, participating in sprint planning, stand\-ups, and iterative delivery. * Ensure that data engineering practices align with FISMA High and multi\-tenant security, governance, and compliance requirements. * Leverage AI automation tools to support data engineering pipeline development, testing, and validation and to accelerate delivery. **Required Qualifications** * Proven, hands\-on experience as a Data Engineer or Databricks Developer building production\-grade data pipelines. * Strong working knowledge of Databricks on AWS, including E2 architecture, cluster configuration, job orchestration, and workspace management. * Hands\-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, and Pandas for large\-scale, distributed data processing. * Solid programming skills in Python; working knowledge of R is a plus. * Experience with Databricks Auto Loader for scalable, incremental file ingestion. * Practical experience with AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) for change data capture and real\-time data replication. * Strong experience with Delta Lake and Delta tables, including schema evolution, time travel, and optimization techniques such as OPTIMIZE, Z\-ORDER, and VACUUM. * Experience with Amazon RDS and other relational database sources used in data extraction and integration workflows. * Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, window functions, aggregations, and performance tuning. * Solid understanding of medallion architecture and modern data lakehouse design principles. * Experience with GitLab and CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, build, and deployment of data engineering code. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum project environments. **Preferred Skills** * Broader knowledge of AWS services beyond DMS and RDS, including S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, CloudWatch, and IAM. * Experience operating within FISMA High, FedRAMP, or other regulated, multi\-tenant compliance environments. * Familiarity with data quality frameworks, anomaly detection techniques, and automated data validation. * Exposure to infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation for provisioning data platform resources. * Knowledge of streaming technologies such as Kafka, Kinesis, or Spark Structured Streaming. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** jobs.title: Enterprise Data Architect – Customer Data Platform (Azure Databricks Lakehouse)
jobs.description: **ASCEND Program Information:** Southern Company is committed to building the future of energy for the customers who depend on us, the communities we serve and the industry we lead. The ASCEND program will transform how we do business, helping us elevate the customer experience, adapt to industry changes, and implement technology that offers new capabilities with more agility. It will involve implementing multiple applications, including the replacement of our meter data management (MDM) and customer service systems (CSS) with a new, Oracle customer information system (CIS) called customer to meter (C2M). Additionally, it includes implementing an advanced analytics platform, customer experience (CX) and commercial engagement platform (CEP). The new platform, to be rolled out to Alabama Power, Georgia Power and Mississippi Power, will be implemented in phases. Currently, we are building an ASCEND organization dedicated to helping the electric operating companies realize the vision for a modernized, efficient, digital customer experience to deeply engage with our customers and provide a more personalized experience. ASCEND will be one of the most comprehensive Customer Service and Marketing transformation initiatives in our company’s history. CIS\_PROJECT.pdf for more information about the CIS/MDM program and to view FAQs The successful candidate will remain an employee of the operating company while reporting to the CIS/MDM Program Team and may report to a SCS or operating company leader for delivery. Positions within the CIS Program will be filled based on the job requirements and the business needs and overall project scope. Candidates should answer all applicable questions thoroughly as this information will be used to select the successful candidates. While these roles are expected to be hybrid work, approximately 25% travel is anticipated and for this reason, it is preferred that resources are located within the electric service territory. The successful candidate will remain an employee of the operating company while reporting to the CIS/MDM Project Team and may report to a Southern Company Services or operating company leader for delivery. **Job Title: Enterprise Data Architect – Customer Data Platform (Azure Databricks Lakehouse)** \*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*This position follows a hybrid work schedule and requires working on\-site three (3\) days per week and remotely two (2\) days per week. \*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\* **Why this role** Our Azure Databricks Lakehouse is the system of record for replicated Customer Information System (CIS) data for approximately 4\.6 million electric utility customers. It feeds billing, rates, credit management, payments, service orders, and metering and usage reporting, and it is the foundation for our analytics, data science, and AI work. As the technical authority for this platform, you will set the architecture, standards, and roadmap, and you will serve as the final architectural approval authority for the Customer Data Platform ecosystem. This is a highly visible, cross\-functional role where reliability and auditability matter, and where your decisions shape how a major utility uses its customer data for years to come. **About the role** You will lead the design, governance, and evolution of the Lakehouse, working at the intersection of enterprise architecture, data engineering, and utility business operations. You will define how CIS data is replicated, secured, and consumed across the enterprise, supporting both batch and near\-real\-time needs, and you will partner with enterprise architects, application teams, cybersecurity, vendors, and business stakeholders to turn business priorities into scalable solutions. **What you will do** * Own the end\-to\-end architecture and strategic direction of the Lakehouse, from ingestion through consumption, including medallion design patterns and Delta Lake implementation. * Architect near\-real\-time and batch replication of CIS data, and lead decisions on Change Data Capture (CDC), streaming, and integration technologies to meet defined service level objectives. * Guide data engineers who are defining logical and physical data models and the standards that support operational reporting, business intelligence, advanced analytics, data products, and regulatory needs. * Establish standards for data quality, lineage, cataloging, observability, and metadata management using Unity Catalog and enterprise metadata tools. * Design and govern the integration patterns that downstream operational, analytical, and regulatory applications use to consume customer, billing, metering, and premise data. * Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance teams on access control, encryption, masking, and regulatory controls, and design for high availability, disaster recovery, and operational resilience. * Work with data engineers, and data science and analytics teams to create architectural patterns for machine learning, generative AI, and a lic utility commission requirements. * Experience with Apache Spark, Delta Live Tables, Structured Streaming, Databricks Workflows, Event Hubs, or Kafka. * Experience with platform resiliency, FinOps, and capacity planning on Azure and Databricks. * Experience with Agile, SAFe, and product\-oriented delivery models. Master’s degree, or Azure, Databricks, or architecture certifications. * **What we value** * Business value mindset. You deliver business outcomes, not just technical solutions. * Ownership and accountability. You take personal responsibility for commitments and follow through without needing close oversight. * Collaborative leadership. You build trust across business and technology teams and influence constructively at every level. * Constructive courage. You challenge assumptions and raise concerns early, with diplomacy and candor, even when it is unpopular. Stewardship and integrity. You act as a trusted steward of enterprise data, holding to high standards of security, compliance, and integrity. * **First 12 months** * Close the highest\-risk gaps in data quality, latency, lineage, and access control. * Stand up a working architecture\-review practice so new pipelines and data products follow the standard. * Baseline platform reliability and cost and use that baseline in capacity and design decisions. Craft a written roadmap that ties the next platform investments to customer and revenue priorities. * This job description does not, nor is it intended to represent an exhaustive listing of all duties, tasks or responsibilities for the position listed. Based upon individual experience and team workload, responsibilities are assigned in varying degrees. **About Southern Company** Southern Company (NYSE: SO ) is a leading energy provider serving 9 million customers across the Southeast and beyond through its family of companies. Providing clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy with excellent service is our mission. The company has electric operating companies in three states, natural gas distribution companies in four states, a competitive generation company, a leading distributed energy solutions provider with national capabilities, a fiber optics network and telecommunications services. Through an industry\-leading commitment to innovation, resilience and sustainability, we are taking action to meet customers' and communities' needs while advancing our goal of net\-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050\. Our uncompromising values ensure we put the needs of those we serve at the center of everything we do and are the key to our sustained success. We are transforming energy into economic, environmental and social progress for tomorrow. Our corporate culture has been recognized by a variety of organizations, earning the company awards and recognitions that reflect Our Values and dedication to service. To learn more, visit www.southerncompany.com . Southern Company invests in the well\-being of its employees and their families through a comprehensive total rewards strategy that includes competitive base salary, annual incentive awards for eligible employees and health, welfare and retirement benefits designed to support physical, financial, and emotional/social well\-being. This position may also be eligible for additional compensation, such as an incentive program, with the amount of any bonus/awards subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan(s). jobs.title: Software Engineer - Linux Kernel (C++, C)
jobs.description: SpaceXAI's mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge. Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands\-on and to contribute directly to the company's mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates. At SpaceXAI, we design, build, and operate the largest AI supercomputers in the world, from the ground up. As a member of the Platform Core team, you will be responsible for the lowest layers of the software stack on the devices setting the pace for how fast we can push the frontier of AI. Our team's software interfaces directly with the core hardware of the supercomputer and its network fabric. Our mission is to expose the full capability of that hardware — limited only by physics — to the rest of the stack, all while retaining the smallest, most robust footprint possible. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Build and maintain the lean, high\-reliability Linux\-based operating system that underpins our supercomputer network fabric. * Write (or rewrite) high\-performance device drivers to extract the maximum physical capability from our network and compute hardware. * Manage deployment, operation, and debugging of our platform in production, including: * + Rigorous resolution and root\-causing of anomalies to ensure the system is constantly improving in reliability. + Developing and constantly improving our tools for observability and configuration management. * Collaborate with our hardware teams and external partners to design the next generation of supercomputer hardware – and then bring up our OS and software stack on it. ### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Hands\-on systems programming experience in C or C\+\+. * Strong operating systems fundamentals (scheduling, memory management, I/O) — you must be able to articulate in extreme detail how a computer works, from the hardware all the way up to high\-level applications. * Understanding of computer networking, both in the host (OS stack) as well as common network devices like switches and routers. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. ### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel and its networking stack — transferable experience with another production\-grade kernel is okay, too! * Proficiency with debugging tools spanning kernel, network, and userspace (e.g., ftrace, perf, Wireshark/tcpdump, eBPF, gdb, and more). * Experience bringing up new hardware from scratch — you have flashed bare\-metal software on a microcontroller with JTAG, or bootstrapped a Linux kernel and rootfs on new hardware. * Demonstrated track record of developing and optimizing device/peripheral drivers — ideally for high\-speed interfaces, or with advanced considerations like DMA and cache coherency. * Understanding of major peripheral hardware interface standards (Ethernet, PCIe, I2C, SPI, etc.) — you can critically review a schematic, and debug these interfaces if needed. * Experience with product security, OS/system hardening, and secure boot schemes. ### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** $180,000 \- $440,000 USD Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at xAI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. *SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. Solutions Engineers to deliver demos and narratives that land with each trade's specific priorities * Move with real urgency — cycles typically run under 90 days — and keep Salesforce clean, current, full\-cycle AE with a documented track record of hitting or beating number, ideally with experience managing larger, more complex accounts (this isn't a first\-AE\-seat role) * Experience selling operational, multi\-stakeholder B2B software — think project management, manufacturing, industrial, or similar — where you built ROI cases and ran a real value\-selling motion (not high\-velocity, single\-tool transactional sales) * A genuine hunter's mentality and comfort self\-sourcing pipeline, even at the enterprise level — we're looking for people who've proven they can win without relying on a big brand name or an existing marketing engine to open doors * Success in an early\-growth environment (think Series B/C) — scrappy, coachable, and comfortable building process rather than
