jobs.description: Stratus, deriving from the Latin term meaning 'layer', offers an advanced set of MEP specific solutions that seamlessly layer across a contractor's entire workflow from design to fabrication to installation. Our team of seasoned industry experts, skilled technology leaders, innovators, and entrepreneurs understands that fabrication does not occur in isolation, and increasingly, it may not happen within your own fabrication shop. Through close relationships with our customers—who include some of the most innovative and largest MEP contractors—we have developed a suite of Stratus tools to digitize, automate, and optimize piping, plumbing, sheet metal, and electrical contracting. Stratus provides the software layer an MEP Contractor needs to optimize profits with true "Data Driven Contracting." **GENERAL DESCRIPTION:** The Senior Site Reliability Engineer is accountable for how Stratus behaves in production. Reporting to the Senior Director, Platform Engineering, this role brings genuine SRE discipline to a platform that MEP contractors run their fabrication shops on — where downtime does not mean a degraded experience, it means work stops on a job site. Stratus is a \~50\-person, primarily remote, Series B software company growing quickly. Unrelenting Reliability is one of our company values, and this is the role that operationalizes it. You will define what reliable means in numbers, instrument the system so we can see it, and close the loop from production signal back into engineering priority. This is an engineering role with a production mandate: you will write code, tune queries, build alerting, run load tests, and lead incidents — and you will be measured on customer\-visible availability and latency, not on tickets closed. The load\-bearing problems on your plate are: (1\) establishing service level objectives and an error budget the whole engineering organization operates against, with the measurement infrastructure to back them; (2\) building the detection and response capability — high\-signal alerting, clear on\-call and escalation paths, per\-system incident ownership, and well\-exercised recovery paths — so that production problems are caught and resolved fast; and (3\) building the performance and capacity engineering practice for our data and messaging layers, with headroom measured rather than assumed. You will work across every engineering pod, with our platform and security functions, and with the customer\-facing teams who see reliability problems first. The right candidate is comfortable being the person who says a number out loud and defends it, and is drawn to a place where the reliability practice is being built rather than maintained. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Define and own service level indicators, objectives, and error budgets for customer\-facing services; build the measurement pipeline that makes them trustworthy and publish availability and latency against target on a regular cadence. * Build and own production observability: instrumentation standards, dashboards, and actionable alerting on our stack — AKS on Azure, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and Grafana, with Istio as the service mesh and Flux for GitOps — extending coverage across every environment. * Establish and run incident response practice — on\-call rotation and paging paths, severity definitions, per\-system incident ownership, escalation into and out of customer support, and blameless post\-mortems in incident.io. * Set the recovery standard: define what rollback and recovery must demonstrate, and verify through regular exercise that every service meets it. * Lead performance and capacity engineering: query and index tuning, connection\-pool sizing, capacity modeling against real load, and designing for graceful degradation under partial failure. * Work with the existing team that runs our k6 load, stress, spike, and soak testing against a production\-like environment; help set per\-endpoint latency thresholds tied to our SLOs and make the results a gate on delivery. * Drive production readiness: review new services and significant changes against readiness criteria covering instrumentation, alerting, failure modes, resource limits, and rollback before they ship. * Close the loop on remediation: track post\-mortem action items through to verified production change. * Contribute to business continuity and disaster recovery planning, including backup and restore validation, failover design, and recovery objectives. * Partner with engineering pods to push reliability ownership outward — coach teams on instrumenting and operating their own services. * Write code: tooling, automation, instrumentation libraries, and fixes in the production codebase. **QUALIFICATIONS:** * 6\+ years of professional engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years in a dedicated SRE or production engineering role at a B2B SaaS company. * Demonstrated ownership of SLOs and error budgets in production — you have defined them, measured them, argued about them with product leadership, and changed engineering behavior with them. * Deep, practical observability skills with Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, and Grafana or comparable: you have instrumented real systems and built alerting that pages on customer impact rather than on CPU. * Hands\-on incident command experience at meaningful severity, including building on\-call and escalation practice from the ground up. * Strong database performance skills — query profiling, index design, connection pooling, and diagnosing saturation under load. MongoDB experience strongly preferred; comparable document or relational depth acceptable. * Production Kubernetes experience (AKS preferred) sufficient to debug a live problem — pod scheduling, resource limits, networking, and service mesh behavior (Istio preferred). * Solid coding ability in at least one general\-purpose language (Go, Python, C\#, or TypeScript); willingness to work in a C\#/.NET codebase. * Experience with load and performance testing tooling (k6, JMeter, Gatling, or comparable) and with turning results into engineering priority. * Production experience on Azure or AWS, with real understanding of the failure modes of managed services. * Fluency with AI\-assisted engineering tooling and a track record of designing AI\-leveraged workflows for your team — this is a graded expectation at every level at Stratus. * Excellent written communication: you write post\-mortems, runbooks, and reliability reports that executives and engineers both read and act on. * Judgment and steadiness under pressure, and the credibility to tell engineering and product leadership something they do not want to hear. **NICE TO HAVE:** * Experience establishing or maturing an SRE practice — defining the discipline, not inheriting it. * Experience with Sentry or comparable application error\-monitoring platforms. * Experience operating event\-driven and real\-time systems — message brokers (Azure Service Bus, Kafka) and websocket or push layers (SignalR or comparable). * Experience operating MongoDB Atlas at production scale, including replica set topology and Atlas performance tooling. * Experience with durable workflow orchestration (Temporal or comparable). * Background in multi\-region or multi\-zone architecture and DR design against stated recovery objectives. * Experience with incident.io, PagerDuty, or comparable incident management platforms. * Familiarity with DORA metrics and with reliability work inside SOC 2 or NIST 800\-171 scope. * Experience with legacy monolith reliability — improving the operational behavior of an ASP.NET or comparable application you cannot rewrite. * Domain interest in MEP, BIM, AEC, or construction technology. * Prior experience in a Series B / growth\-stage company navigating the transition from product\-market fit to scale. **BENEFITS:** * Comprehensive and competitive health benefits plan * Matching 401k contributions * 20 days annual PTO * Primarily remote work with occasional annual team onsites. E\-VERIFY STATEMENT *Stratus* *participates* *in E\-Verify. After you join the team,* *we'll* *verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by* *submitting* *information from your Form I\-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post\-hire only* *\-* *we never use E\-Verify to pre\-screen applicants.* E\-Verify Notice Right to Work Notice

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive
jobs.description: Stratus, is the leading cloud\-based platform for MEP contractors. We’re on a mission to revolutionize the construction industry by providing innovative data driven solutions that seamlessly layer across a contractor’s entire workflow from design, to fabrication, to installation. **About Stratus** Stratus is the leading cloud\-based platform for MEP contractors. We're on a mission to revolutionize the construction industry by providing innovative, data\-driven solutions that seamlessly layer across a contractor's entire workflow from design, to fabrication, to installation. **The Role** This is a quota\-carrying role focused on Stratus's most important relationships: the 50 largest MEP contractors in North America. These organizations rarely buy as one company. They are parent companies with multiple operating companies underneath, each with its own leadership, processes, and buying authority. Your job is to understand how each one actually makes decisions, win the operating companies, and turn that footprint into enterprise\-wide licensing agreements worth seven figures. You'll own a focused book of named strategic accounts and be backed by Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Product, and direct access to our executive team. We're still building our strategic accounts motion. If shaping how Stratus partners with the biggest names in MEP excites you, you'll thrive here. If you need a fully built\-out program on day one, this probably isn't your seat. **What You'll Do** * Own a named book of strategic accounts within the top 50 MEP contractors and consistently exceed a \~$2M annual quota * Map multi\-layered account structures (parent companies, operating companies, regional divisions, and acquired businesses) and understand where decisions are made centrally versus locally * Land and expand across operating companies, then convert those deployments into enterprise\-wide licensing agreements negotiated at the parent level * Lead seven\-figure, multi\-year deals from strategy through signature, including pricing structure, ramp schedules, rollout plans, and commercial terms * Build executive relationships at both the parent and operating company level: CEOs, CFOs, COOs, and CIOs at the top, with operating company Presidents, VPs of Operations, and VDC/BIM and fabrication leaders as champions * Navigate enterprise procurement, legal, IT, and security reviews, and manage MSA and enterprise agreement negotiations alongside finance and legal partners * Build and maintain strategic account plans covering relationship maps, whitespace by operating company, competitive position, and a multi\-year expansion strategy * Quantify value at enterprise scale, from standardizing workflows and data across operating companies to giving parent company leadership visibility into fabrication and field performance * Orchestrate the full Stratus team, including Solutions Engineers, Customer Success, Product, and executive sponsors, to deliver a coordinated experience for every account * Forecast accurately on longer, multi\-quarter sales cycles and keep Salesforce clean, current, and forecast\-ready * Bring the voice of our largest customers back to Product and Leadership; what you learn will directly shape our roadmap **What You'll Bring** * 7\+ years of quota\-carrying B2B sales experience, including 2\+ years managing strategic, named, or major accounts * A documented track record of closing seven\-figure deals * Proven experience converting existing customers or business\-unit deployments into large, organization\-wide enterprise licensing agreements * Experience navigating complex, multi\-layered organizations: holding companies, parent and operating company structures, PE\-backed platforms, or acquisition\-driven roll\-ups * Experience selling operational, multi\-stakeholder software (think construction technology, ERP, project management, manufacturing, or industrial) where you built ROI cases and ran a real value\-selling motion * Executive presence and credibility in the boardroom, with the ability to align C\-suite stakeholders who don't always agree * Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including multi\-year agreements, enterprise pricing structures, and working through redlines with procurement and legal * The patience to run long, complex cycles combined with the urgency to keep them moving * Fluency in MEDDPICC or a similar qualification methodology * A data\-driven approach and enthusiasm for using AI to work smarter (it's core to how we operate and what we sell) * Proficiency in Salesforce (or similar CRM) and a knack for picking up new tools quickly * Open to \~40% travel, including on\-site executive meetings and operating company visits **Bonus Points** * Existing relationships within the top MEP, mechanical, electrical, or plumbing contractors in North America * Experience selling into construction, contractors, or the built environment * Experience selling into PE\-backed platforms or companies growing through acquisition * Prior strategic or enterprise sales success at a growth\-stage SaaS company **Why Stratus** At Stratus, you'll own the relationships that define our company's future. You'll work directly with our executive team, help build our strategic accounts program from the ground up, and see your customers' feedback show up in the product. This fully remote opportunity lets you balance work and life while making a tangible impact on the largest contractors in the industry. As a Strategic Account Executive, you'll play a crucial role in helping drive our mission to transform the construction industry. Grow with us as we make an impact! **E\-Verify Statement** Stratus participates in E\-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I\-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post\-hire only \- we never use E\-Verify to pre\-screen applicants. *E\-Verify Notice* *Right to Work Notice*

jobs.title: Application Engineer IV, Dynamics 365
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Application Engineers are responsible for designing, developing and maintaining software applications that meet the needs of the organization. They collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including developers, business analysts, and end\-users to ensure applications are optimized for performance, usability and reliability. Employees serving at this level \- Application Engineer IV \- are expected to perform as expert professionals, providing technical leadership to others internally and externally in a specific field of expertise. They also may guide less\-experienced staff on their technical and professional development. **In this role:** This is the technical lead role for our CRM engineering practice (MS Dynamics 365 / Power Platform). Our CRM platform has grown significantly in scope — now spanning Claims, Warranty, Customer Support, and Parts \& Service — and we're building out internal engineering capacity to match that growth. You will formally set technical direction — architecture, patterns, and standards — and you'll mentor the engineers building inside them. This is the natural next step for a platform that required hands\-on engineering acumen to reach the next level of business\-readiness. **Primary Responsibilities** **Application Software Development: 20%** Develop the most complex existing and new applications by analyzing and identifying areas for modification and improvement. Develop new applications to meet business needs. **In this role:** * Architect and, where needed, personally build the most complex solutions in Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and the surrounding Azure ecosystem. * Provide expert\-level Dataverse plugin development (C\#), client\-side scripting, and business rule/workflow authoring. * Leverage the full\-stack range (JavaScript/TypeScript, C\#/.NET, REST/SOAP APIs, ETL workflows) to build and review integrations across Claims, Warranty, Customer Support, and Parts \& Service. **Application Software Maintenance: 20%** Lead monitoring, identifying, and correcting the most complex software defects to maintain fully functioning applications software. **In this role:** * Serve as the internal standard\-bearer for SecOps and IT governance. * Ensure everything built on the platform, by employees or by our SI vendor, meets company security and compliance standards. * Own the technical relationship with the SI vendor. * Review vendor deliverables for quality and standards alignment. * Identify what should move in\-house over time. **Application Software Road Map: 15%** Define and maintain a roadmap to facilitate complex application software development and ensure the development work is prioritized in line with business requirements. **In this role:** * Define how things get built — architecture, design patterns, coding standards, and engineering best practices for the CRM platform. * Design and own the platform's ALM/DevOps backbone. * Establish environment strategy, solution packaging and release pipelines, and promotion governance across dev/test/prod. **Testing Performance: 15%** Design and monitor the quality of complex and interrelated website/applications software tests and respond to user emails to monitor, diagnose, and correct performance issues. **In this role:** * Set and enforce the team's quality bar. * Review designs and code from both engineers and the SI vendor. * Unblock hard problems. * Raise the standard for what “done well” looks like across the platform. **Documentation and Backup: 15%** Create and maintain complex technical and/or user documentation to a high standard, and back up files to ensure instant recovery if problems occur. **In this role:** * Document the architecture, patterns, and standards you define, so they outlive any one project. * Establish foundational technical documentation where none currently exists. **Horizon Scanning: 15%** Identify new external developments and/or emerging issues within an area of technology or business function and evaluate their potential impact on, or usefulness to, the organization. **In this role:** * Track emerging tools, patterns, and platform capabilities in the Dynamics/Power Platform/Azure ecosystem, including AI\-assisted development tooling. * Provide informed recommendations on which technologies are worth adopting based on business value, not novelty. **Job Requirements** * At least 8\-10 years of relevant and progressive work experience (Preferred) **Application Development:** * Works at an advanced level to develop software through the use of programming languages. **IT Testing:** * Works at an advanced level to design, execute and report on systems/service tests to ensure that an application functions as specified in the requirements. **Data Collection and Analysis:** * Works at an advanced level to determine and analyze trends from data that is collected to assist in compiling reports that will help in decision\-making. **Categorizing and Classifying Information:** * Work ng work you didn't personally write, including work from an external vendor or contractor. * Comfort operating without a technical leader above you — this role is that technical leader for the team. **These will make a candidate stand out:** * Microsoft certifications reflecting depth, not just entry (PL\-400, MB\-500/600\-series, AZ\-204/AZ\-305, or similar). * Prior experience standing up architecture or engineering standards from scratch on a team that didn't have them yet. * Experience specifically overseeing or grading the output of a systems integrator or outsourced delivery team. * Background across multiple Dynamics lines of business or complex, multi\-LOB CRM environments. **What Kind of Person Thrives Here** This role has no technical leader above it — the person in this seat is the ceiling on technical quality for this team. They'll be defining architecture and standards in real time, often while reviewing vendor work and mentoring newer engineers who are still finding their footing. That takes genuine expert\-level depth, real comfort setting direction without someone validating it, and the patience to teach what they know. Someone who's been the person other engineers came to when something was genuinely hard (and liked being that person) is exactly who we're looking for. **What We Support** This role sits within our CRM practice, which runs MS Dynamics 365 across Claims, Warranty, Customer Advocacy, and Service and Quality. **TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS** * International and Domestic: 15% **EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:** BA/ BS, 8–10 years of progressive IT experience. **WORK EXPERIENCE** * **Office Location:** Camden, NJ apart of the Greater Philadelphia Area (Philly) * **Hybrid Role:** Hybrid Role \- Remote work 2 days per week (after 90 days) \[Wednesdays \& Fridays] **COMPENSATION:** The recruiting base salary range for this full\-time position is $150,000 \- $165,000 / year. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Additionally, this role is **bonus\-eligible** , with a target bonus percentage that provides an opportunity to earn even more based on your performance. (Internal Job Grade: P4\_T) **WHY JOIN US?** In addition to competitive salary and an incomparable culture, Subaru offers an amazing benefits package that include: **Total Rewards \& Benefits:** * Medical, Dental, Vision Plans * Pension, Profit Sharing, and 401K Match Offerings * 15 Vacation days, 5 Floating Holidays, 5 Sick days, and 9 Company Holidays * Tuition Reimbursement Program: Fifteen\-thousand\-dollar yearly benefit * Vehicle Discount Programs **Learning \& Development:** * Professional growth and development opportunities * Direct partnership with senior leadership * Formal Mentorship Program * LinkedIn Learning License Visit our careers landing page for additional information about our compensation and benefit programs. **ABOUT SUBARU** Love. It’s what makes Subaru, Subaru®. As a leading auto brand in the US, we strive to be More Than a Car Company®. Subaru believes in being a positive force in the communities in which we live and work, not just with donations but with actions that set an example for others to follow. That’s what we call our Subaru Love Promise®. Subaru is a globally renowned automobile manufacturer known for its commitment to innovation, safety, and sustainability. With a rich history dating back to 1953, Subaru has consistently pushed the boundaries of automotive engineering to deliver vehicles that offer not only exceptional performance but also a unique blend of utility and adventure. Subaru's company culture is built on collaboration, diversity, and a shared passion for our product. We foster an inclusive environment that encourages employees to bring their unique perspectives and talents to the table. Our team members are driven by a common goal: to create exceptional vehicles that inspire and delight our customers.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description: Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast\-growing, and high\-performing network of public charter schools takes a village \- families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole\-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential. ### **About the Role** As an AI Product Manager at Success Academy, you will sit at the intersection of business strategy, school operations, and emerging technology to drive AI\-powered innovation across a growing network of 57\+ schools. Sitting alongside engineers, data scientists, UX designers, and organizational leadership, you will own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of generative AI tools that empower educators and streamline enterprise workflows. This role is central to Success Academy's mission to scale educational excellence, ensuring that cutting\-edge AI features translate directly into measurable efficiency gains and improved student outcomes. ### **Key Responsibilities** * Own the end\-to\-end AI product lifecycle, guiding features from initial discovery and ROI\-focused prioritization through to delivery and continuous optimization. * Translate complex stakeholder needs and high\-level business goals into precise AI/ML feature requirements for engineering and data science teams. * Design intuitive and seamless AI experiences by collaborating with UX/UI and technical teams to integrate LLMs, RAG pipelines, and ML outputs into daily workflows. * Establish evaluation metrics and design experimentation frameworks alongside data scientists to validate model performance and feature effectiveness. * Drive continuous product refinement by building user feedback loops that evolve models and AI capabilities based on real\-world adoption. * Act as the connective tissue across the organization, balancing technical feasibility with business impact to deliver high\-value AI solutions on schedule. * Contribute to shaping the broader organizational AI strategy, aligning product roadmaps with long\-term enterprise goals. ### **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of product management experience (AI/ML or data\-driven platforms preferred) with a track record of launching enterprise or customer\-facing tools. * Hands\-on experience building custom GPTs or basic AI applications, with familiarity in LLM ecosystems (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and GenAI concepts (RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases). * Demonstrated expertise in Agile environments using tools like Jira and Confluence to manage backlogs, jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** Symbotic is seeking an Electrical Engineer to design electrical hardware for automated material\-handling robots and related platforms. In this role you will contribute to the schematic design, PCB layout, analysis, prototype support, integration, and test of assigned electrical designs — boards, harnesses, and the interfaces that connect them — from design through release. You will carry assigned work through Symbotic’s Product Development Process (PDP). You will apply established design practices, broaden your capability in the discipline, and partner with more senior electrical designers and with mechanical, firmware, test, and manufacturing so those designs can be built and tested. **What we do** The Electrical Engineering – Bot Hardware team is part of Symbotic’s Hardware Engineering organization and develops the electrical hardware that powers and connects our robotic systems. Our team designs PCB\-based electronics, harnesses, and electrical interfaces that support power distribution, sensing, compute, communications, and control across our automation platforms. We partner closely with mechanical, firmware, test, manufacturing, and other engineering teams to integrate these designs into reliable, manufacturable robotic products and support them from development through production. **What you'll do** * Design electrical solutions of moderate scope for assigned boards, harnesses, and interfaces (power, sensing, compute interfaces, interconnect, and grounding), using established methods and precedent, and asking for guidance when the assignment is new. * Take assigned designs from schematic through prototype and release: schematic capture, PCB layout, bring\-up support, and the documentation needed for review and release. * Follow the PDP on your work — design reviews, requirements, verification, and release discipline — so assigned designs move on the same path as the rest of the program. * Design schematics and PCB layouts in Altium for assigned boards. Execute placement, routing, and DFM, and apply the stackup, SI/PI, and EMC practices already used on the platform, with review from a more senior designer. * Apply DfX (DFM, DFA, DFT, and related) so assigned designs are manufacturable and testable at the contract manufacturer. * Support PLM work for assigned items (BOM updates, ECO inputs, document release) and support contract\-manufacturer builds. * Contribute to requirements and test procedures, and execute the testing needed to confirm function of the assigned design, including support of EMC/EMI debug with a more senior engineer. * Investigate issues in the lab and implement corrective changes on assigned designs, with support on failures that extend beyond the board. * Select components within approved\-part and design practices for robotics, automation, and automotive\-class environments. * Give informal guidance to less experienced colleagues on day\-to\-day design tasks. * Travel occasionally to the lab, a contract manufacturer, or a site to support bring\-up of assigned hardware. **What you'll need** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. * 2\+ years of electrical design experience, or equivalent experience that shows the same capability. * Working knowledge of Altium schematic capture and PCB layout (or equivalent ECAD, with a demonstrated willingness to work in Altium). * Experience with electronics for automation, robotics, automotive, or similar embedded systems. * Contributes to board\-level design and to interfaces with the larger electrical system (power distribution, grounding, sensors, and interconnect), with guidance on system\-level tradeoffs. * Awareness of safety expectations on automation and robotic platforms, and ability to follow product safety requirements with guidance from Functional Safety. * Working knowledge of EMC/EMI fundamentals (grounding, filtering, return paths, and layout practices) and ability to support debug. * Applies DfX so assigned designs can be built and tested. * Able to follow a formal PDP / phase\-gate process, with moderate guidance on new assignments and little instruction on day\-to\-day work. * Familiarity with PLM and with contract\-manufacturer builds, or a clear ability to learn those practices on the job. * Builds productive working relationships and explains technical information clearly to teammates who know the subject. * Works collaboratively with mechanical, firmware, test, operations, and supply chain in a results\-oriented, project\-driven team. **Physical and Environment Requirements** * Wilmington, MA preferred (lab and cross\-functional presence). Occasional travel to contract manufacturers, test facilities, or sites as required. * Lab and occasional warehouse / site work around automated equipment. **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. jobs.title: Physical design Staff Application engineer
jobs.description: Hillsboro, Oregon, United States **Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 19123 **Base Salary Range** $112000\-$168000 **Date posted** 10/04/2026 ### **We Are**Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. ### **You Are** You have spent years in the trenches of physical design, working on chips that actually tape out and ship in products people use. The difference between a design that closes timing and one that burns three months of schedule is something you can see coming in the floorplan stage, and you are the kind of engineer who speaks up before it becomes a crisis. You know Fusion Compiler or ICC2 well enough that you can debug a routing congestion issue at 9pm on a customer call and walk out with a plan that actually works. Scripting is not a side skill for you, it is how you think. You build flows in TCL and Python that do not just automate tasks but make design decisions smarter and more predictable. When someone says "the tool is doing something weird," you are the one who digs into the log files, finds the root cause, and writes the fix that prevents it from happening again. You are comfortable working directly with customers, not just handing off a deck but sitting in the room, understanding their constraints, and building solutions that fit their reality. At Synopsys, you will work on the hardest physical design problems in the industry, on the most advanced nodes, with customers who are building the chips that power everything. ### **What You'll Be Doing** * Support customer engagements on advanced\-node designs at 7nm, 5nm, and below using Synopsys physical design tools including Fusion Compiler, helping them hit PPA targets under real schedule and resource constraints * Develop and enhance physical design methodologies and automation solutions using TCL, Python, and Perl to improve design quality, predictability, and team efficiency across the RTL\-to\-GDS flow * Debug complex physical design challenges including placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, timing closure, and power optimization on FinFET designs with multi\-patterning and electromigration constraints * Build and deliver methodology recommendations tailored to customer design constraints, process technologies, and project timelines, not generic best practices but solutions that fit their specific context Contribute to AI\-assisted and machine learning\-driven design optimization initiatives, * ing data\-driven approaches to solve implementation challenges that traditional methods struggle with * Collaborate with R\&D, product management, and field teams to translate customer pain points into product requirements and feature enhancements that make it into the next release * Travel to customer sites as needed to provide onsite support, training, and design reviews, often under tight deadlines and high\-stakes tape\-out pressure ### **The Impact You Will Have** * Enable customers to achieve timing closure and tape\-out success on advanced\-node designs that define next\-generation AI, mobile, and datacenter products * Build automation and methodology improvements that get reused across multiple customer engagements, multiplying your impact across dozens of designs * Shape the roadmap of Synopsys physical design tools by feeding real customer challenges directly into R\&D, influencing features that thousands of engineers will use * Reduce design cycle time and improve PPA outcomes for customers working at the cutting edge of semiconductor technology, where every percentage point of performance or power matters * Mentor field teams and customers on advanced physical design techniques, raising the bar for how complex designs get implemented across the industry * Help drive adoption of AI\-driven optimization methodologies that change how physical design gets done, not just incrementally but fundamentally * Strengthen customer relationships by being the engineer they call when a design is stuck and they need someone who can actually solve the problem, not just escalate it ### **What You'll Need** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or a related field with 5\+ years of hands\-on ASIC physical design experience, or a master's degree with 3\+ years of experience * Proficiency with industry\-standard implementation tools such as Synopsys ICC2, Fusion Compiler, or Cadence Innovus, you have used these tools on real tapeouts, not just in training * Strong scripting and automation skills using TCL, Python, or Perl to build flows, analyze data, and solve problems that do not have a button in the GUI * Solid understanding of advanced\-node design challenges at 7nm and below, including FinFET effects, multi\-patterning, electromigration, and the tradeoffs that come with each * Experience with logical and physical synthesis flows, and familiarity with AI\-driven optimization methodologies is a strong plus * Excellent communication and presentation skills, you can explain a complex timing closure strategy to a customer engineering team and a high\-level roadblock to their management in the same meeting * Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed, sometimes on short notice, to provide onsite support during critical design phases ### **Who You Are** * You can walk into a customer meeting with incomplete information, ask the right questions, and leave with a clear plan that the team actually believes in * When a design is failing timing by 500ps and the customer is two weeks from tape\-out, you do not panic, you methodically work the problem until you find the path to closure * You write scripts that other engineers can actually read and modify, not just code that works but code that scales across a team * You push back when a methodology recommendation does not fit the customer's reality, even if it means more work to find the right answer * You can explain a complex physical design tradeoff to a VP in two sentences without losing the nuance, and then turn around and debug a TCL flow issue with an engineer * You treat customer problems like your own, not because you have to but because you care about the outcome and you know your work directly affects whether their chip succeeds or fails ### **The Team You'll Be Part Of** Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. ### **Rewards and Benefits** We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability. In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible for an annual bonus, equity, and other discretionary bonuses. Synopsys offers comprehensive health, wellness, and financial benefits as part of a competitive total rewards package. The actual compensation offered will be based on a number of job\-related factors, including location, skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter can share more specific details on the total rewards package upon request. The base salary range for this role is across the U.S.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II, RPM Growth & Ops
jobs.description: **Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?** Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real\-world evidence to deliver real\-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time. **About us** ------------ At Center Health, we help people with diabetes feel better every single day. You might know us for **Aria**, our AI coach. Aria chats with patients about their glucose, meals and medications, and people who use it lower their blood sugar twice as well as they do with a human coach. Behind Aria is something just as exciting: a remote patient monitoring (RPM) program that's growing fast with clinics all over the US. Clinics enroll their patients, and we connect to their glucose monitors. When someone starts drifting out of range, we let their care team know, instead of three months later at the next appointment. Patients get support between visits, clinicians get a clear view of who needs them most, and practices get a program that pays for itself. Every new clinic means hundreds to thousands more people getting better care, and you'll see that impact week by week. We're now part of **Tempus**, one of the biggest precision medicine platforms in healthcare. Tempus brings deep clinical history on millions of patients. We bring the live, day\-to\-day picture. Put together, that's a brand new way to care for chronic disease, and diabetes is only the beginning. We're a small team, and every one of us has been touched by diabetes, either personally or through someone we love. We started Center to build the thing we wished existed. **The role** ------------ You'll be the engineer who keeps our RPM engine humming, and makes it better every week. Every day, a lot of systems have to work together: patient outreach, device connections, data sync, claims documentation and more. When they all run smoothly, patients get care and clinics thrive. You'll own that machine: the integrations, the monitoring, and a fast, friendly response when something needs attention. And because you'll know the system better than anyone, you'll be the first to spot the growth ideas hiding inside it. **What you'll do** * Build and improve the automations behind outreach, data sync and reporting * Bring your own ideas for growing RPM, and ship them * Keep our RPM and EHR integrations healthy, with monitoring that tells us about problems before anyone else notices * Work through our EHR integration pipeline: exports, re\-exports, and the reports clinics rely on * Be the quick, reassuring engineering response when clinics, patients and our support team need help * Lead our EHR integrations as we take on larger clients **How we build** ---------------- We build with AI every day, and we've put real care into doing it well. Our repo ships its own set of Claude Code agents that understand our security setup, our monitoring operations and our quality system. Every change moves through a clear loop: plan it, build it, test it, review it. If a change touches regulated code, the process catches it. The result is a small team that moves quickly, ships safely, and spends its energy on the interesting problems. Our stack is TypeScript from top to bottom: Svelte on the front end, Node services behind it, MongoDB underneath, Capacitor for mobile, and LangChain with Vertex and OpenAI powering the AI. A lot of our operations run on n8n. Don't worry if some of that is new to you. A couple of us had never written Svelte before joining and were shipping within a day. Some of what we build counts as a medical device, and we're a HIPAA business associate, so we take quality and privacy seriously. It adds a little process, and it also means you can be proud of everything that reaches a patient. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * **A solid track record of shipping and running production systems**, usually 5\+ years. We care more about what you've built, and how fast you're growing, than about the number. * **You've started something of your own**, or been an early engineer somewhere. It's the best sign we know that someone will own a problem end to end. * **You love making things reliable.** Good monitoring, clean integrations and a calm, methodical approach when something breaks. * **You're great with people.** You explain technical issues clearly to clinicians and support staff, and you like being the one who gets them unstuck. * **You're AI\-native.** You build with AI tools every day and know how to check their work. * **Solid TypeScript**, or the ability to pick it up fast. * **You've wrangled integrations.** APIs, data pipelines, and messy third\-party systems that don't always behave. **Bonus points:** EHR or health data standards (HL7, FHIR), workflow automation tools like n8n, healthcare billing, or mobile experience. **Life at Center** ------------------ We're headquartered in San Francisco with a remote engineering team spread across London, Liverpool and Cairo, and we're hiring on the US East Coast so you'll share working hours with the clinics and patients we serve. We're flexible, and we trust you to do your best work on a schedule that suits you. Questions are always welcome and always get a real answer. You'll have regular 1:1s with your manager, focused on where you want to grow. And when something goes wrong, we get curious about why, never about who. **Sound like you?** ------------------- Thousands of times a day, someone opens Center to understand what their blood sugar is doing, and every month more clinics join us. If you want your work to show up in real people's health, we'd love to meet you. NYC: $150,000\-$210,000 The expected salary range may vary for other locations. Actual salary may vary based on qualifications and experience. Tempus offers a full range of benefits, which may include incentive compensation, restricted stock units, medical and other benefits depending on the position. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. ### **About Us** Tempus was founded in August of 2015 by Eric Lefkofsky, after his wife was diagnosed with Breast Cancer. Shortly after he founded the company in an effort to bring the power of technology and artificial intelligence to cancer care, he convinced Ryan Fukushima to join as the company’s first employee. Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics. We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. Despite our rapid growth, our mission remains the same—to help make sure patients are on the right drug at the right time, so they can live longer and healthier lives. ### **Why Work Here?** We’re looking for people who can change the world. Who question the status quo and don’t shy away from tough problems. For the builders who are never done building and the learners who are never done learning. We’re looking for passionate people with undying curiosity. Those who want to attack one of the most challenging problems mankind has ever faced. Head on.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Technical Excellence & Escalations
jobs.description: **Who is Tenable?** Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! **What makes Tenable such a great place to work?** Ask a member of our team and they'll answer, "Our people!" We work together to build and innovate best\-in\-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you're part of our \#OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! **Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1\-OPT, F1\-CPT, H\-1B, TN, J\-1, etc** **Your Role:** The Senior Manager, Technical Excellence \& Escalations leads the two teams that sit between Technical Support and the rest of the business: the global Technical Excellence team, staffed by our Technical Leads, and the global Escalations Engineering team. Both produce Tenable's earliest and clearest signal about product supportability and customer risk. Both have historically produced that signal faster than the organization could act on it. This role exists to close that gap. This is not a queue\-management job. The Senior Manager is accountable for two outcomes: turning Technical Lead expertise and escalation findings into tracked change with Product and Engineering, and running one escalations practice that behaves identically in AMER, EMEA, and APJ. The role sits within Operations \& Scale and works in close partnership with the Sr. Director, who sets overall strategy and carries the executive narrative. The Senior Manager owns the operating model, the day\-to\-day practice, and the working\-level relationships with Product and Engineering that make change actually happen. They lead senior individual contributors who are already force multipliers — which makes this a job about influence and orchestration, not direction. Who You Are: * **An orchestrator, not a bottleneck.** You create the conditions for senior experts to influence the organization instead of routing their work through yourself. * **Technically credible.** You have the depth to earn respect from Principal\-level engineers and to challenge an Engineering assessment that doesn't hold up. * **A clear communicator under pressure.** You can hold a room containing both a frustrated customer and an Engineering lead, and translate technical detail into business consequence. * **A systems thinker.** You are drawn to the pattern behind the escalation. You would rather fix the class of problem than win the individual case. * **Comfortable influencing without authority.** Much of what this role must accomplish depends on teams you don't own. * **Effective remotely.** You build trust and hold a team together without relying on being in the room, and you communicate in writing well enough that distance isn't a handicap. * **A developer of senior talent.** You are energized by growing people who are already very good, and you give direct feedback. **Your Opportunity:** Technical Excellence Team * Run the operating model and product coverage plan for the global Technical Excellence team — every strategic product has clear lead ownership, defined authority, and no coverage gaps across theaters. * Set the team's working agenda: what leads work on, what they own, and how their time splits between reactive escalation support and proactive supportability work. * Turn Technical Lead findings — defect patterns, supportability gaps, documentation failures, recurring friction — into one prioritized, evidence\-backed agenda, not a stream of individual product complaints. * Position Technical Leads as credible partners in Product and Engineering forums, with the data, framing, and support they need to influence rather than escalate. * Contribute to the Technical Lead career path with the Education \& Enablement Manager, and apply it consistently — progression from Technical Lead through Senior and Principal, and the competencies that separate each grade. Global Escalations Practice * Own the global escalations practice day to day: process design, entry and exit criteria, severity definitions, roles, communication standards, and adherence. * Drive it to a single global standard. One model, consistently applied and measured across all theaters, with regional variance only where legally or operationally required. * Operate and enforce the working agreement with Product Engineering — SLA a  manual pulls. jobs.description: Why Hershey: At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more. At Hershey, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in the communities where we live, work, and do business. This commitment originated with our founder, Milton Hershey, and continues to shape who we are today. Guided by our employee value proposition, Lead Today. Create Tomorrow, we empower our people to drive impact now while shaping what comes next. Our One Hershey mindset brings teams together across functions, geographies, and businesses, enabling us to operate with speed, collaboration, and shared purpose. The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose. **How will you fit in the big picture?** ---------------------------------------- As a Packaging Sustainability Engineer, you will help bring The Hershey Company’s packaging sustainability priorities to life. You will apply packaging engineering expertise to evaluate and qualify new materials, lead testing and trials, and support scalable solutions that protect product quality, consumer experience, manufacturability, cost, and regulatory compliance. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate across the business and with external partners to advance practical, high\-impact packaging improvements. **What will you do?** --------------------- * Execute sustainable packaging projects focused on recyclability, recycled content, material efficiency, circularity, and greenhouse gas reduction while maintaining product protection, quality, and manufacturing reliability. * Evaluate new packaging materials and technologies through supplier reviews, feasibility assessments, laboratory testing, design of experiments, transport simulations, line trials, technical qualification, specification updates, and post\-launch follow\-up. * Partner with suppliers, converters, material developers, recyclers, and technology providers to identify and advance sustainable material solutions for potential commercialization. * Translate established sustainability priorities, customer and consumer needs, and regulatory requirements into practical technical workplans, test methods, risk assessments, and implementation steps. * Collaborate with Procurement, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, Legal, Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Sustainability, and equipment partners to deliver solutions that are technically sound, cost effective, scalable, and compliant. * Use packaging data, lifecycle thinking, supplier inputs, and sustainability analytics to develop clear technical recommendations and identify material reduction and performance opportunities. * Support packaging regulatory readiness, including Extended Producer Responsibility, recyclability claims, labeling implications, recycled content requirements, and packaging data needs. * Document specifications, testing outcomes, technical decisions, assumptions, risks, and implementation requirements; share learnings and provide technical guidance to project partners and less experienced engineers. * Monitor emerging packaging technologies, material science developments, recycling infrastructure, customer expectations, and regulatory trends and apply relevant insights to assigned projects. **Minimum Education \& Requirements** ------------------------------------- **Experience:** 5\+ years of relevant experience in packaging development, packaging engineering, material science, sustainability, or a related technical field. **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Packaging Engineering preferred; Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related technical field is acceptable. **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced knowledge of packaging materials, converting technologies, equipment interaction, manufacturability, quality requirements, and specification management across flexible, rigid, paper\-based, corrugate, film, resin, polymer, fiber\-based, or emerging material systems. * Experience executing packaging trials, supplier evaluations, technical qualifications, specification updates, commercialization support, and sustainable packaging implementation. * Knowledge of sustainable packaging principles and regulatory\-driven packaging change, including EPR, recyclability claims, recycled content, labeling, packaging data, or carbon reduction. * Strong analytical, project management, communication, and cross\-functional influence skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-moving environment. * Working knowledge of SAP, PLM/PDM, specification systems, packaging data dashboards, Microsoft Office, project management tools, or sustainability reporting inputs. **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- At Hershey, we offer competitive pay and a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and life outside of work. * Health \& Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus wellness programs that support your physical and mental health * Financial Security: Competitive pay, annual incentive opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match * Time Off \& Flexibility: Paid time off, company holidays, and flexible ways of working where applicable * Growth \& Development: Career development programs, learning opportunities, and internal mobility Benefits may vary based on role, location, and eligibility. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $114,480 to $143,100 per year. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of job‑related factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skill set, education, and training. In addition to a market\-competitive base salary, our Total Rewards package includes performance‑based incentives and a comprehensive, competitive benefits package designed to support overall physical, mental, and financial well‑being (as applicable). jobs.title: Information Technology Support Technician III
jobs.description: **Position Specific Description** --------------------------------- **Recruitment Number 26\-215TO**, Information Technology Support Technician III, SR\-17, Honolulu, Oahu. **Summary of Duties** --------------------- Serves as an independent worker responsible for assisting a professional IT Specialist in conducting studies of work processes, procedures and operations of simple complexity to determine user's needs; developing applications for micro computer users utilizing various micro computer software in a localized environment; managing, operating, maintaining and monitoring of information technology resources which includes mini/micro, mainframe, network, and other computer systems, application software, peripheral devices; providing training and assistance to users on basic system procedures and a variety of mini/micro, mainframe, network and other computer software application programs; writing and editing procedure language; and performs other duties as required. **Minimum Qualification Requirements** -------------------------------------- **Education Requirement**: Graduation from high school or GED. **Specialized Experience**: Three (3\) years of experience in an IT operational entity which demonstrated knowledge of mini/micro, mainframe, and/or network computer components and involved the use of: * networking equipment (e.g. modems, line drivers) * various mini and micro computer application programs (e.g., word processing, database, spreadsheets, electronic mail) * peripheral equipment (e.g., laser printers, disk drives, UPS \- uninterruptible power supply) **Substitution of Education for Experience**: 1\. Successful completion of a two\-year degree (e.g., Associate's Degree) from an accredited technical school, college or university in a Computer Science or Information Technology/Electronics/ Networking Technology related field may be substituted for one (1\) year of Specialized Experience. 2\. Successful completion of a certified program (e.g., Microsoft Windows NT; Novell Netware, etc.) and passing a series of proficiency tests administered at an official testing center which resulted in becoming a certified engineer (e.g., Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer, Certified Novell Engineer) may be substituted for two (2\) years of Specialized Experience. 3\. A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology/Electronics/ Networking Technology related field or comparable major from an accredited college or university may be substituted for two (2\) years of Specialized Experience. **Selective Certification Requirement \- Driver's License:** For certain positions, applicants must possess a current and valid driver's license to operate a motor vehicle. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- Any additional information may be attached to your online application, submitted by email to Recruitment@courts.hawaii.gov, or mailed to the following address: Hawai\`i State Judiciary, Human Resources Department, 426 Queen Street, First Floor, Honolulu, Hawai\`i 96813\. *Education*: If you are using education as a substitution for experience, you must submit a copy of your transcript(s) or diploma(s) at the time of application. If you are selected for a position, we will request an official transcript (not a copy) at a later date. The official transcript must indicate completion of the training and/or the awarding of the appropriate degree.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II
jobs.description: **About The Kendall Group** The Kendall Group is comprised of eight divisions with 75\+ locations in ten states. Combined, we serve the Electrical, Automation, Pipe, Valve, and Fitting products, Steam, Lighting, Industrial Controls, and Instrumentation Industries. The Kendall Group is a 100% employee\-owned company. Kendall offers a great opportunity for a rewarding career. **Why The Kendall Group?** Our employee ownership model is the core of who we are. You will not only own part of the company, but you will own your future. At Kendall, you'll have opportunities to learn and grow while being coached and mentored along the way. We're that company where people stay! We're proud to say more than 60% of our associates have more than 5 years of tenure, and more than 40% have greater than 10 years. At Kendall, you will be valued and supported, your ideas will be heard, your voice will matter, and you'll work alongside incredible people who care about your success. Role Summary: Reporting to the Professional Services Manager, the Software Engineer II is a key member of the Kendall Professional Services team. The primary role of the Software Engineer II is to develop, implement and maintain software that is used to deliver positive customer outcomes such as the digital transformation of manufacturing processes. The role will focus on standardizing customizable software solutions to be scalable and readily adaptable for various customer applications. This will also include some minimal engagement with various external customers to ensure the customer’s needs and questions are being addressed. Kendall’s Professional Services team exists to add value to customers by driving positive outcomes through Software as a Service solutions developed and maintained by the Software Engineer II.**Exciting work you will do:** The essential duties and responsibilities of the Software Engineer II position will consist of, but are not limited to, the following: * Develop new standardized but configurable software solutions to drive positive customer outcomes * Implement technical solutions for various customers * Maintain existing solutions and improve in accordance with other priorities * Proactively identify improvements to existing software solutions * Own and prioritize opportunities passed from marketing, outside sales, and national accounts * Manage workflow and competing priorities * Provide timely updates to internal and external contacts * Participate in scoping/quoting portion of customer opportunities * Provide technical support for implemented solutions * Maximize company value by utilizing strategic partner company products * Re\-deploy standard software solutions previously developed by the team * Keep software repositories like GitHub updated with developed software solutions * Implement and adhere to high standards of program documentation and version control * Collaborate with QA engineers to develop and execute comprehensive testing plans, including unit testing, integration testing, and end\-to\-end testing * Keep up to date with the latest industry trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve your skills and contribute innovative ideas * Contribute to the software development lifecycle process, including requirements gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance * Participate in agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, by attending regular meetings, sprint planning, and retrospectives * Document software design, architecture, and processes to ensure knowledge sharing and maintainable codebase * Assist in developing SOPs for software engineering job functions * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members when needed * Perform other duties as assigned **Competencies you possess:** * Service Excellence * Results, Action Oriented * Accountability and Responsibility * Decision Quality * Displaying Technical Expertise * Problem Solving * Teamwork and Collaboration * Priority Setting **What you’ll need:** * **Work Experience:** 5 years’ experience as a Software Engineer or similar role, with a strong portfolio showcasing software development projects * **Required Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or substantial equivalent work experience * **Computer/Analytical Skills:** Experience working with MS Office; ability to learn new software; proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, C\+\+, JavaScript; familiarity with software development tools and version control systems (e.g., Git) * **Organization Skills:** Highly organized and detail\-oriented; ability to multi\-task and shift priorities as needed; ability to work in fast\-paced, continuously evolving, and at times ambiguous environment * **Cross\-functional Skills:** Ability to work well cross\-functionally; provides excellent internal and external customer service; strong problem\-solving skills and ability to analyze and tackle complex technical challenges * **Communication Skills:** Strong interpersonal communication, problem\-solving, organizational, and written/verbal communication skills * **Physical, Mental and Visual Skills:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk, and hear; must be able to stand, walk, and climb stairs; reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions * **Physical Environment:** Normal office environment * **Travel:** Up to 50% * **Driver’s License:** Possess and maintain a valid driver’s license **Qualifications we prefer but don’t require:** * **Work Experience:** Previous experience with Plex, Fiix, FactoryTalk Optix, or other SCADA software; exposure to industrial/manufacturing operations; professional experience working on a team of highly skilled individuals; previous role delivering or interacting with Software as a Service * **Technical Skills:** Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud; understanding of containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes; knowledge of database systems and SQL queries; machine control with computer programming experience The Kendall Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, military status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description: #### **Location:** **MetroHealth Old Brooklyn Campus****Biweekly Hours:** **80\.00****Shift:** **8a\-5p** **The MetroHealth System is redefining health care by going beyond medical treatment to improve the foundations of community health and well\-being: affordable housing, a cleaner environment, economic opportunity and access to fresh food, convenient transportation, legal help and other services. The system strives to become as good at preventing disease as it is at treating it.
