Researches the latest technology as it applies to the MetroHealth infrastructure and technological potential. Monitors all networks and systems for maximum usage and performance. Evaluates vendor proposals and vendor solutions. Insures enterprise\-wide computer and network security. Upholds the mission, vision, values, and customer service standards of The MetroHealth System.** **Qualifications:** Required: Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline. May substitute work experience if deemed of adequate complexity and responsibility. Five years of experience with Microsoft Active Directory 2008/2012 with three or more years of experience in design and/or implementation and support. Three or more years of experience with Windows 2008/2012 Server and Linux servers in a highly complex, multi\-site, client server environment. Three or more years of experience with Microsoft System Center tools in a highly complex, multisite, client server environment. Server Virtualization experience with three or more ears in VMWare/HypeV design and/or implementation (minimally utilizing EMC and Brocade Switches) and implementation with Microsoft and/or Linux servers. Experience with and ability to program in one or more of the following: C\#, HTML, PowerShell (other languages may substitute per Director/Manager). Ability to lead technical projects involving staff from multiple disciplines. Preferred: Experience with EPIC, Citrix, Xen App Server, Netscaler, SNMP network monitoring, thin clients, databases such as Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, TCP/IP and other network protocols. MCSE, MCSA Certifications. Physical Demands: May need to move around intermittently during the day, including sitting, standing, stooping, bending, and ambulating. May need to remain still for extended periods, including sitting and standing. Ability to communicate in face\-to\-face, phone, email, and other communications. Ability to read job related documents. Ability to use computer.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering, Reuters
jobs.description: **Job Description** The **Director, Software Engineering** will lead Reuters' content management systems engineering organization, with direct responsibility for the platform underpinning content creation, editorial workflows, and publishing on Reuters.com. Reporting to the VP, Software Engineering, this leader will direct the technical strategy, architecture, and delivery of Reuters' CMS platform through a major transition, building and leading the engineering, editorial\-tooling, and delivery teams responsible for its day\-to\-day operation and long\-term evolution. This is a hands\-on leadership role: the Director is expected to act as a principal engineer when needed, providing direct technical guidance on both front\-end and back\-end challenges, not just organizational oversight. This leadership position will shape the technical roadmap for Reuters' CMS platform, translating editorial and business requirements into a scalable, reliable architecture. The ideal candidate will build and lead a high\-performing engineering organization spanning platform engineering, editorial tooling, and delivery operations, while establishing the standards, processes, and talent needed to support Reuters' journalism at scale. Success requires deep technical expertise in modern web and cloud architecture, proven people leadership across multiple teams, and a clear point of view on where AI can responsibly accelerate how the organization builds and ships software. Relocation Support \& Travel: Available upon discussion; minimal travel expected. **Key Responsibilities** * Own the technical architecture and long\-term roadmap for Reuters' content management platform, directing design decisions around scalability, performance, and cost across backend services and AWS infrastructure. * Establish and maintain uptime and reliability standards for a production platform serving external customers at scale, while evaluating and guiding the platform's modern web rendering strategy. * Partner with editorial stakeholders to translate newsroom workflows into platform requirements, directing the roadmap for editorial tooling and identifying opportunities for AI\-assisted content workflows that support without compromising journalistic standards. * Lead the teams responsible for platform delivery, including release management and production support, while owning the technical execution of the platform transition and establishing metrics to track platform health and operational risk. * Build, mentor, and lead a multi\-team engineering organization, including managers and individual contributors, while fostering a high\-performing culture grounded in ownership and continuous improvement across distributed teams. Communicate technical strategy and tradeoffs credibly to engineers, product partners, executives, and customers while championing AI upskilling and adoption programs across the engineering organization. * **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience * 10\+ years in software engineering with 4\+ years managing engineers, including experience managing managers or leading multiple teams * Demonstrated ownership of a production platform serving external customers at scale with experience in Agile methodologies and DevOps practices * Deep knowledge of AWS, serverless architecture, and distributed systems; strong grasp of modern web rendering (server\-side and client\-side rendering, React, build tooling); and working knowledge of HTTP, caching semantics, and CDN behavior in high\-traffic environments * Experience with microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), test automation frameworks, and browser/system performance testing methodologies Ability to communicate technical concepts credibly to engineers, product partners, executives, and customers, with demonstrated ability to build and lead high\-performing technical teams across multiple functions * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in SaaS or platform businesses where developers are among customers * Background in publishing, media technology, or content management systems, or experience leading an organization through platform consolidation or modernization * Familiarity with enterprise\-scale CDN providers (particularly Akamai or CloudFront) and cloud cost optimization at scale * Experience integrating teams with divergent engineering cultures under shared standards, or exposure to AI/ML technologies with a track record of adopting AI into engineering workflows responsibly Resilience and adaptability in the face of ambiguity, with passion for technology and its potential to drive business value; strong advocacy for diversity, inclusion, and cultural sensitivity across distributed organizations * \#LI\-CH1 **What’s in it For You?** * **Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and profe atch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD\&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption \& Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $158,900 USD \- $295,100 USD.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs.\&\#xa;This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.\&\#xa; This job posting will close 10/23/2026\. **About Us** Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward. As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug\-free workplace. We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here. Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here. More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com

$2,500 sign\-on bonus upon being in the role for 90 days.** **Hours of Work – Eagan, Minnesota** 2nd Shift – 2:30p \- 10:30p * **Key Responsibilities** In this opportunity as an **Electrician** , your jobs.description: ### **About The Role** Together AI is the AI native cloud, which has been built bottoms up to cater to the demand for the new generation of AI applications and agents. The company has seen tremendous growth with 10X growth year on year and has over a million developers. As we continue to drive product innovation, we are also investing deeply in our GTM. This role will lead partner marketing at Together AI. They will define our partner marketing strategy and own the execution, in collaboration with the GTM leadership. This role will report into the head of product and solution marketing and will have the opportunity to own and independently build the partner marketing function at one of the most innovative companies at the forefront of AI. ### **Responsibilities** * Create and execute partner marketing strategy, specially for NVIDIA and cloud partners – in collaboration with GTM leadership * Own core messaging for partners, working closely with product marketing to build those * Be the marketing POC (point of contact) for partners and run regular rhythms of business to drive co\-marketing efforts * Collaborate with demand gen and field marketing to run partner marketing campaigns * Outline and track metrics to measure our success in the partner space * Experiment and try new ideas that can help us scale further the ROI for both partners and Together aI ### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of partner marketing experience, preferably working with cloud hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, GCP) and/or NVIDIA * Proven track record in creating and implementing high impact partner campaigns for B2B businesses, preferably in AI or Software Platform (PaaS) * Strong ownership mindset and ability to build something from ground up * Experience with scaling organizations through partner GTM * Strong analytical skills with a data\-driven approach to decision\-making and reporting * Bachelors degree required, preferred if in engineering ### **About Together AI** Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. jobs.title: Product Manager (AI Agents)
jobs.description: **About Traba** =============== Traba is building the AI operating layer for the industrial supply chain. We started in the workforce space because contingent labor is the biggest operational pain point our manufacturing and logistics customers face. We used it to embed ourselves inside their daily operations and create a far better customer experience through technology. Now those same customers are pulling us beyond staffing into the broader operational workflows that run their facilities. That foundation gave us proprietary data from millions of shifts and deep enterprise relationships. But our edge is more than data. By connecting to the systems running across every facility and activating the workers already on our platform to execute against them, we are building applied AI that drives real productivity gains and transforms how the global supply chain operates at scale. We are backed by Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and General Catalyst. **The Role** ------------ We are looking for an entrepreneurial and experienced Product Manager to join as a founding member of the Agents team and help us build the next layer of Traba's product, an agentic platform that synthesizes the data flowing through our marketplace and operates autonomously inside our customers' supply chain workflows. Think Claude, but for Light Industrial businesses. You'll embed deeply in our customers' operations, design and ship production agents that understand context, reason through ambiguity, make decisions, and execute work on behalf of users. This is a true 0\-to\-1 product role operating at the frontier of applied AI. You will work directly with founders, product engineers, ML teams, and early design partners to define workflows, shape product strategy, and build products while the underlying model ecosystem continues changing beneath us. The assumptions, capabilities, and constraints will evolve rapidly and the product will evolve with them. This role reports directly to our VP of Product. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Architect and steward product strategy for Traba’s AI agent platform * Solve complex customer problems by balancing user needs, technical constraints, and evolving AI capabilities * Write detailed product requirements and partner deeply with product engineers and ML teams * Rapidly validate and prototype ideas alongside customers and design partners * Design agent systems that reason through workflows, orchestrate tools, maintain context, and execute meaningful work * Define product behavior, evaluation systems, and quality frameworks that improve reliability and performance * Use data to uncover patterns and answer key product and system questions * Evolve our AI product portfolio with a deep understanding of model capabilities and system architecture * Visualize and communicate complex concepts from system behavior and evaluations to user experiences and business impact * Socialize your work across all levels and departments while synthesizing diverse stakeholder feedback **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- **Real agent builder.** You have launched customer\-facing AI products where the system took meaningful actions on behalf of users. We are intentionally setting a high bar here. Shipping AI features, copilots, chat interfaces, wrappers, or lightweight LLM integrations alone is not enough. You understand agents that execute workflows, orchestrate systems, use tools, maintain context, and perform work autonomously. **0\-to\-1 operator.** You have built products from scratch with real customers and understand the realities of finding product market fit. You have launched, rebuilt, changed direction, killed ideas, and iterated toward signals. You are comfortable creating structures where no playbook exists. **AI\-native problem solver.** You move quickly in environments where models evolve constantly and assumptions regularly break. You understand that building AI products often means navigating prompt rewrites, model shifts, reliability tradeoffs, and capability cliffs. **First\-principles thinker.** You spend equal time thinking about why, how, and what. You understand that strong product judgment often comes from deeply understanding systems and constraints rather than applying generic playbooks. **Customer\-embedded builder.** You believe the best products are built shoulder\-to\-shoulder with customers. You have experience deeply embedding with early customers, understanding workflows firsthand, and rapidly shipping based on direct feedback loops. Experience with forward deployed environments or customer\-embedded product development models is highly valued. **Technical depth.** You are comfortable operating alongside ML engineers and highly technical teams as peers. You can understand evaluations, reason through system tradeoffs, prototype ideas, and participate deeply in technical conversations. You do not need to be an ex\-engineer, but you should have strong technical instincts and enjoy getting into the details. **Builder mentality.** Inventive and scrappy problem solver. You move quickly, embrace ambiguity, and know how to create meaningful outcomes without relying on giant teams or excessive process. **Deeply collaborative.** You work seamlessly across engineering, ML, operations, design, leadership, and customers to bring new products to life. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * 3 – 5 years of experience as a Product Manager * Evidence of launching products from scratch and driving meaningful customer outcomes * Experience building AI\-native products or customer\-facing agent systems * Strong technical abilities with the ability to work deeply with engineering and ML teams * Ability to read evaluations, reason through system performance, and prototype ideas * Experience operating in highly ambiguous startup environments with fast iteration cycles * Deep familiarity with AI tools and hands\-on experience building with modern AI systems * Desire to work at a startup and cover an exceptionally wide surface area * A strong work ethic and desire to build a category\-defining company **Benefits** ------------ * Start\-up equity * Competitive Salary * 100% Paid health, dental \& vision coverage * Dinner Provided via Grubhub \& stocked kitchen for NY employees * Commuter benefit * Team building events * Gympass Benefit * Flexible PTO * ✚✚ Additional: One Medical Membership, Gympass, HSA via Optum, Talkspace, Health Advocate, Teledoc Health **Salary Range Details** ------------------------ The compensation range for this position is set between $150,000 and $190,000, reflecting our market analysis and other relevant considerations. However, exceptions may be made for candidates with qualifications that significantly differ from those outlined in the job description.We also offer a highly competitive equity package designed to ensure you share meaningfully in the long\-term success and upside of the business. The position is based onsite in New York City or San Francisco, five days per week, giving you the opportunity to collaborate closely with a high\-performing team in a fast\-paced, energetic environment. Being in person supports real\-time decision\-making, stronger teamwork, and the kind of creative problem\-solving that drives meaningful impact. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Traba is dedicated to promoting Equal Opportunity employment practices. We evaluate all applicants without discrimination based on race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristics that are legally protected by local, state, or federal regulations. We encourage applicants from a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. **Our Values** -------------- **Dream Big \-** We are on a path to change the world for the better. We create and communicate a bold direction that inspires a life\-changing vision. We don’t sacrifice long\-term value for short\-term results. **Olympian’s Work Ethic \-** Changing the world never comes easy. We work harder, longer, and smarter, not just two out of three. We put everything we have on the field. **Growth Mindset \-** We confront the toughest challenges head\-on and persevere. Sometimes we fail, but we brush ourselves off, adapt, learn, and push forward with resilience. **Customer Obsession \-** We go the extra mile for our workers and businesses. We remain focused on delivering high\-quality products and services that solve this massive and overlooked industries’ problems Privacy Notice for CA Applicants Compensation Range: $150K \- $190K

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Clinical Analytics
jobs.description: **Principal Software Engineer \- Clinical Analytics** Truveta is the world's first health provider led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a special combination of health, software and big data experience who share our company values. **This position is based out of our headquarters in the Greater Seattle area.****\#LI\-hybrid** **Who We Need** Truveta is building a diverse and inclusive team to tackle complex health and technical challenges. We are seeking enthusiastic new graduates who are problem\-solvers, collaborative teammates, and eager to make a difference in healthcare. If you're excited about purposeful work, joining a mission\-driven team, and launching your career in a supportive environment, Truveta could be the perfect place to start. **This Opportunity** At Truveta, you'll help define how health systems use data to improve the quality of care. You'll work at the intersection of cloud services, analytical data platforms, and user experiences, setting the technical direction for technology that lets clinical and quality teams define, monitor, and act on the metrics that matter most. Health systems deserve modern, intuitive tools for measuring care quality, yet getting answers from large\-scale clinical data still often takes specialized skills and long turnaround times. At Truveta, we are building a next\-generation analytics platform that lets health systems securely explore their data, track performance over time, and drive measurable improvements in patient outcomes. We are seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the architecture and technical strategy of Truveta's clinical analytics platform. You will be both a hands\-on builder and a force multiplier: designing the systems that power low\-latency analytics and self\-serve dashboarding, writing critical code, raising the engineering bar, and mentoring engineers across the organization. You will partner with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering leadership to translate the needs of health systems into a durable platform vision, then guide teams in delivering it. This role offers the opportunity to shape a foundational product area, tackle ambiguous and technically demanding problems, and make a meaningful impact on our mission of saving lives with data. **Work Areas:** * Define the end\-to\-end architecture for clinical analytics: analytical data serving, metric definition and computation, and self\-serve dashboarding and visualization for health systems. * Make foundational design decisions on OLAP and analytical storage, data modeling, query performance, caching, and scalability for population\-level health data. * Design secure multi\-tenant systems with strong data isolation, fine\-grained access control, and auditability appropriate for sensitive health data. * Determine how health systems define, customize, and share their own metrics and dashboards, balancing flexibility with governance, performance, and cost. * Build and prototype critical components, set technical standards, and lead design and code reviews across teams. * Mentor and grow engineers, and partner with other engineering leaders to align roadmaps and reduce technical risk across the broader Truveta data platform. * Establish engineering practices for reliability, observability, and operational excellence in production analytics services. **Key Qualifications** * BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 12\+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large\-scale software systems, with a track record of technical leadership on complex, multi\-team initiatives. * Deep experience with data, OLAP, or analytics technologies, including analytical databases, BI and dashboarding platforms, and data modeling for high\-performance reporting workloads. * Strong backend engineering expertise in .NET (C\#), Python, or a similar language, including REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, and cloud\-native architectures on platforms such as Azure. * Demonstrated ability to make and communicate sound architectural tradeoffs, and to drive alignment among engineering, product, and executive stakeholders. * Proven experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical capability of a team. * Strong communication skills, including the ability to write clear technical design documents and explain complex systems to diverse audiences. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building embedded analytics, self\-serve BI, or data\-driven products for technical or business users. * Experience with multi\-tenant architectures, including row\-level security and tenant isolation, in regulated or sensitive\-data environments. * Familiarity with healthcare data, clinical quality measures, or health informatics. * Experience with containerized deployments, infrastructure as code, and operating high\-availability production services. * Experience applying AI or natural\-language interfaces to analytics and data exploration. **Why Truveta?** Be a part of building something special. Now is the perfect time to join Truveta. We have strong, established leadership with decades of success. We are well\-funded. We are building a culture that prioritizes people and their passions across personal, professional and everything in between. Join us as we build an amazing company together. **We Offer:** * Interesting and meaningful work for every career stage * Great benefits package * Comprehensive benefits with strong medical, dental and vision insurance plans * 401K plan * Professional development \& training opportunities for continuous learning * Work/life autonomy via flexible work hours and flexible paid time off * Generous parental leave * Regular team activities (virtual and in\-person) * The base pay for this position is $222,000 to $240,000\. The pay range reflects the minimum and maximum target. Pay is based on several factors including location and may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles are eligible for additional compensation such as incentive pay and stock options. *If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents* *linked* *here.* Truveta is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and empowering workplace. We believe that having employees, interns, and contractors with diverse backgrounds enables Truveta to better meet our mission and serve patients and health communities around the world. We recognize that opportunities in technology historically excluded and continue to disproportionately exclude Black and Indigenous people, people of color, people from working class backgrounds, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA\+ people. We strongly encourage individuals with these identities to apply even if you don't meet all of the requirements. **Please note that all applicants must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer as we are unable to sponsor work visas or permits (e.g., F****‑****1 OPT, H****‑****1B) at this time. We appreciate your interest in the position and encourage you to explore future opportunities with us.**

jobs.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer (Agentic AI)
jobs.description: Job description Company and benefits Job ID SRSTA019353 Employment Type Regular Work Style hybrid Location Seattle,WA,United States Role Sr. Staff Software Engineer (Agentic AI) **Why UKG:** At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do. We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you. \*\*\*UKG is unable to offer sponsorship for this position.\*\*\* **Sr. Staff Software Engineer \- Agentic Acceleration Group** We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Staff Software Engineer to define and drive our enterprise\-wide agentic AI strategy on Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) and other agentic platforms. You will shape the future of intelligent automation across UKG's product portfolio, influence technical direction across multiple engineering organizations, and establish UKG as a thought leader in enterprise agentic AI. As a Sr. Staff Engineer, you will set technical vision, architect organization\-wide systems, drive transformational change, and elevate engineering excellence company\-wide. **Responsibilities**: * Strategic Technical Leadership: Define enterprise\-wide technical strategy for agentic AI across UKG. Set long\-term vision for how agents transform UKG's HCM platform. Influence product roadmaps and business strategy through technical insight. Drive division\-level or company\-level objectives. * Enterprise Architecture: Architect organization\-wide agentic AI capabilities on Google ADK and other platforms. Design foundational frameworks, orchestration patterns, and platform capabilities that serve multiple product teams. Set architectural standards and best practices for agent development across the organization. * Cross\-Organizational Influence: Drive technical decisions across multiple teams and divisions. Set standards for agent development, tool design, safety frameworks, and operational excellence. Shape engineering culture and technical direction at scale. * Advanced Agent Systems: Pioneer sophisticated multi\-agent architectures including hierarchical systems, swarm intelligence, adversarial networks, and hybrid human\-agent workflows. Push boundaries of what's possible with agent orchestration. Demonstrate engineering excellence through industry\-leading implementations. * Innovation \& Research: Stay at the forefront of agentic AI research. Evaluate emerging platforms and techniques. Prototype breakthrough capabilities. Drive adoption of transformative technologies. Contribute to industry knowledge through publications, open source, or conference presentations. * Agent Safety \& Governance: Establish organization\-wide frameworks for agent safety, governance, and responsible AI. Design policy engines and guardrail architectures that scale across all systems. Influence company\-wide AI safety policy and regulatory compliance standards. * Platform Integration: Design integrations between agents and UKG's entire enterprise ecosystem. Build strategic tools, APIs, and MCP servers that unlock capabilities across products. Define integration patterns that scale across teams and product lines. * Service Excellence: Define service health, quality, and operational standards for all agentic systems. Establish monitoring, observability, and incident response frameworks. Set the bar for production excellence, reliability, and cost efficiency. * Mentorship \& Talent Development: Mentor senior engineers, lead engineers, and engineering managers. Raise the technical bar through code reviews, design reviews, and architectural guidance. Build the next generation of technical leaders. Recognized as go\-to expert and trusted advisor. * Thought Leadership: Represent UKG externally as a technical expert. Publish articles, present at conferences, contribute to open source, and engage with the AI engineering community. Establish UKG's technical reputation and attract top talent. * Strategic Partnerships: Engage with technology partners (Google, Anthropic) to influence platform roadmaps. Represent UKG in technical advisory relationships. Leverage partnerships to drive internal innovation. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). * 10\+ years of professional software development experience, with 3\+ years building agentic AI systems or LLM\-powered applications in production at scale. * Deep expertise in Python, Java, C\#, JavaScript, or TypeScript, with track record of setting coding standards and best practices. * Proven experience architecting and building production agents using Google ADK, Anthropic Claude SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, or similar platforms. * Expert\-level understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering, and advanced agent design patterns (ReAct, Chain\-of\-Thought, constitutional AI, multi\-agent collaboration). * Track record of influencing technical direction across multiple teams or organizations. Demonstrated ability to set architectural standards and drive adoption. * Proven ability to lead highly complex, cross\-functional initiatives with significant business impact. * Deep expertise with GCP (Vertex AI, Google ADK), Azure (Azure OpenAI), or AWS (Bedrock), and modern DevOps practices. * Exceptional problem\-solving skills, systems thinking, and ability to navigate complex technical and organizational challenges. * Outstanding leadership, communication, and influence skills. Ability to drive technical decisions across senior stakeholders and executive audiences. * Demonstrated track record of mentoring senior engineers and raising the technical bar across organizations. **Company Overview:** UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. With the world's largest collection of workforce insights, and people\-first AI, our ability to reveal unseen ways to build trust, amplify productivity, and empower talent, is unmatched. It's this expertise that equips our customers with the intelligence to solve any challenge in any industry — because great organizations know their workforce is their competitive edge. Learn more at ukg.com. Equal Opportunity Employer UKG is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, disability, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, and other legally protected categories. View The EEO Know Your Rights poster UKG participates in E\-Verify. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Disability Accommodation in the Application and Interview Process For individuals with disabilities that need additional assistance at any point in the application and interview process, please email UKGCareers@ukg.com. The pay range for this position is $145,600 to $240,695\. The actual base pay offered may vary depending on skills, experience, job\-related knowledge and work location. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible to participate in a performance\-based bonus plan and to receive restricted stock unit awards as part of total compensation. Learn more about UKG’s benefits and rewards at https://www.ukg.com/about\-us/careers/benefits NOTICE ON HIRING SCAMS UKG will never ask you for a copy of your driver’s license, social security card, or passport during a job inter ABOUT OUR JOB DESCRIPTIONS All job descriptions are written to accurately reflect the open job and include general work responsibilities. They do not present a comprehensive, detailed inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required for the job. Management reserves the right to revise the job or require that other or different tasks be performed if or when circumstances change.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer (C# / .NET / Angular)
jobs.description: The **Enterprise Solutions and Services Development** team develops and supports full\-stack applications for the entire organization. We work closely with our business partners in developing new applications, enhancing existing ones, and building enterprise solutions for our different business needs. At UMB, we have over a century of experience, and we constantly push the boundaries using the latest technologies and processes to bring the best products to our customers and partners. As a **Full\-Stack Developer**, you will be part of a team developing and supporting scalable full stack applications. As a senior developer, you will be part of application design and review team tasks and functions. You will also work closely with UMB stakeholders and technical teams to ensure the best solution is implemented. This is a subset of the overall responsibilities which will include multiple initiatives as assigned by IT leadership. **This role is hybrid (Mon through Thu on\-site / Fri remote) at the UMB Technology \& Operations Center located in downtown Kansas City, MO.** ***How you’ll spend your time:*** * Collaborate with the business and technical teams, develop solutions that fulfill the business requirements incorporating UMB and industry strategies, patterns, standards and technologies, and then review solutions with stakeholders for alignment. * Develop new applications including enhancing existing applications to meet business needs. * Develop and review both front\-end and back\-end code in C\# and Angular JS. * Create and Maintain Technical documents. * Mentor junior IT and Business teams on new technologies and patterns. * Stay current with modern technology, patterns and trends. ***We’re excited to talk if you have:*** * Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or related discipline and at least 5 years of enterprise solutions and API development experience **OR** equivalent combination of education and work experience. * Strong experience with C\# / .NET back\-end development, including MVC architecture, REST API development, and Entity Framework. * Experience in the following: + Web development using Angular JS framework + SQL Server + Development or support of applications in AWS + Microservice architecture implementation + Implementation of APIs security patterns using JWT tokens and/or oAuth2\. + Exposure to CI/CI pipelines ***Bonus Points if you have:*** * Financial services or banking industry experience. **Applicants must have legal authority to work in the United States. Work Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.** This position was posted on 10/05/2026\. The application deadline for this position is 45 days from the posting date unless filled earlier. **Compensation Range:** $98,208 \- $144,705 *The posted compensation range on this listing represents UMB’s good faith and reasonable estimate based on its budget and what it expects to be the starting pay for this role, but the actual compensation may vary by geographic location, experience level, and other job\-related factors. Please see the description of benefits included with this job posting for additional information.* UMB offers competitive and varied benefits to eligible associates, such as Paid Time Off; a 401(k) matching program; annual incentive pay; paid holidays; a comprehensive company sponsored benefit plan including medical, dental, vision, and other insurance coverage; health savings, flexible spending, and dependent care accounts; adoption assistance; an employee assistance program; fitness reimbursement; tuition reimbursement; an associate wellbeing program; an associate emergency fund; and various associate banking benefits. Benefit offerings and eligibility requirements vary. **Are you ready to be part of something more?** You're more than a means to an end—a way to help us meet the bottom line. jobs.title: AI Technology Director
jobs.description: Umain, part of Eidra, is a digital product consultancy with nearly 200 engineers, designers, and product strategists. We partner with companies including McDonald’s, Polestar, Heineken, Rijksmuseum, Spotify, and Philips Hue to shape, build, and scale the products and platforms their businesses and customers rely on. We work in small, senior teams, staying with a product from its first idea through launch and beyond. Umain is growing its AI engineering team in the US. Our AI engineers around the world design, prototype and build AI\-powered tools and software that change how clients work, from advanced GenAI workflows and custom agents to production\-ready AI applications. You'll join a global team of more than 30 AI engineers across Sweden, the Netherlands, Norway and North America, working alongside strategy consultants, marketers, data experts and designers. This full time role is based in Chicago at our West Loop office. As part of Umain's expanding U.S. footprint, you'll help establish our reputation for engineering excellence, strategy, and delivery in the American market. You must be in Chicago or willing to relocate to be considered for this role as we require a minimum of 3 days in\-office per week. ### **Your role as AI Tech Director** You'll be our most senior technical voice in AI in North America, leading our clients’ most ambitious projects—where the technology is new and the answers aren’t obvious. You'll work as a peer to our clients' CTOs, helping them understand where AI is heading over the next few years (well beyond today's GenAI tools) and what that means for their business now. You'll set the technical direction for our teams and work closely with colleagues in strategy, design, and marketing to get things built. You ensure our promises are technically sound and our work delivers on them. As the technical counterpart on the commercial side, you help shape and present pitches, develop proposals, and define scope and budgets. This isn’t a deal\-hunting role—we don’t expect you to proactively pursue new business. ### **What you'll do** * Lead technology and AI conversations with senior client stakeholders as a credible counterpart to their CTO. * Keep track of where AI is heading, across GenAI, agents, machine learning, computer vision, on\-device and physical AI, and turn that into clear advice for clients and for our own direction. * Set the technical vision and architecture standards across our AI work, weighing what's possible against what's practical and safe. * Guide and mentor our AI engineers, help with architectural choices, raise the quality bar, and step in on the hardest problems. * Stay hands\-on enough to know what's real, prototyping new capabilities when it's the fastest way to find out. * Assess feasibility and risk on AI work, including data security, privacy, licensing, regulation, and responsible use. * Oversee delivery from idea to production: keeping teams focused, clearing bottlenecks, and spotting problems before they show up. * Support commercial work as the technical counterpart: joining pitches, shaping proposals, and defining scope and budgets to win work we can deliver. * Help build our AI engineering team in North America and work closely with our teams in Europe. * Be a visible voice for Umain's AI work in the U.S., with clients and in the wider industry. ### **What you bring** * 10\+ years of engineering experience, with at least 3 working hands\-on with AI. * Several years in consulting or agency environments, working directly with clients on complex, multi\-team engagements. * Real commercial expertise. You're comfortable shaping and pricing proposals and scoping work as the technical authority, without needing to hunt for deals yourself. * A clear perspective on where AI is headed and a track record of turning emerging opportunities into action. * Experience building and shipping things yourself, not only advising on them. Maybe you founded something, launched a product, or built a new offering from scratch. * A track record of architecting and overseeing delivery of complex AI solutions that hold up in production. * Hands\-on experience with modern GenAI: LLMs, embeddings and vector databases, retrieval, agents, fine\-tuning and evaluation, and working with the major model providers. * Range beyond GenAI, such as classic machine learning, computer vision, multimodal models, forecasting or recommendation systems, and a sense of when each is the right tool. * Strong engineering skills in Python and/or TypeScript, including backend systems and data pipelines. * Experience deploying and running applications on AWS, Azure or GCP, with solid DevOps habits (containers, CI/CD, monitoring). * The presence to lead conversations with senior executives and the ability to explain complex concepts clearly. * A knack for turning vague questions into concrete plans for clients. * Sound judgment about when to use AI—and when not to—and the openness to rethink your approach as evidence evolves. * Curiosity about new capabilities, and a habit of trying things yourself before forming a view. ### **Nice\-to\-Have** * Experience with large consumer brands, especially in retail, food service, or automotive. * Experience with edge or on\-device AI, robotics, or AI in physical environments. * Experience helping build a team or practice in a new market. ### **When you apply** **Along with your CV, use the cover letter portion of your application to tell us about a call you made early on a technology or direction. What did you see, what did you do about it, and how did it play out? Wrong calls count too, as long as you can tell us what you learned.** ### **What we offer** At Eidra, we offer a competitive salary package complemented by comprehensive benefits that prioritize employee well\-being, reflecting our Nordic heritage. We provide a range of healthcare benefits, including fully subsidized insurance premiums for employees and their families. Our vacation policy promotes work\-life balance with flexible time off, requiring a minimum of 3 weeks off per year. We encourage employees to take vacations in 2\-week increments to truly detach and recharge. Our culture emphasizes inclusive decision\-making, collaboration, and continuous learning, fostering an environment of transparency and trust. Compensation: $200,000\.00\-$225,000\.00 USD annually based on experience Eidra North America is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Associate General Counsel, Ads & AI
jobs.description: **The opportunity** =================== Unity is shipping AI products into the hands of millions of creators, and the data infrastructure behind Unity’s Grow business is being rebuilt at the same time. This role is the lawyer at the center of both. You will be the legal owner for Unity’s AI product portfolio — in\-editor and desktop AI agents, generative tooling, our agent plugin ecosystem, and the ML systems powering ad monetization — and for the identity and data\-rights frameworks those products depend on. The questions are genuinely unsettled. Who owns the output of a generative tool a developer directs? What can a platform train on when 90% of games embed third\-party marketplace assets? When does a telemetry default cross from convenience into a consent problem? You will not be applying a playbook. You will be writing it, and your written positions will govern how products get built. Short\-term success (first two quarters): the uncovered matters have a clear owner and a documented position; product teams route AI and data questions to you by default rather than escalating; the highest\-risk open items have decisions attached to them. Longer\-term success: Unity’s AI and data\-use positions are coherent across the portfolio rather than negotiated product by product; the frameworks scale without you personally reviewing every request; you are a trusted voice with product and engineering leadership on what Unity should and should not do. Impact. This is a small legal team where each lawyer owns their swimlanes outright. There is no layer between you and the product decisions. What you write becomes the company’s position. **What you'll be doing** * Serve as primary legal counsel for Unity’s AI product portfolio — desktop and in\-editor AI agents, generative tooling, the agent plugin ecosystem, and AI\-driven marketing and monetization products — from concept through launch and iteration. * Own the data\-rights and identity frameworks underpinning Unity’s Grow business, including developer data\-use architecture, training\-data eligibility, device identifiers and cross\-product data flows. * Counsel product, engineering and data\-science teams in the room where features are designed, converting privacy, IP and regulatory constraints into requirements engineers can build to. * Draft and negotiate the agreements that make the roadmap possible — model and technology provider licenses, partnership and referral agreements, research collaborations and data\-sharing arrangements. * Set and defend Unity’s positions on emerging AI and data questions in writing, and build the templates, playbooks and guidance that let those positions scale across teams **What we're looking for** * Licensed to practice law, with in\-house or law\-firm experience counseling technology product teams directly. * Demonstrated ownership of legal counseling for AI or machine\-learning products, covering training\-data rights, model licensing, output ownership and user\-facing disclosures. * Working command of global privacy law — GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, COPPA — applied to SDKs, telemetry and advertising data flows, not just policy documentation. * Ability to draft and negotiate commercial technology agreements independently, from first redline to signature. * A track record of issuing clear written legal positions on unprecedented questions and defending them with senior stakeholders. **You might also have (optional)** * Experience in games, interactive entertainment, or a developer\-platform business. * Mobile advertising or ad tech background — mediation, attribution, programmatic, or measurement. * Hands\-on EU AI Act or comparable emerging\-AI\-regulation assessment work. * Open\-source licensing depth, especially license compatibility for datasets and embedded assets. * Experience building legal self\-service infrastructure for fast\-moving product organizations. * Comfort using AI tools in your own practice. **Additional information** jobs.title: Senior Principal Scientist
jobs.description: **Job Description** **The Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) has an outstanding opportunity for a Senior Principal Scientist to join the Environmental and Information Systems Department. This is a full\-time Massachusetts\-based position.** **About this Opportunity** Reporting to the Senior Principal Oceanographer, the Senior Principal Scientist will support research that is focused on advancing the fundamental understanding and practical application of underwater acoustic signal transmission, propagation, detection, and exploitation in the ocean environment. These efforts investigate the complex interactions between acoustic wavefields and the dynamic ocean, including the effects of temperature structure, salinity, pressure, internal waves, mesoscale variability, seabed composition, bathymetry, and ambient noise on acoustic performance. The major emphasis of these research activities is the development, evaluation, and application of advanced array\-based sensing and signal processing techniques. The projects of interest encompass the design, modeling, calibration, and operational assessment of fixed, towed, bottom\-mounted, distributed, and autonomous acoustic arrays used for passive and active sensing. Technical areas include beamforming, adaptive spatial filtering, matched\-field processing, source localization, direction\-of\-arrival estimation, synthetic aperture techniques, coherent and incoherent processing, array performance optimization, and distributed sensor network architectures. Particular attention is given to improving target detection, classification, tracking, and localization in acoustically challenging shallow\-water and deep\-ocean environments while mitigating the effects of reverberation, multipath propagation, clutter, and environmental uncertainty. These projects require developing new analytical methods and numerical models, designing and executing laboratory and field experiments, integrating observational data with theoretical and computational approaches, and evaluating the operational effectiveness of emerging acoustic sensing technologies. Projects frequently involve the integration of acoustic observations with oceanographic measurements, autonomous platforms, and environmental prediction systems to improve the accuracy and reliability of sonar performance assessments under realistic operational conditions. **Key Responsibilities:** The incumbent will be independently responsible for study design and planning, execution of research activities and analysis, fundraising, and dissemination of results and data to the scientific community. Projects use mathematical models, computer simulations, and direct observations to understand how turbulent ocean processes across all scales contribute to the dynamics of the ocean and climate. Research Planning (15% FTE): * Conceives and develops technical strategy and plans research to answer complex scientific questions, including the development of new technologies. * Develops collaborative and synergistic research relationships and coordinates research plans with peer scientists within APL, elsewhere at the UW, and at other institutions in the US and abroad. * Assesses the feasibility of proposed methods and tests. Research Activities (40% FTE): * Oversees research preparation and execution, including equipment procurement, fieldwork coordination, and on\-site participation as chief scientist or as part of a collaborative science team. * Monitors quality and content in field data and makes real\-time decisions on the adaptation of research activities in response to changing conditions and findings. * Conducts and/or manages data screening, calibration, analysis, and synthesis in the context of past results and scientific literature on theoretical, numerical, and experimental investigations to arrive at scientific conclusions. * Shares results with the scientific community and the naval research enterprise through meetings, conferences, reports, and articles in the peer\-reviewed literature. Fundraising (20% FTE): * Pursues research funding opportunities through typical channels (e.g., ONR, NSF) and any additional emergent relationships with additional sponsors. * Writes and submits single\- and multi\-investigator proposals, including articulation of the scientific question and methods used to explore its answer, and development of a detailed, comprehensive research project plan and budget. * Cultivates and maintains a strong rapport with sponsors and collaborators, domestic and international scientific partners, and representatives from the operational Navy. Personnel Management/Education/Mentoring (15% FTE): * Supervises field engineers, junior engineers, and lab staff. * Serves as advisor and mentor to graduate students and postdocs. Project Management (10% FTE): * Management of grant spending (purchases, salaries, overhead). * Prepares reports to sponsors throughout the project as well as at the close of each project. **Required Qualific ications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license/certification/registration. Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Department. **Preferred Qualifications** * Prior experience and success as a Principal Investigator on federally funded research projects. * Established a history of successful fundraising, project execution, and publication. * Experience evaluating and interpreting in\-situ observations. * Recognized as a national or international authority in ocean acoustics. **Desired Qualifications:** * Applies extensive and advanced principles, theories, and concepts, and contributes to the development of solutions to complex problems that require innovation and ingenuity. * May create new science and/or technologies and extend them into new applications. **About APL:** The Applied Physics Laboratory is a research unit at the University of Washington. Our research expertise is in ocean physics and engineering, ocean and medical acoustics and imaging, polar science, remote sensing, and signal processing. We conduct research and development that is sponsored by a variety of federal and state agencies and take great pride in our long\-standing status as a US Navy\-designated University Affiliated Research Center (UARC). Our work takes place not only on the University of Washington campus and medical centers, but in field locations around the world – at sea, in the air, and on polar ice caps. We apply rigorous scientific inquiry and engineering excellence in pursuit of solutions to important problems for the good of our region, nation, and world. We are focused on building and sustaining a laboratory where all students, staff, and collaborators can realize success. We believe every member of our team enriches our research enterprise by exposing us to a broad range of ways to understand and engage with the world, identify challenges, and discover, design, and deliver solutions. jobs.title: Post-doctoral Research Associate: College of Nursing - UTK
jobs.description: The **College of Nursing (CON)** at the University of Tennessee Knoxville, the state’s flagship research institution, seeks a **Post\-Doctoral Researcher** to provide advanced research training with Vinciya Pandian, PhD, MBA, MSN, ACNP\-BC, and support two complementary programs of research at the intersection of critical care, patient safety, immersive learning, and digital innovation. The fellow will receive mentored training while contributing to execution of the Center for Immersive Learning and Digital Innovation research focused on prevention of central line\-associated bloodstream infection (CLABSI) and to development of a competitive grant application focused on safe care for individuals with a tracheostomy. This is a grant\-funded position and is contingent upon the continued funding of the grant. Post\-Doctoral Research Training and Scholarship * Develop an independent program of research aligned with critical care, patient safety, immersive learning, digital health, and/or implementation science. * Receive mentored training in the design, execution, and evaluation of complex clinical and translational research, including systems engineering, human factors, implementation, quantitative and qualitative methods, and technology\-enabled interventions. * Contribute to development of grant application, including literature synthesis, refinement of aims and hypotheses, research strategy development, preliminary\-data integration, methods, milestones, implementation and evaluation plans, and coordination of contributions from interprofessional collaborators. * Develop grant\-writing skills through preparation of extramural proposals and career\-development applications appropriate to the fellow's trajectory. * Analyze and interpret research data and lead or co\-author data\-based manuscripts for peer\-reviewed journals. Prepare abstracts and presentations for scientific and professional conferences and communicate findings to clinical, scientific, and community audiences. * Gain experience with immersive and digital research platforms, including virtual reality, augmented/mixed reality, simulation, robotics, prototyping, artificial intelligence, and associated usability, acceptability, fidelity, and performance measures. * Develop mentoring and team\-science skills by working with students, research assistants, clinicians, engineers, and other collaborators. * Complete and maintain required human\-subjects protection, CITI, IRB, research\-integrity, privacy, and institutional training and compliance. Assistance with Project Direction (under the direction of the senior researcher) * Support day\-to\-day execution and transition/implementation of the Center for Immersive Learning and Digital Innovation research, maintaining protocol fidelity, study timelines, documentation, and quality\-control procedures. * Coordinate protocol set\-up and amendments; prepare and maintain IRB and regulatory materials; and assist with standard operating procedures, research manuals, study tracking, and reports. * Support participant screening, recruitment, consent/enrollment processes as permitted by protocol, scheduling, study visits, follow\-up, and communication with clinical and research partners. * Set up and maintain REDCap data\-collection instruments; monitor completeness and accuracy; perform data cleaning, coding, documentation, and preparation of analysis\-ready datasets. * Support retrospective chart review, surveys, focus groups/interviews, workflow observation/process mapping, and evaluation of interprofessional, provider, process, and patient outcomes as specified by study protocols. * Assist with implementation and evaluation of immersive and digital interventions, including training activities, usability and acceptability assessment, implementation fidelity, and documentation of barriers and facilitators. * Conduct or support quantitative and qualitative analyses and prepare summaries, tables, figures, presentations, manuscripts, progress reports, and other study products. * Coordinate with clinical, engineering, technology, simulation, infection\-prevention, statistical, and other collaborators; provide work direction to students or research assistants when assigned. * Support research laboratory set\-up and maintenance, including equipment, study materials, survey instruments, inventory, data\-security procedures, and quality control. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Earned PhD or equivalent research doctorate in Nursing, Health Science, Public Health, Biomedical or Health Informatics, Human Factors, Implementation Science, Psychology, Engineering, or a closely related field * Experience conducting or assisting with human\-subjects, clinical, simulation, implementation, or health\-services research * Demonstrated interest in critical care, acute care, patient safety, infection prevention, or technology\-enabled healthcare research * Evidence of scholarly productivity through peer\-reviewed publications, abs sional and interdisciplinary research teams * Data management and analytical skills using research software, with the ability to learn REDCap and other research tools Ability to follow research protocols, maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and resolve research related problems * **Preferred Qualifications:** * Clinical or research experience in intensive care, acute care, or other high\-acuity setting * Nursing or other health\-professional background * Experience with CLABSI prevention, central\-line care, infection prevention, airway/tracheostomy care, mechanical ventilation, or related critical\-care patient\-safety topics. * Experience with NIH, AHRQ, or other extramural grant development or project management. * Experience with REDCap, quantitative/qualitative data analysis, chart\-review data, or mixed\-methods research * Experience with simulation, virtual/augmented reality, digital health, robotics, or other emerging healthcare technologies * Experience coordinating multi\-site or interdisciplinary research and/or mentoring students or research assistants. **Work Location:** 1200 Volunteer Blvd Knoxville, TN 37996 **Duration:** 2 years **Compensation:*** Anticipated hiring range: $65,000 – $70,000 * **Application Instructions** For best consideration, applicants should submit a cover letter and resume before October 12 th , 2026\. Specific questions about the position may be sent to College of Nursing Human Resources, conhr@utk.edu **About the College of Nursing** With a longstanding tradition of excellence in nursing education, research, and clinical practice, we are proud to be a guiding force in healthcare education. We embrace innovation while honoring the values that have shaped our success. By offering cutting\-edge academic programs, supporting impactful research, and forging strong community partnerships, we prepare healthcare professionals who deliver high\-quality, culturally responsive care in a diverse and ever\-changing world. Join the Vol Nurse Family! **Get to know CON** The University of Tennessee, Knoxville, has shaped leaders, changemakers, and innovative thinkers since its founding in 1794\. The university is home to more than 38,000 students and 10,000 statewide employees—the Volunteers—who uphold the university’s tradition of lighting the way for others through leadership and service. UT Knoxville offers over 900 programs of study across 14 degree\-granting colleges and schools. As Tennessee’s flagship land\-grant university, its footprint spans the entire state. The university holds the highest Carnegie classification for research activity and has deep partnerships with industry leaders and the US Department of Energy’s largest multidisciplinary laboratory, Oak Ridge National Laboratory. The Knoxville campus serves and recruits for UT Knoxville, including the Institute of Agriculture and the Space Institute, as well as the UT Institute of Public Service. UT Knoxville considers its employees its number one asset. With values that focus on work\-life balance, compensation, and innovation leadership, all Vols are supported to advance professionally. Employees have access to career development and coaching, continued education, and an extensive list of development and training possibilities. The Volunteer employee experience implements structures and practices to attract and retain top\-tier talent, fostering a strong staff community and supporting a culture of involvement and engagement for everyone. The university holds a strong commitment to its land\-grant mission of learning and engagement, with a tradition of service and leadership that carries that Volunteer spirit throughout the state and around the world. It has been ranked nationally as “Best Employer for New Graduates,” “One of America’s Best Large Employers,” and “Best Workplace for Women,” and has been designated as “Best Place for Working Parents” by Forbes Magazine. Apply today and join the Tennessee Volunteer community!
